# Zipline Fact Sheet

## About Zipline

Zipline is an American robotics company and the world’s largest autonomous delivery service. Zipline
has flown more than 130 million autonomous miles, operates on multiple continents, and safely makes
a delivery every 30 seconds somewhere in the world.

Zipline started in 2014 to build the first logistics system that serves all people equally. We did
this because 5.5 million kids lose their lives each year due to a lack of access to basic medical
products. Those deaths are entirely preventable. Our system gets blood and medicine from Point A to
Point B when people need it – saving lives. Today, Zipline delivers to more than 5,000 hospitals and
health centers and has become a key part of healthcare supply chains in Africa, helping save tens of
thousands of lives and dramatically improve health outcomes.

It turns out that moving things quickly from Point A to Point B is a universal need. Each year in
the U.S., more than 5 billion on-demand orders are delivered using vehicles that weigh thousands of
pounds to transport items that weigh less than five. It’s slow, expensive, and bad for the
environment. A better system helps busy families care for their kids, brings fast and reliable
delivery to hard-to-serve areas, and helps older adults stay healthier with easier access to
prescriptions and fresh groceries—without needing a car trip.

In 2025, Zipline launched Platform 2 (P2), our home delivery service designed to make instant
deliveries of food, retail goods, and health products to people who live even in dense cities across
the U.S. In its first year of service Zipline launched P2 in Pea Ridge, Arkansas and more than 20
communities in the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex with Walmart, and more than a dozen restaurant
brands. Customers use the Zipline app to choose from tens of thousands of items with many more being
added all the time.

We deliver food from restaurants, including fan favorites like Chipotle, Crumbl, Blaze Pizza,
Wendy’s, Little Caesars, Hawaiian Bros, and much more. Most orders arrive at homes in less than 30
minutes from the time the order is placed, which means fries arrive hot and crispy, and drinks
arrive still cold and refreshing.

## Technology

Zipline has two delivery services—a service optimized for long-range and rural deliveries, Platform
1, and a service optimized for urban home delivery, Platform 2. Zips are what people see, but they
are only a small percentage of what Zipline does. Behind each delivery is a complex network of
airspace deconfliction tools, inventory management, fulfillment software, warehousing, performance
management, cold chain storage, and more.

Zipline’s instant logistics system is a trusted partner for businesses, governments, and consumers
across the healthcare, food, and retail sectors. Zipline operates around the world 24/7 to deliver
tens of thousands of different items, including medical supplies, blood, vaccines, prescriptions,
retail goods, food, and products that support human and animal health.

## Our Healthcare Work
* Today Zipline regularly delivers to more than 5,000 hospitals and health facilities, including
everything from blood, vaccines and medical products to supplies and gauze. Collectively our
deliveries help doctors save more than 10,000 lives each year.
* Many of our deliveries have helped save the lives of mothers in particular. Numerous studies have
found Zipline’s service helps dramatically improve health outcomes, including:
* 56% decrease in maternal mortality
* 66% decrease in missed opportunities to treat malaria.
* We reduce medical product stockouts by up to 60%
* $0.66 incremental cost per additional Fully Immunized Child (lower than all other
interventions)

**Learn more about ****[Zipline's Healthcare Impact.][3]**

## About Platform 2
* P2 can deliver up to ten times faster than traditional automotive delivery and can make deliveries
ten miles away as quickly as ten minutes.
* Each P2 aircraft is designed to fly up to 24 miles and carry up to 8lbs, with plenty of room for a
family dinner.
* Zipping Points let businesses use Zipline without any construction. Zipline orders are loaded into
Zipping Points in seconds without specialized packaging, training, devices. The Zip will arrive
and pick up the order completely asynchronously.
* P2 aircraft are designed to stay quieter than cars and trucks by hovering high above while its
Delivery Zip descends to the ground on a tether to deliver a package - a contactless delivery
system.
* Zipline’s home delivery service is designed to handle the vast majority of instant delivery orders
in the U.S. across the food, healthcare, and convenience sectors.
* P2 aircraft are equipped with Zipline’s FlightIQ, its advanced onboard autonomy and perception
suite that lets us fly, navigate, and deliver smartly and safely.
* All of Zipline’s aircraft and operations are FAA-approved. Zipline is a pioneer in the use of
Unmanned Aircraft System Traffic Management (UTM), which lets multiple operators automatically
reserve flight routes and airspace, part of its redundant safety systems to avoid conflicts in our
shared airspace.
* For more information on our safety operations, check out [Safety at Zipline][4].

## FAQ

**What does Zipline delivery sound like?**

Zipline deliveries are quieter than common neighborhood sounds. We work hard to be a welcome part of
the communities we serve and to blend seamlessly into the everyday soundscape.

**What weather conditions can Zipline deliver in?**

We run one of the largest testing campaigns in aviation history to make sure we can deliver in rain,
wind, storms, cold, and other conditions that would normally slow down automotive transport.

**What makes Zipline’s approach different from other delivery services?**

It’s just not efficient to use a 3,000 pound car to deliver things like a takeout order, or your
medication. Zipline is faster, more convenient, and doesn’t get stuck in traffic. By staying safely
high up in the air, Zipline deliveries are quieter than common neighborhood sounds.

**Does Zipline have approval to fly?**

Yes. Zipline follows all relevant regulations in every country it operates. Within the United
States, Zipline has all necessary permissions from the FAA to operate. We work closely with the FAA
to ensure our system meets or beats all safety standards and regulations, including extensive
verification of our aircraft, software, operations, procedures, personnel, and more. We work closely
with local communities to keep improving – adding new businesses and features people care about.

relevant_companies.polished_summary: Flirtey is a company specializing in live sports streaming and betting services, offering a comprehensive platform for sports enthusiasts. Their core offerings include real-time match scores, detailed schedules, highlights, and betting odds across various sports leagues, catering to a diverse audience of sports fans and bettors. With a focus on enhancing the viewing experience, Flirtey aims to provide engaging content and reliable information for users seeking to stay connected with their favorite sports.

relevant_companies.company_summary: Matternet is a logistics company that specializes in innovative drone delivery systems, primarily serving the healthcare and e-commerce sectors. Its core products include the Matternet M2 Drone, designed for urban logistics with a payload capacity of 2.5 kg, the Matternet Station for automated package handling, and a comprehensive software platform that optimizes drone operations and logistics management. By leveraging advanced drone technology, Matternet aims to revolutionize the logistics landscape, enhancing efficiency and reliability for its target customers.

# Shaping Tomorrow's Sky
# with Indigenous Drone

Aebocode Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a drone manufacturing company in India focused on building
indigenous drone solutions. We design and manufacture drones for defence, emergency services,
industrial use, education, and urban development. Our work supports Make in India and strengthens
local manufacturing and self-reliance. Every drone is built with real use cases in mind, from field
operations to training and research.

## Crafted Excellence

[Surveillance Drone]

### Surveillance Drone

This surveillance drone is designed to monitor areas continuously and collect real-time visual data
with stable and reliable flight performance. It is widely used in defence operations for border
monitoring, patrol missions, and threat detection, as well as in security patrolling of sensitive
locations. The drone supports perimeter surveillance, crowd monitoring, and infrastructure
protection across large areas. By providing continuous aerial awareness, it helps security teams
respond faster and operate more safely.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
5 kms LOS
Flight Time
Up to 45 mins
Max Speed
Up to 14 m/s
[Read More][16]
[FPV Drone]

### FPV Drone

This FPV drone offers an unmatched, immersive flying experience with real-time first-person visuals
that put you in the pilot’s seat. Engineered for speed, agility, and smooth maneuverability, it’s
ideal for drone racing, freestyle tricks, and cinematic videography. Its responsive controls and
advanced stabilization ensure confident flight even during aggressive movements.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
5 kms LOS
Flight Time
Up to 25 Mins
Max Speed
Up to 20m/s
[Read More][17]
[Cargo Drone]

### Cargo Drone

This cargo drone is designed to transport heavy loads safely and efficiently across short and long
distances while maintaining stable and controlled flight. It uses intelligent flight systems to
manage weight balance, route accuracy, and safe landing, making it suitable for logistics, medical
supply delivery, disaster relief, and defense operations.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
5 Kms LOS
Flight Time
Up to 30 Mins
Max Speed
Up to 8 m/s
[Read More][18]
[Fixed Wing Drone]

### Fixed wing Drone

This fixed wing drone is built for long-range missions that require extended endurance and wide-area
coverage. Its aerodynamic design allows it to fly longer distances while consuming less energy
compared to multi-rotor drones. It is widely used for mapping, surveying, border monitoring, and
large-scale surveillance operations. Stable flight, precise data capture, and efficient area
coverage make fixed wing drones suitable for strategic and commercial applications.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
5 Kms LOS
Flight Time
Up to 90 Min
Max Speed
Up to 25 m/s
[Read More][19]
[Explore More][20]
[Abhyas Drone]

### Abhyas Drone

This training drone is designed to help beginners and professionals learn drone flying in a safe and
controlled way. It focuses on stable flight, predictable handling, and easy recovery from mistakes,
which makes it ideal for skill development and practice sessions. The drone allows pilots to
understand basic aerodynamics, navigation, and flight control before moving to advanced or
mission-critical platforms. It is commonly used in training institutes, educational programs, and
defense or industrial pilot training.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
2 Km LOS
Flight Time
Up to 30 Mins
Max Speed
Up to 10 m/s
[Read More][21]
[Fire Fighting Drone]

### Fire fighting Drone

This firefighting drone is designed to support fire response teams by providing aerial visibility
and critical data during emergencies. It helps locate fire hotspots, monitor fire spread, and assess
risk in real time without putting firefighters in danger. The drone can operate in high-temperature
and low-visibility environments, making it useful for urban fires, industrial sites, and forest
areas.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
5 Kms LOS
Flight Time
Up to 30 Min
Max Speed
Up to 15 m/s
[Read More][22]
[Drone Simulator]

### Drone Simulator

This drone simulator is designed to train pilots in a safe and controlled virtual environment before
real-world operations. It helps users understand flight dynamics, controls, and emergency handling
without risking hardware damage. The simulator supports skill development for beginners as well as
advanced mission practice for professionals. By improving pilot confidence and reducing training
costs, drone simulators play an important role in responsible drone operations.
[Read More][23]
[Show less][24]

# amr industry alliance

uniting to act on antimicrobial resistance
The AMR Industry Alliance is one of the largest private sector coalitions set up to provide
sustainable solutions to curb antimicrobial resistance, **with over 90 biotech, diagnostics,
generics and research-based pharmaceutical companies and associations** joining forces. Read some of
our latest reports below:
[ principles for pooled procurement ][17]
[ leaving the lab ][18]
[ equitable and responsible access roadmap ][19]
[ antibiotic manufacturing standard ][20]
[read more][21]

###  

### We drive and measure the life-sciences industry progress to curb antimicrobial resistance in
### four different areas:

Invest in R&D to meet public health needs with new innovative diagnostics & treatments
Improve access to high-quality antibiotics and ensuring that new ones are available to all
Work to reduce the development of antimicrobial resistance
Support measures to reduce environmental impact from production of antibiotics

## shared goals

We are uniting efforts to reduce the development of antimicrobial resistance, invest in R&D to meet
public health needs and improve access to antibiotics, vaccines and diagnostics.
[find out more][22]

## progress report

Despite the ongoing challenges presented by the pandemic, the AMR Industry Alliance’s 2021 Progress
Report captures efforts made by the life sciences industry to fight AMR across several domains:
research and science, access, appropriate use, and manufacturing. The third iteration of this
biannual report captures progress made by Alliance members between July 2019 and March 2021. Find
out more below.
[find out more][23]

## in action

Our case studies provide snap-shots from across the life-sciences industry, share information on the
tangible steps we are taking to invest in new research to develop new antibiotics and vaccines,
prevent infection, and improve appropriate use of antibiotics.
[find out more][24]

Mr. Andy Card, the second longest-tenured White House Chief of Staff, has served in senior government roles under three U.S. Presidents. Mr. Card serves on the Board of Directors of public corporation Union Pacific, on the Business Advisory Board of BrainStorm Cell Therapeutics, on the Advisory Board of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, and on a number of non-profit boards. Mr. Card, appointed in November 2000, served as Chief of Staff to President George W. Bush from January 2001 to April 2006. Before that, Mr. Card was Vice President-Government Relations for General Motors Corporation, one of the world’s largest automobile manufacturers. From 1993 to 1998, Mr. Card was President and Chief Executive Officer of the American Automobile Manufacturers Association, the trade association whose members were Chrysler Corporation, Ford Motor Company, and General Motors Corporation. From March 1987 until March 1988, Mr. Card ran the successful New Hampshire Presidential Primary Campaign for George H. W. Bush.

## Engineering Capabilities

Draganfly is a contract engineering partner for government agencies, enterprise organizations,
academic institutions, and businesses of all sizes. Our team’s truest capabilities are actualized
during the engineering process as hardware designers, software designers, engineers, project
managers, and vertical-specific experts come together to build custom drone solutions for our
partners. Our end-to-end engineering services include:

**Hardware design:** Component, product, and system design
**Software design:** Custom software and interface design
**Development:** Including integration with 3rd party platforms, PX4, Ardupilot, DJI and more
**Modeling:** 3D design and modeling of mechanical components
**ITAR equipment management:** Approved handling and integration of ITAR, and Controlled Goods
technologies
**Support:** Testing, training, documentation, and repairs

## Prototyping

Whether we created the original design or not, **we can build a prototype to make your vision a
reality.** We specialize in low volume, handmade hardware with a strong attention to detail. All you
need is to provide us high-level specs of your components and we’ll craft a turnkey solution for
your specific use case. We have the capabilities to source, supply, or fabricate any material
necessary for your project. Our in-house equipment includes a **CNC mill, CNC router, lathe, FDM 3D
printers, vacuum forming machine, temperature calibration chamber, gyro rate table, and more** to
provide electronics, machining, and PCB assembly services. We are skilled in working with the
following materials:
**Plastics**
**Composites**
**Aluminum**
**Carbon fibre**

Our team of engineers pioneered the Drone space more than two decades ago.

No matter the challenge, we can craft a custom solution for your business.

## Andy Card

## ADVISOR

Mr. Andy Card, the second longest-tenured White House Chief of Staff, has served in senior
government roles under three U.S. Presidents. Mr. Card serves on the Board of Directors of public
corporation Union Pacific, on the Business Advisory Board of BrainStorm Cell Therapeutics, on the
Advisory Board of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, and on a number of non-profit boards. He is also a
professional speaker represented by the Washington Speakers Bureau and joined NBC News as a
contributor in April 2017.

Mr. Card, appointed in November 2000, served as Chief of Staff to President George W. Bush from
January 2001 to April 2006. Prior to his tenure as White House Chief of Staff, Mr. Card managed and
ran the Republican National Convention in Philadelphia at the request of nominee Texas Governor
George W. Bush. Before that, Mr. Card was Vice President-Government Relations for General Motors
Corporation, one of the world’s largest automobile manufacturers. From 1993 to 1998, Mr. Card was
President and Chief Executive Officer of the American Automobile Manufacturers Association, the
trade association whose members were Chrysler Corporation, Ford Motor Company, and General Motors
Corporation. When Chrysler became part of Daimler Corporation, Mr. Card oversaw the dissolution of
the nearly 100-year-old trade association.

Mr. Card also served as Deputy Chief of Staff and then as a Cabinet Member for President George H.W.
Bush as the 11th Secretary of Transportation. Prior to that, he served as Special Assistant (1983 to
1987) and later as Deputy Assistant to the President and Director of Intergovernmental Affairs for
President Ronald Reagan (1988) where he was a liaison to governors, statewide elected officials,
state legislators, mayors, and other elected officials. From March 1987 until March 1988, Mr. Card
ran the successful New Hampshire Presidential Primary Campaign for George H. W. Bush.

Mr. Card is a graduate of the University of South Carolina with a B.S. in Engineering. He also
attended the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy and the John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard
University. Mr. Card served in the U.S. Navy from 1965 to 1967.

## Tim Dunnigan

## DIRECTOR

Tim Dunnigan, a retired U.S. Army Infantry Officer and accomplished technology entrepreneur, is the
CEO & President of MMS Products, Inc., a defense technology solutions provider. He is also the
Founder of CaptureTec, LLC, a defense consultancy group focused on supporting Warfighters through
leadership and innovation. As COO and Co-founder of Talon Aerolytics, Tim led the development of the
nation’s largest aerial drone services provider, expanding operations to all 50 states and
facilitating digital data collection with AI analysis for national critical infrastructure.

As CEO and Founder of Strategic Integration, LLC, Tim developed and operated the CTED (Create, Test,
Educate, Deploy) turnkey business model for defense consulting and technology integration. He has
served America’s security interests abroad through multiple classified (TS/SCI) contracts with the
U.S. Department of Defense. Additionally, as the Founder of iK9, LLC (CVE SDVOSB), Tim co-authored
the Veterans Administration’s (VA) training protocols for service dogs provided to Military Veterans
with Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD).

Mr. Dunnigan is a Corporate Advisor with Integrated Defense Accelerator, Founder of the I’m a Hero
Too Foundation [501(c)(3)], and a children’s book author. He holds an active Top Secret security
clearance and is currently a Doctoral Student researching leadership efficacy in decision-making
with regard to drone usage, where AI and machine autonomy are considered. Tim has been awarded six
patents and has two patents pending for an aerial drone delivery system he developed to address
capability gaps he witnessed during his multiple humanitarian trips to Ukraine.

## Andy Card

## ADVISOR

Mr. Andy Card, the second longest-tenured White House Chief of Staff, has served in senior
government roles under three U.S. Presidents. Mr. Card serves on the Board of Directors of public
corporation Union Pacific, on the Business Advisory Board of BrainStorm Cell Therapeutics, on the
Advisory Board of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, and on a number of non-profit boards. He is also a
professional speaker represented by the Washington Speakers Bureau and joined NBC News as a
contributor in April 2017.

Mr. Card, appointed in November 2000, served as Chief of Staff to President George W. Bush from
January 2001 to April 2006. Prior to his tenure as White House Chief of Staff, Mr. Card managed and
ran the Republican National Convention in Philadelphia at the request of nominee Texas Governor
George W. Bush. Before that, Mr. Card was Vice President-Government Relations for General Motors
Corporation, one of the world’s largest automobile manufacturers. From 1993 to 1998, Mr. Card was
President and Chief Executive Officer of the American Automobile Manufacturers Association, the
trade association whose members were Chrysler Corporation, Ford Motor Company, and General Motors
Corporation. When Chrysler became part of Daimler Corporation, Mr. Card oversaw the dissolution of
the nearly 100-year-old trade association.

Mr. Card also served as Deputy Chief of Staff and then as a Cabinet Member for President George H.W.
Bush as the 11th Secretary of Transportation. Prior to that, he served as Special Assistant (1983 to
1987) and later as Deputy Assistant to the President and Director of Intergovernmental Affairs for
President Ronald Reagan (1988) where he was a liaison to governors, statewide elected officials,
state legislators, mayors, and other elected officials. From March 1987 until March 1988, Mr. Card
ran the successful New Hampshire Presidential Primary Campaign for George H. W. Bush.

Mr. Card is a graduate of the University of South Carolina with a B.S. in Engineering. He also
attended the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy and the John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard
University. Mr. Card served in the U.S. Navy from 1965 to 1967.

The TelePress™ is a comprehensive remote blood pressure monitoring device for personal use. By
placing a strap around the upper arm and pressing a button, a person easily activates the automatic
measurement and transmission of the heart rate and blood pressure readings to a remote medical
monitoring center. These values are then compared to baseline measurements and added to the
corresponding personal health record, which is stored in a central database.

The home-based, one-touch, automatic self-pressurization device accurately measures the heart rate,
systolic and diastolic values, which are displayed on a large LCD screen. Storage, evaluation, and
transmission of measured values are handled by the HCC IV.

**Features / Advantages**
* Real-Time response to abnormal measurements
* Early identification of unfavorable trends
* Personal monitoring program
* Improved management of treatment programs
* Assured access to accurate patient data

[ Learn more ][78]

## TELEMEDICINE PRODUCT

CCM™
SHL Telemedicine’s Central Communication Module (CCM™) is an innovative telecommunication device
that transmits medical data to our telemedicine centers from a variety of medical monitoring devices
developed by SHL.The SHL CCM is designed to transmit over an Internet connection, cellular platform,
or regular landline. The choice of transmission method will depend on the type of telemedicine
device/s provided to the user and their telecommunication set up at home.Our CCM works with many
devices from SHL’s product line, including our blood pressure, weighing (TeleWeight), oxygen

Founded in 2018, blueflite^{®} offers a drone-based logistics platform for faster and more
cost-effective deliveries. The patented, unique, and all-electrical drone design has vertical
take-off and landing capabilities, advanced maneuverability, and is built without compromise – to
meet the rigorous demands of commercial operations.

Whether packages are large or small, our drone-based platform is built to scale in both size and
quantity. Operating through our proprietary logistics systems blueflite^{®}’s digital network is
designed to work with existing logistic solutions, making blueflite^{®} the obvious choice for large
logistic contracts.

[Contact us][18]

high-speed cruise through vectored thrust. Superior operating economics, for a range of logistics
applications. The all-electric drive-train allows for emission-free energy sources.

* Lightweight carbon composite airframe
* Independently actuated tilt-rotors
* All-electric design with battery monitoring system
* Integrated cargo compartment with easy access

Drone as first responder – When time is life

Your browser does not support the video tag.

Partners in our journey of collaborative innovation:

By harnessing the power of autonomous drones, we deliver life-saving medical equipment and provide real-time situational awareness to emergency services before the first unit arrives, dramatically improving response times and ultimately, saving lives. Presently, our system reaches over 250,000 people, and is on constant standby, ready to be deployed at a moments notice.

When every second counts.

Get started today, sign up for our online introduction webinar.

Everdrone GridPlanner™ predictive analytics

Our innovative Everdrone GridPlanner™ isn’t just a tool—it’s a comprehensive analytical system designed to revolutionize emergency response efficacy. Utilizing the latest in data analysis technologies, it assesses system responsiveness, providing critical evaluations of how drone assistance can dramatically expedite emergency services compared to conventional methods.

The power of GridPlanner™ lies in its capability to conduct an extensive gap analysis for various types of emergencies. By meticulously reviewing historical emergency incidents and executing simulations of drone flights to real-world locations, it furnishes predictive insights that are invaluable for strategic planning. This thorough analysis not only facilitates the identification of crucial areas that require the most attention but also empowers you to allocate resources efficiently and tailor the grid according to your specific needs and ambitions, ensuring a focused approach on the zones of highest impact.

Embarking on this transformative journey begins with integrating our drone-as-first-responder grid. This systematic approach ensures not just expansive coverage but also heightened responsiveness in critical moments. It’s about targeting efforts where they’re needed most, fortifying your emergency response framework, and providing immediate, life-saving interventions.

Medkit + Liveview delivery

Consider the significant benefits of immediate, precise situational understanding coupled with delivery of essential medical supplies. Our drone system provides emergency teams, including ambulance services, with critical information to assess situations before arrival, facilitating more efficient, safe, and swift responses.

Our service extends beyond delivering valuable insights. It’s a vital resource in critical moments, quickly transporting crucial medical equipment such as AEDs and anti-bleeding kits to the scene. This approach maximises the effectiveness of the ‘golden hour,’ the crucial period during which immediate medical intervention is most successful. This dual functionality represents not just innovation but a vital support in emergency scenarios. With real-time data and essential medical supplies at hand, our first-on-scene drone system enhances emergency response and enables precision healthcare like never before.

Evidence-Based Approach

Our dedication to evidence-based solutions is at the heart of our mission, exemplified through rigorous research in partnership with prestigious entities like the Karolinska Institutet. This scientific rigor ensures our emergency drone services are reliable, precise, and grounded in solid data.

Operational excellence is paramount, influenced by extensive experience from live, real-world deployments. This isn’t merely about drones; it’s about an integrated, responsive system that encompasses advanced logistics, real-time analytics, and seamless communication—all crucial for effective emergency response.

Our collaborations with Europe’s brightest innovators and researchers reinforce the effectiveness and advancement of our solutions. It’s not just a service we offer—it’s a data-backed, operationally excellent lifeline.

Time critical events

are where we thrive

{{getTime}}

Taking the direct route, eliminating problems like rush hour traffic and traffic jams allows us to arrive faster than keeping to the road as traditional emergency service vehicles. It also gets us places where it is otherwise hard or impossible to get to with cars or trucks.

moments, quickly transporting crucial medical equipment such as AEDs and anti-bleeding kits to the
scene. This approach maximises the effectiveness of the ‘golden hour,’ the crucial period during
which immediate medical intervention is most successful. This dual functionality represents not
just innovation but a vital support in emergency scenarios. With real-time data and essential
medical supplies at hand, our first-on-scene drone system enhances emergency response and enables
precision healthcare like never before.
* Evidence-Based Approach

Our dedication to evidence-based solutions is at the heart of our mission, exemplified through
rigorous research in partnership with prestigious entities like the Karolinska Institutet. This
scientific rigor ensures our emergency drone services are reliable, precise, and grounded in solid
data.

Operational excellence is paramount, influenced by extensive experience from live, real-world
deployments. This isn’t merely about drones; it’s about an integrated, responsive system that
encompasses advanced logistics, real-time analytics, and seamless communication—all crucial for
effective emergency response.

Our collaborations with Europe’s brightest innovators and researchers reinforce the effectiveness
and advancement of our solutions. It’s not just a service we offer—it’s a data-backed,
operationally excellent lifeline.

## Time critical events
## are where we thrive

{{getTime}}

Taking the direct route, eliminating problems like rush hour traffic and traffic jams allows us to
arrive faster than keeping to the road as traditional emergency service vehicles. It also gets us
places where it is otherwise hard or impossible to get to with cars or trucks.

## End-to-End Aerial Intelligence & Drone Operations

## We Manage the Entire Drone Process for You

From mission planning to actionable insights, Volatus Aerospace delivers turnkey aerial solutions
that help organizations operate safer, smarter, and more efficiently

[ Talk To an Expert ][37]

### We don't just fly drones, we deliver outcomes. insights. results. intelligence.

## How Our Services Work

## We take care of everything from mission planning to intelligence delivery.

Our workflow is designed to ensure accurate data acquisition, operational efficiency, and actionable
outcomes. We combine aerial platforms, advanced sensors, and domain expertise to deliver end-to-end
solutions tailored to each project requirement.

## 01

## Requirement Consultation

We begin by understanding your operational objectives, site conditions, technical requirements, and
expected outcomes to define the right aerial solution.

## 02

## Scope Analysis & Mission Planning

Our specialists evaluate project feasibility, sensor requirements, regulatory constraints, flight
operations, and data deliverables to develop an optimized execution plan.

## 03

## Data Acquisition & Operations

Once aligned, our operations team deploys the appropriate UAV or crewed aerial platform to capture
high-quality geospatial, visual, thermal, or sensor-based data.

## 04

## Processing & Intelligence Delivery

Collected data is processed using advanced analytics and geospatial workflows to generate actionable
insights, technical reports, maps, models, and decision-ready intelligence, not just raw data.

Aerial Intelligence Services

## Aerial Intelligence Services

## Surveillance & Monitoring

Continuous or periodic aerial observation operations focused on real-time situational awareness,
activity detection, perimeter security, and operational monitoring over large areas or distributed
assets.
* Pipeline & Utility Corridor Surveillance
* Perimeter & Critical Infrastructure Monitoring
* Construction & Industrial Site Monitoring
* Traffic, Crowd & Public Safety Monitoring
* Remote Operations Monitoring

[ Learn More ][38]

## Asset Inspections

High-resolution condition assessment and defect identification of physical assets and infrastructure
using visual, thermal, LiDAR, and sensor-based aerial data acquisition.
* Energy & Utility Inspections
* Pipeline & Corridor Inspections
* Thermal & Infrared Inspections
* Gas Detection & Environmental Inspections
* Confined Space Inspections
[ Learn More ][39]

## Geomatics & Mapping

Acquisition and processing of accurate geospatial data for surveying, terrain modelling, mapping,
volumetric analysis, and digital twin generation.
* Photogrammetry & Orthomosaic Mapping
* Digital Twin & 3D Modelling
* Volumetric & Stockpile Analysis
* Change Detection & Site Monitoring
* GIS & Spatial Analytics

[ Learn More ][40]

## Logistics & Delivery

UAV-based transportation of payloads, equipment, medical supplies, and mission-critical materials
using autonomous or remotely piloted aerial logistics systems.
* Medical & Humanitarian Aid Supply
* Rural & Remote Area Logistics
* Urban Cargo Delivery
* Industrial & Commercial Logistics

[ Learn More ][41]

## Emergency & Disaster Response

Rapid deployment aerial operations for incident assessment, search and rescue support, hazard
monitoring, emergency coordination, and post-disaster intelligence gathering.
* Hazardous Area Reconnaissance
* Search & Rescue Support
* Emergency Situation Monitoring
* Flood & Disaster Assessment
* Wildfire Detection & Monitoring

[ Learn More ][42]

## Agriculture & Environmental Monitoring

Remote sensing and aerial analytics solutions for vegetation analysis, environmental assessment,
forestry management, crop intelligence, and natural resource monitoring.
* Crop Health Monitoring
* Multispectral Vegetation Analysis
* Wildfire Risk Assessment
* Deforestation Monitoring
* Biodiversity & Habitat Monitoring

[ Learn More ][43]

## Integrated Fleet & Operational Platforms

Our operations are supported by integrated aerial and ground-based acquisition platforms designed
for scalable monitoring, inspection, surveying, and geospatial intelligence operations.

### UAV Systems

Remotely piloted aerial platforms supporting flexible deployment across inspection, surveillance,
mapping, monitoring, and logistics operations.

### Crewed Aircraft

Manned aerial platforms supporting large-area coverage, long-endurance missions, specialized
sensing, and complex airborne operations.

### Fixed-Wing Aircraft

Supporting corridor mapping, regional surveillance, airborne LiDAR acquisition, and long-range
operational missions.

### Rotary-Wing Aircraft

Supporting low-altitude inspections, precision monitoring, rapid deployment, and
infrastructure-focused aerial operations.

### Mobile Geospatial Systems

Vehicle-mounted acquisition platforms supporting roadway mapping, corridor surveys, urban modelling,
and infrastructure intelligence operations.

### Terrestrial Survey Systems

Ground-based laser scanning and spatial acquisition systems supporting engineering surveys,
industrial modelling, and high-accuracy infrastructure documentation.

## Technical Capabilities

Our capabilities and multi-sensor approach enables deeper insight, earlier detection, and better
decision-making.

### AI Analytics

Automated defect detection and predictive data insights.

### Thermal Imaging

Inspections for fault detection.

### LiDAR

Mapping and digital twin modelling.

### BVLOS Operations

Extended-range data collection beyond VLOS.

### Corona UV

Detection for electrical discharge.

### RTK / PPK Positioning

High-precision centimeter-level geo-referencing accuracy.

### Photogrammetry

Image-based mapping and 3D reconstruction.

### Multispectral Imaging

Environmental, agricultural, and specialized crop/soil analysis.

### Live Streaming & Remote Operations

Real-time awareness and secure telemetry broadcasting.

### Gas Detection Sensors (OGI)

Optical Gas Imaging & methane detection.

### Edge Computing & Data Processing

Real-time compute for rapid localized sorting and safety.

### Digital Twin & 3D Modelling

Accurate virtual reconstructions of physical asset.

## Sentinel

## Autonomous Monitoring Platform

Volatus Sentinel provides an autonomous aerial monitoring system designed to support persistent
infrastructure inspection and monitoring operations. Sentinel systems integrate autonomous drone
operations with advanced monitoring technologies

### Autonomous Drone Docking & Launch

Autonomous drone docking and launch capability for persistent operations.

### Remote Connectivity

Remote connectivity through cellular and satellite communications.

### Secure Remote Monitoring

Secure remote monitoring and system management.

### PTZ Situational Awareness Cameras

## Advanced Aerial Surveillance & Monitoring Solutions

Modern surveillance operations require continuous situational awareness, scalable monitoring
capabilities, and rapid access to operational intelligence. Our aerial surveillance and monitoring
solutions support infrastructure operators, industrial facilities, public safety agencies, and
remote operations teams with real-time airborne visibility and aerial monitoring capabilities.

Using integrated aerial platforms equipped with HD imaging systems, thermal sensors, live-streaming
technologies, and AI-assisted analytics, we support both scheduled monitoring operations and
rapid-response aerial deployments across diverse operational environments.

## Critical Infrastructure Monitoring

Aerial monitoring of industrial facilities, substations, refineries, solar farms, mining sites, and
other high-value infrastructure assets.

## Pipeline & Utility Corridor Surveillance

Monitoring of linear infrastructure corridors for unauthorized activity, encroachments, leak
indicators, vegetation risks, and operational anomalies.

## Construction & Industrial Site Monitoring

Periodic aerial monitoring for operational oversight, project progress tracking, equipment activity
observation, and safety assessment.

## Remote Operations Monitoring

Continuous or scheduled aerial monitoring for remote assets and geographically distributed
operations where ground visibility is limited.

## Traffic & Crowd Monitoring

Real-time aerial observation supporting traffic flow analysis, public event monitoring, crowd
movement assessment, and emergency coordination.

## Technology Stack & Capabilities

Integrated aerial sensing, real-time monitoring systems, and scalable operational workflows
supporting continuous surveillance and monitoring operations.

### RGB / HD Visual Imaging

High-resolution airborne imaging for real-time observation, monitoring, and visual intelligence
collection.

### Thermal Imaging

Thermal sensing capabilities for heat anomaly detection, low-visibility monitoring, and operational
risk identification.

## Advanced Airborne Inspection Solutions

Modern asset inspection programs require accurate condition assessment, reduced operational
downtime, and safer access to critical infrastructure. Our aerial inspection solutions support
industrial operators, utilities, infrastructure owners, and engineering teams with high-resolution
airborne inspections, advanced sensor data acquisition, and scalable inspection workflows.

Using integrated aerial platforms equipped with thermal imaging, LiDAR, gas detection, multispectral
sensing, and HD visual systems, we deliver inspection data that supports maintenance planning,
regulatory compliance, structural assessment, and operational decision-making.

## Infrastructure & Structural Inspections

Inspection of bridges, towers, rooftops, industrial structures, and transportation infrastructure
for condition assessment and defect identification.

## Energy & Utility Inspections

Aerial inspections of transmission lines, substations, solar farms, wind turbines, and utility
assets supporting maintenance and operational reliability.

## Pipeline & Corridor Inspections

Monitoring of pipelines and right-of-way corridors for leaks, erosion, encroachments, vegetation
risks, and infrastructure anomalies.

## Thermal & Infrared Inspections

Thermal assessment of industrial systems, electrical assets, energy infrastructure, and operational
hotspots using airborne thermography.

## Gas Detection & Environmental Inspections

Airborne gas detection and environmental monitoring supporting leak identification, emissions
assessment, and regulatory compliance workflows.

## Confined Space Inspections

Remote inspection of hazardous and restricted-access environments using advanced aerial systems to
improve safety and operational visibility.

and asset intelligence.

High-accuracy spatial data acquisition supporting structural analysis, digital twins, and

### AI-Based Analytics

Automated analytics supporting anomaly detection, defect identification, and inspection data

### RTK / PPK Positioning

Survey-grade positioning systems ensuring accurate and repeatable inspection data acquisition.

Geo-referenced inspection outputs, condition analysis, and reporting supporting maintenance and
operational planning.

## Driving the Future of Drone-Based Delivery

Modern logistics operations increasingly require faster response times, remote accessibility, and
flexible transportation capabilities. Our aerial logistics and delivery solutions support efficient
payload transport for industrial operations, emergency response, healthcare logistics, and
remote-area missions where traditional ground access may be limited or time-sensitive.

Using integrated aerial platforms, autonomous navigation systems, live operational monitoring, and
scalable mission coordination workflows, we support both scheduled and on-demand aerial delivery
operations across diverse operational scenarios.

## Medical & Humanitarian Aid

Delivering critical supplies to hospitals, remote clinics, and disaster zones.

## Rural & Remote Access

Serving hard-to-reach locations where traditional transport is limited or not possible.

## Industrial & Commercial Logistics

Moving essential cargo for energy, infrastructure, mining, public safety, defense and beyond.

## Urban Cargo Delivery

Expanding into controlled urban logistics for commercial applications.

## Delivery Drones

## Condor XL

A powerful cargo drone, engineered for long-range , heavy-payload deliveries in the world’s most
challenging environments. Designed with industry and government in mind, the Condor XL opens up a
new frontier for drone logistics.

Key Features
* Two-stroke, gasoline powered helicopter drone
* Designed for long-range deliveries (upto 200km) and heavier payloads (upto 180kg).
* Multi-package payload compartment

Whether it’s delivering critical supplies to remote communities, supporting industrial operations or
responding to emergencies, the Condor XL is purpose-built for missions where conventional logistics
fall short.

## Canary

The drone offers a 20 km (12 miles) range and a payload capacity of 4.5 kg (10 lbs.), making it
suitable for a variety of uses including the delivery of parcels, medical tests, medicine, emergency
kits, small parts, and mail. It features an integrated weight scale for accurate payload
measurements and a touchless cargo drop feature for efficient deliveries. Additionally, the drone is
equipped with new safety technology, including an aircraft parachute deployment system. It is also
approved for flight over people, ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

## Aero II - Defour Aerospace

This tilt-wing drone takes-off and lands like a helicopter, but flies as fast and energy efficient
as an airplane. Designed it for a maximum of flexibility, highest safety standards and low operation
cost.

Payload: Internal payload, front loaded, slide-in External payload, 40kg max.

## PRISM - DroneUp

The DroneUp Aircraft is a high-performance delivery drone with a 55 lb MTOW and 40-minute endurance,
featuring advanced AI-driven navigation, obstacle detection, and precision landing. Its integrated
winch system enables 100-foot line delivery with secure Smart Hook v3.4 and Flight Lock technology
for automated loading and release. Powered by a redundant 12S system and dual F9P GPS units, it
ensures reliable, autonomous operations. Designed for seamless logistics, it’s built to integrate
into scalable drone delivery networks.

## Infrastructure & Software

FLYTE Remote Operations Control Center (OCC) DBX DroneSpot™

Volatus Aerospace Inc.’s FLYTE software is a comprehensive solution for managing autonomous drone
operations, particularly in drone logistics and delivery. FLYTE is a complete solution for
autonomous drone operations that integrates with existing logistics, supply chain, and enterprise
systems. It includes features like automated flight management for multiple drones, maintenance
tracking, real-time tracking and telemetry, and geofencing for safe navigation, and emergency
landing procedures, as well as robust reporting and analytics tools and more.

The Operations Control Center (OCC) is a cutting-edge, controlled access facility capable of
accommodating up to 20 operators simultaneously and is capable of 4+ hours of off-grid
functionality. To date, the OCC has conducted more than 10,000 commercial flights, travelling a
distance of more than 20,000 km, with operations as far as 3,600 km away from the OCC. Staffed by
highly qualified operators, weekly operations out of the OCC include flights at Edmonton
International Airport and Halton Healthcare delivering laboratory specimens and medical supplies ,
including the delivery of dangerous goods.
* **Integrated Mission Control Center:** Centralized operational coordination supporting real-time
mission monitoring, fleet visibility, communication workflows, and scalable aerial logistics
management.
* **Real-Time Fleet Coordination:** Continuous monitoring and coordination of aerial assets, payload
movement, and mission execution.
* **Live Operational Visibility: **Integrated telemetry, mission tracking, and communication systems
supporting operational awareness.
* **Scalable Logistics Management: **Support for multi-platform deployments, distributed operations,
and time-sensitive delivery workflows.

DBX, enables autonomous pickup of packages from retailers, QSR, and other origination points. DBX
provides climate-controlled package management and storage with a footprint smaller than a parking
space.

DBX can also be deployed as a delivery destination in urban areas, unlocking drone delivery in
hard-to-deliver areas like apartments and multi-dwelling communities. As a secure locker, DBX
addresses the widespread issue of “porch piracy,” keeping packages safe and secure.

DroneSpot™ is a proprietary infrastructure solution developed by Volatus Aerospace to facilitate the
safe and efficient operation of drone deliveries. Serving as a designated secure takeoff and landing
area for drones.

Features: Air traffic monitoring, localized weather station, intelligent monitoring system and other
critical data to ensure safe and efficient drone operations.

## Safety & Compliance

### Operations Planning

We work with you to determine the best technologies for your unique delivery need. We develop a
complete ground-air risk / mitigation assessment of the operation. Formulate a “Concept of
Operations,” which outlines the full scope of the delivery service including a full analysis of the
airspace. Obtain requisite approvals through regulatory and government agencies.

### Training & Education

Pilots are trained to the highest standards, adhering to regulatory requirements, internal policies,
customer requirements, and manufacturer recommendations. Our pilots undergo continuous education and
advanced training programs that meet or exceed industry and regulatory requirements, ensuring they
remain at the forefront of safety, compliance, and operational excellence.

## Safety Management
* **Transparent Reporting**: We maintain an open safety record, transparently documenting all
incidents, resolutions, and internal Safety Management System (SMS) analyses to drive continuous
improvement. By proactively addressing risks and implementing enhancements, we ensure compliance
and report incidents to the appropriate aviation authorities.
* **Rigorous Testing:** Every drone in our fleet is rigorously tested for performance and
reliability before deployment, undergoing thorough evaluation and vetting by Volatus to ensure the
highest operational standards.
* **Regular Maintenance:** We implement strict maintenance and preventative maintenance schedules in
full compliance with regulatory and manufacturer requirements, ensuring all equipment remains in
optimal condition while minimizing potential operational risks.
* **Advanced Navigation Systems:** Our drones are equipped with state-of-the-art navigation systems
such as real-time traffic management and obstacle avoidance technologies, ensuring safe operations
in complex urban and rural environments.

## Agriculture & Environmental Monitoring

Smart and Intelligent Monitoring Across Land, Forest & Agriculture

[ Talk To An Expert ][38]

## Precision Monitoring for Agricultural & Environmental Applications

Environmental monitoring, forestry operations, and modern agriculture increasingly rely on accurate
geospatial intelligence, scalable monitoring capabilities, and data-driven decision-making. Our
aerial operations support environmental agencies, forestry organizations, agricultural operators,
and land management teams with advanced remote sensing, aerial analytics, and operational monitoring
solutions.

Using remotely piloted and crewed aerial platforms equipped with multispectral sensors, LiDAR
systems, thermal imaging, and geospatial processing workflows, we deliver high-quality environmental
and vegetation intelligence across diverse operational environments.

## Crop Health Monitoring

Aerial assessment of crop conditions, vegetation stress, growth variability, and agricultural field
performance.

## Multispectral Vegetation Analysis

Spectral analysis supporting vegetation classification, plant health assessment, and agricultural
intelligence workflows.

## Wildfire Risk Assessment

Monitoring vegetation conditions, thermal anomalies, and environmental indicators supporting
wildfire preparedness and risk analysis.

## Forest Health Monitoring

Large-area aerial monitoring of canopy conditions, vegetation density, disease impact, and forestry
operations.

## Irrigation Analysis

Assessment of irrigation efficiency, water distribution patterns, and crop moisture variability.

## Deforestation Monitoring

Monitoring land-use changes, vegetation loss, and forestry activity across large geographic regions.

## Environmental Impact Assessment

Geospatial monitoring and aerial analysis supporting environmental compliance, site assessment, and
ecological studies.

## Biodiversity & Habitat Monitoring

Aerial observation and mapping supporting ecosystem analysis, habitat assessment, and conservation
operations.

## Technology Stack & Capabilities

Integrated aerial sensing systems and geospatial workflows supporting large-scale environmental and
vegetation intelligence operations.

### Multispectral Imaging

Spectral sensing capabilities supporting vegetation analysis, crop assessment, and land
classification workflows.

### LiDAR Systems

High-accuracy terrain and canopy mapping supporting forestry analysis and environmental modelling.

### Thermal Imaging Systems

Thermal sensing for vegetation stress detection, wildfire monitoring, and environmental assessment.

### Geospatial Intelligence Workflows

Spatial data processing and environmental analytics supporting mapping and monitoring operations.

### AI-Based Analytics

Automated analysis supporting vegetation classification, anomaly detection, and large-scale
environmental monitoring.

### RTK / PPK Positioning

High-accuracy positioning systems supporting survey-grade environmental and agricultural data
acquisition.

### Integrated Air Operations

Combined crewed and remotely piloted aerial operations supporting scalable environmental monitoring
missions.

### Digital Terrain & Surface Modelling

Generation of terrain, canopy, and environmental surface models supporting analysis and planning
workflows.

## Enhance Environmental & Vegetation Monitoring Operations

Leverage advanced aerial sensing, geospatial intelligence, and scalable monitoring capabilities for
environmental, forestry, and agricultural operations.

Advanced aerial monitoring and remote sensing technologies enable faster environmental assessment,

# Pioneering the
# Future of Aviation

Volatus Aerospace is shaping the global landscape of uncrewed flight through precision engineering,
uncompromising safety, and a legacy of aeronautical excellence.

## Built on Experience.
## Driven by the Future.

## Aviation Expertise & Operational Excellence

With deep roots in traditional aviation, Volatus Aerospace brings decades of operational, safety,
and regulatory expertise into the evolving uncrewed systems industry, building reliable solutions
trusted by commercial and defence partners worldwide.

## Bridging Innovation to Commercialization

Our Center of Excellence transforms emerging technologies into practical aviation solutions,
supporting the transition between crewed and uncrewed systems while enabling scalable innovation for
commercial and defence applications worldwide.

## Our Mission

**To deliver advanced aerial solutions through innovation, operational excellence, and a relentless
commitment to our stakeholders.**

## Our Vision

**To shape the future of intelligent aerial innovation worldwide.**

## A MESSAGE FROM OUR CEO

“We have built a team that is constantly pushing the boundaries of UAV technology, Counter-UAS
systems, defence innovation, and advanced aerospace solutions powered by AI intelligence and
advanced analytics. Our work spans inspection, imaging, data capture, autonomous aerial systems,
R&D, production, pilot training, and operational consultancy across multiple industries, delivering
meaningful outcomes for our clients. At the core of our success are our people, and the
relationships they build with clients, regulators, partners, and investors that continue to drive
our growth and impact. We remain committed to exceeding expectations while fostering an inclusive,
collaborative, and supportive culture that embraces the strength of diverse perspectives.”

## Glen Lynch

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

## Our Values

## Where purpose, people, and performance align.

### INTEGRITY

We act with the highest ethical standards, ensuring transparency and honesty in everything we do.

### SAFETY

We prioritize safety above all, ensuring our products, services, and operations meet the most
rigorous standards.

### CUSTOMER FOCUS

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, and we are committed to delivering solutions
that create real value.

### EXCELLENCE

We strive for excellence in every aspect of our work, continuously improving to deliver the highest
quality outcomes.

### TEAMWORK

We believe in the power of collaboration, working closely with stakeholders to achieve shared goals
and lasting success.

### SUSTAINABILITY

We are committed to responsible practices that reduce environmental impact and support a better
future.

## SAFETY CULTURE

Our Safety Management System (SMS) is the heartbeat of our operations. It is a structured approach
that integrates organizational structures, accountabilities, policies, and procedures.

### 01. SYSTEMATIC RISK MANAGEMENT

A structured approach to identifying, assessing, and mitigating safety risks across all operations.

### 02. REGULATORY READINESS

Aligned with global safety standards and prepared for integration into modern air traffic systems.

### 03. DEPLOYMENT-READY OPERATIONS

Proven cargo solutions designed for safe BVLOS operations in remote and controlled environments.

## Meet Our Executive Team

## Glen Lynch

## Chief Executive Officer

Glen has a proven executive management track record and experience driving growth in the aerospace
industry. He has over thirty years of experience in operational aviation, with seven years of
aerospace manufacturing.

He has exceptional skills in assessing an organization or facility’s challenges and partnering with
leadership to create profitable solutions quickly and cost-effectively.

## Luc Massé

## Executive Vice President

Luc is a deeply respected aviation strategic leader. His abilities contribute to the continuous
growth and profitability of the companies he leads.

Four decades of experience in aviation, a quarter of a century in contract negotiation, management,
aircraft sales and strategic planning in addition to his degrees in marketing and law, make Luc an
exceptional Executive Vice President.

## Abhinav Singhvi

## Chief Financial Officer

Abhi is responsible for the operational and financial strategy, assessment of organic and
acquisition expansion opportunities, governance and risk management. He has been instrumental in the
company’s growth initiatives.

He is a respected finance and investment professional with over a decade of experience in tech
startups, venture capital and Fortune 500 companies. He holds an MBA from Schulich School of
Business in Toronto and is a Chartered Accountant.

## Rob Walker

## Chief Commercial Officer

Rob is a deeply respected executive manager and business development professional. He is known for
his “out-of-the-box” thinking which lends itself well to problem solving and idea generation. A
proven negotiator with strong relationship-building and partnering skills on an international basis.

Over two decades of experience in business development, marketing, communications & promotions in
uncrewed aircraft, aerospace, infrastructure, advertising & economic development industries.

## Greg Colacitti

## Chief Operations Officer

Greg is a dynamic leader with over 15 years of entrepreneurial experience, having played a pivotal
role in building and expanding manufacturing companies across both Canada and the United States.

His expertise spans across business development, operations, and executive leadership. Greg has been
recognized for his keen ability to identify emerging trends and for his strategic insight into
leveraging technology to maximize operational efficiency, driving growth and innovation.

# **Infrastructure ** for
# Advanced Air Mobility

Skyports designs, builds, owns, and operates networks of vertiports, enabling safe and efficient
urban air transport in major markets around the globe

## What We Do

Aviation is on the verge of a transformation. The advent of electric vertical take off and landing
aircraft opens the potential of urban air transport. Vertiports are the dedicated ground
infrastructure that help realize this future. Skyports is the world’s leading vertiport provider and
operator.

Site Selection
Designing, Permitting, & Construction
Operations
Technology

Skyports works with aircraft operators, asset owners, and local stakeholders to establish a
transportation network optimized for efficiency and convenience. Our approach considers the needs of
the customer and the community, enabling us to identify the best vertiport sites.

Skyports uses its airport planning, airspace, regulatory, and operations expertise to design and
build vertiports which capture industry best practices and aircraft performance requirements.
Working with authorities and communities, we obtain necessary permits and permissions before
deploying each vertiport.

Skyports implements the processes and procedures that allow vertiports to function safely and
efficiently. We process passengers and cargo through the terminal, support aircraft on the ground,
and ensure a safe operating environment for landing and take off.

At the core of Skyports’ product is a technology solution that enables safe and efficient
operations. This includes landside terminal management, airside resource management, operational
status supervision, and data integrations across stakeholders.

Japan Best of Japan Drone Award 2018 - Best Venture CEATEC Award 2018 - Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry Award Best of Japan Drone Award 2018 “Best Venture” Best Drone related technology “Nanshan “Entrepreneurship Star” Contest 2018 Shibuya Championship ICC Summit KYOTO 2018 “Real Tech Catapult” Championship TECH PLANTER “Deep Tech Grand Prix” Mitsui Chemicals Award B Dash Camp Fall 2018 in Fukuoka “Pitch Arena” Championship, PERSOL Award CEATEC Award 2018 “Minister of Economy, Trade and Industry Award “Nanshan “Entrepreneurship Star” Contest 2018” 3rd Place, IP Award TechCrunch Tokyo 2018 Startup Battle, 3rd Place 4D GRAVITY® SkyHub® Drone Technology Logistics Technology Intellectual Property Development Strong patent portfolio Innovative drone technology Partnerships with government and municipalities Strong partnerships with logistics companies Expertise in drone operations 6th Floor Ishi Bldg. 2-3-5 Ebisu-Nishi, Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, 150-0021 Japan 2299-1 Funato, Koshigaya-shi, Saitama 343-0003, Japan 4838 Kosuge, Kitatsuru District, Yamanashi 409-0211 Japan Japan Japan Aeronext is focused on building a new societal infrastructure through drone technology. The company has developed a strong patent portfolio for its 4D GRAVITY® technology. Aeronext aims to address societal issues through drone-based logistics. Aeronext founded NEXT DELIVERY in 2021 to specialize in drone logistics. The company has conducted successful drone delivery operations in various regions. Aeronext established in April 2017. NEXT DELIVERY established as a subsidiary in January 2021. Received Japan’s first ever flight approval for Level 3.5 in December 2023. Expanding drone delivery services in Japan. Developing partnerships with local governments and logistics providers. Expanding drone logistics services in Japan. Developing partnerships with local governments and businesses. Regulatory hurdles in drone operations. Competition in the drone technology market. Competition in the logistics sector. Growing demand for drone logistics solutions due to population decline and aging. Potential for international expansion of drone services. Growing demand for drone delivery services. Potential for international expansion. Aeronext is positioned as a leader in the drone logistics market in Japan, with innovative technology and strong partnerships. Increasing adoption of drone technology in logistics and delivery services. Expansion of services to underserved areas. Increasing adoption of drone technology in logistics. Partnerships with major logistics companies. AERONEXT | Aeronext-NEXT DELIVERY｜Drone Technology・SkyHub®

# About Us

Mission

Vision

### New economization of airspace.

Humanity has developed to this point by building civilization through the development of
infrastructures such as electricity, water, gas, roads, and the Internet for society. Today's
industry and our lives are built on these infrastructures.

So what is the next societal infrastructure to be developed? We believe the answer is the sky; the
development of an economic zone in a three-dimensional space from the ground to a height of 150
meters, where only birds fly freely. The main player in that space will be drones.

The most important issue in this pursuit is to ensure safety, making it possible for people to go
about their daily lives without worrying about the drones flying overhead.

With a declining population, achieving a level of performace where drones can fill in the void of
services left by declining populations.

Aeronext is a technology startup that exists to build a new societal infrastructure for the 100-year
life era and to create a world in which everyone can enjoy continued prosperity.

Core Values
* ### Be intentional and
### logically purposeful.

Why are we doing it?
What are we doing it for?
Is this the best way?
To start something, think it through to the point where the result will always be the same
regardless of who does it
* ### Say thank you in a loud voice and
### report bad news even louder.

If you want to accomplish great things, there is little you can do alone. A person who has no
respect for the work of his fellow workers cannot do a good job. The qualities needed by those who
want to do good work are honesty, integrity, and fairness.
* ### Drive the future with passion.

The basic premise of any successful business is that there is a demand or market. But that is not
enough. Only those who act proactively and deliberately, involve others, and accomplish what they
set out to do will have a future. The root of it all is passion.

## Partners

Aeronext actively collaborates with both domestic and overseas partners who share Aeronext’s vision
and offer synergies through complementing respective areas of expertise to promote market creation
and provide value.

* CEO's Message

Aeronext envisions a future in which the sky will become a large-scale economic zone and social
infrastructure as is the ground. Drones will flying in the skies will be commonplace, indispensable
in people’s lives, and indispensable in solving societal issues. Aeronext believes that this future
market will be comparable to the huge ecosystem created by the advent of the automobile.

Aeronext was founded in 2017, when hovering aircraft and flying cameras were still the most common
type of aircraft. 4D GRAVITY® is a revolutionary technology that improves the basic performance of
industrial drones, in areas such as stability, efficiency, and maneuverability, by optimizing the
center of gravity. This breakthrough improvement helps solve the various challenges that drones have
faced.

We have built a robust patent portfolio to make 4D GRAVITY®︎ the standard on industrial drones and
are developing a global partnership economy based on the 4D GRAVITY®︎ license.In addition, as the
drone market grows rapidly, the industrial segment with the greatest potential is in the area of
logistics and transportation. Aeronext endeavors to create and develop this market. To that end,
Aeronext founded NEXT DELIVERY, Inc. in 2021. Drones are an innovative technology that will enable
the Physical Internet and transform the value of people’s time. Aeronext is committed to continue
research and development of this innovative technology.

Powered by our proprietary technologies, intellectual property strategies, and market creation
capabilities, Aeronext will do its utmost to create a world in which the sky becomes an economy and
drones become a new societal infrastructure, in cooperation with partners who share our vision, and
who share our strong beliefs and enthusiasm.

We hope you will join Aeronext in creating an exciting world for the future of the skies.

Keisuke Toji, CEO

# The Future of Drone Delivery

**Drones Are the
“New Societal Infrastructure.”**

llustrated by kanoko.mori

The Aeronext Group views drone delivery from the broad perspective of “building a new societal
infrastructure” from the logistics point of view. We are already beyond demonstration testing and
focusing on practical application and actual implementation in society. As the birthrate declines
and the population ages, our drones will reach out not only to those who are vulnerable with regard
to logistics, but also to those who are vulnerable with regard to access to shopping, medical care,
and even disasters. The Aeronext Group is already providing services to residents in multiple areas,
and will continue to expand our coverage to more areas to maintain the convenience of daily life for
residents, and in the event of an emergency, contribute by rapidly delivering supplies and medicines
to areas that are difficult to access.

**Opening the Door to Next-Generation
Logistics: New Smart Logistics SkyHub®**

New Smart Logistics SkyHub® is an initiative to rebuild sustainable regional logistics
infrastructure through an optimal mix of land and air transportation. The Aeronext Group is working
with our partners to help to reduce the environmental burden and improve the sustainability of
communities across Japan while confronting the challenges facing the logistics industry, such as the
logistics 2024 problem, driver shortages, and rising logistics costs.

**Contributions to Disaster Relief Activities**
**and Phase-free Initiatives**

Especially in times of disaster, the Aeronext Group’s drones can be a means of quickly delivering
relief supplies to isolated areas and evacuation centers, saving many lives. For example, during the
Noto Peninsula earthquake, drones provided direct and rapid assistance to residents in evacuation
centers and isolated areas through the delivery of medical supplies. Through this activity, the
usefulness and speed of drone delivery was reaffirmed. Moreover, it has been repeatedly demonstrated
that the implementation of new smart logistics can be a “phase-free disaster logistics
countermeasure,” in which a system is prepared in advance during normal times in preparation for
contingencies.

**Flight Level 3.5 and Multiple Aircraft Operation: Increasing Possibilities for the
Commercialization of Drone Delivery**

The Aeronext Group was the first in Japan to receive approval and conduct the first flight under the
newly established “Level 3.5”. Since then, the Aeronext Group has conducted “Level 3.5” flights in
areas throughout Japan, and are advancing the commercialization of drone deliveries. The
introduction of Level 3.5, which relaxes or eliminates some of the Level 3 regulations with
conditions, will make practical operations realistic, especially in underpopulated areas, and allow
more regions to enjoy the benefits of drone delivery in the future. The Aeronext Group has also been
a pioneer in the development of remote operation and monitoring systems, and has already begun
testing a system that allows a single remote pilot to operate and monitor multiple aircraft
(multi-aircraft operation). The Aeronext Group has a leading track record in drone delivery and
Level 3.5 flight operations, and is constantly advancing its record.

**Journey to a Sustainable Future:
From Underpopulated to Urban Areas **

Currently, in order to build a more prosperous and sustainable society through drones, the Aeronext
Group is steadily advancing the societal implementation of drone delivery in depopulated areas
through the New Smart Logistics initiative. Once we have demonstrated and confirmed what essential
needs can be solved only with drones, we believe that drone delivery in urban areas will also become
a reality. The Aeronext Group is committed to creating a future where drones are part of everyday
life and everyone can enjoy the benefits of drones. The Aeronext Group will continue to drive the
development of sustainable technologies and their implementation in society in order to realize a
new economy in airspace.

## Advanced drone operation by nationally certified personnel

NEXT DELIVERY’s operations team is led by its Chief Operations Officer, the first to obtain Japan’s
national First Class Unmanned Aircraft Pilot Certification and is comprised of professionals with
First Class and Second Class First Class Unmanned Aircraft Pilot Certification, who are involved in
daily operations of new smart logistics systems throughout Japan. NEXT DELIVERY’s operations team is
involved in drone operations in areas where the SkyHub® is implemented, improving their skills and
know-how. NEXT DELIVERY also has an extensive internal human resource development and personnel
training program that fosters the next generation of professionals, including remote pilots. In
collaboration with local human resources, NEXT DELIVERY is conducting demonstration tests for local
governments to implement the new smart logistics system SkyHub®, providing drone operation services
tailored to the business needs of operators, and expanding the scope of our activities during
disasters, not only in Japan but also in other countries, as well. In December 2023, NEXT DELIVERY
received Japan’s first ever flight approval for the newly established “Flight Level 3.5” and
conducted Japan’s first “Level 3.5” flight in Kamishihoro Town, Hokkaido. Since that flight, NEXT
DELIVERY has routinely conducted Level 3.5 flights in numerous locations throughout Japan.

## About BRINC

Founded in response to the tragic 2017 Las Vegas Shooting, BRINC is committed to deploying drones
and other technologies that benefit the community and help save lives.

[ Our Values & Ethics ][51]
Never build technologies designed to hurt or kill
Be open, transparent and honest
Move carefully and with purpose
Do the hard stuff
Build technologies designed to save lives
Listen to our customers and communities
Be mindful of the implications of our work – we won’t build a dystopia
[Blake Resnick][Blake Resnick]

Fotokite Sigma

Fotokite Sigma provides public safety teams with mission-critical situational awareness from elevated perspectives. Fotokite’s actively tethered drones conserve personnel by launching, flying, and landing with the single push of a button; no piloting required.

Fotokite Sigma is authorized and recognized by aviation authorities as a safer alternative to non-actively tethered drones and free-flying public safety drone systems.

Safe & Reliable in Any Weather

Reliability is a cornerstone of Fotokite’s technology. While normal public safety drone operations are severely limited in inclement weather conditions, Fotokite’s actively tethered UAS are regularly deployed in rain, snow and windy conditions.

# About Fotokite

Our Vision
To provide Public Safety teams with accessible and reliable situational awareness tools to help them
stay safe, save lives, and preserve property. Every day.
Our Culture
Humble. High Performance. High Impact.

We are motivated every day by the life-saving impact our customers make and we work tirelessly to
create and provide the best possible tools to enable public safety teams with situational awareness
that they can access on a daily basis.

We embrace humility as the key ingredient needed to make our international team culture work at full
speed. Our company culture emphasizes a strong collaborative workspace, promotes teamwork, and
encourages each team member to realize individual growth while meeting a strong impact-oriented
shared mission.

Engineering

meets design. Fotokite develops purpose-driven solutions from the ground up, with nearly all of our
system components designed in-house to meet our customer needs.

Our Values

Fotokite designs and deploys advanced situational awareness technology to support public safety
professionals in the protection of and in service to communities across the globe. Headquartered in
Switzerland, Fotokite provides an accessible and accountable system to capture aerial perspectives
that serve the public through our customers, from firefighting to emergency management and police.
All members of the company are driven to develop solutions based on the understanding that the
public good is always the primary consideration, guided by the following principles:

* We commit to applying our technology, skills, and partnerships for the benefit of society, its
members, and the surrounding environment.
* We commit to enabling overt, accountable use cases of Fotokite technology, specifically in support
of public interest organizations and the people they serve.
* We commit to seek out and collaborate exclusively with partners that prioritize public safety
while respecting individual privacy and upholding operational accountability.
* We proactively avoid working with departments and agencies with a continued track record of abuse
of power.

Where we came from
ETH-Zurich Spin-off company with offices in Zurich, Syracuse, and Boulder. Backed by Credit Suisse
Entrepreneur Capital, Sony Innovation Fund, 360 Capital Partners, and Qualcomm Ventures.
2021

Fotokite wins prestigious design awards including the IF Gold Design Award 2021 and 2021 Swiss
Design Prize, which reflect the practicability and usability of the Fotokite Sigma.

2020

Fotokite launches the industry-standard Sigma Rooftop product configuration. Manufacturing ramp-up
continues with Fotokite’s expanded manufacturing facilities based in the USA.

2019

Successful firefighting customer trials lead up to Fotokite’s first public safety product launched
into the USA Fire & Rescue market alongside Pierce Manufacturing Inc., the world’s largest fire
apparatus manufacturer.

2018

Fotokite wins 1st prize at GENIUS NY, the world’s largest UAS accelerator program. Fotokite
technology becomes accessible to every US public safety team to use without pilot certification
based on a combination of the FAA’s Reauthorization Bill and Fotokite’s actively tethered UAS
approach as a fully pilot-free system.

2016

Fotokite begins dedicated work on industrial grade systems, then further refines company focus
towards public safety solutions, leveraging previous generations of Fotokite product and production
experience.

2014

Perspective Robotics is founded as a newly created ETH Zurich Spin-off and receives the first ever
NCCR Spin Fund Grant. Fotokite featured on the TED stage.

2011 - 2013

Tethered localization & interaction “Fotokite” concept born at the ETH Zurich Flying Machine Arena
as part of Sergei Lupashin’s PhD work. First tethered prototypes flown. Initial concept focused on
news & broadcast applications and tested with customers including the BBC.
