# About Us

## We're a global community leveraging drone technology to transform health logistics.

Established in 2016, the UAV for Payload Delivery Working Group (UPDWG) is a vibrant community
founded and coordinated by [VillageReach][21]. The UPDWG community is made up of a diverse set of
members coming from drone companies, healthcare organizations, research institutions, and government
agencies among others.

Our members are united by a shared passion for collective progress, collaboration, and partnership.
Members gain access to valuable information, experiences, and resources, enabling them to push the
boundaries of drone logistics in health systems and beyond.

Learn more about [our members][22] and [join us][23] to be a part of the global movement driving the
transformative potential of drone logistics.

Emmanuel and Fabrice unpack vaccines from the delivery.

## Stay Informed

Stay up-to-date with the latest industry updates, research, and upcoming events with our monthly
newsletter.

# About Us

## We're a global community leveraging drone technology to transform health logistics.

Established in 2016, the UAV for Payload Delivery Working Group (UPDWG) is a vibrant community
founded and coordinated by [VillageReach][21]. The UPDWG community is made up of a diverse set of
members coming from drone companies, healthcare organizations, research institutions, and government
agencies among others.

Our members are united by a shared passion for collective progress, collaboration, and partnership.
Members gain access to valuable information, experiences, and resources, enabling them to push the
boundaries of drone logistics in health systems and beyond.

Learn more about [our members][22] and [join us][23] to be a part of the global movement driving the
transformative potential of drone logistics.

Our Team
* ## Colette Eddy – President & Lead Visionary

Colette is the driving force behind Aerial Innovations, Inc., combining decades of aerial
photography expertise with global perspective. With over a million captures to her name and
experience in 88 countries, she brings unmatched precision, creativity, and leadership to every
project. Her work reflects a bold, boundary-pushing vision—delivering images that are as impactful
as they are unforgettable.

📩 [colette@aerialinnovations.com][26]
* ## Jenny Smith – Vice President, Sales

With 25+ years of experience in aerial photography sales, Jenny is known for her precision,
reliability, and commitment to client success. She consistently delivers high-quality results on
time, every time. A former pro water skier and now an avid snowboarder, Jenny brings the same
energy and discipline to every project—and still holds the title of coolest grandparent around.

📩 [jenny@aerialinnovations.com][27]
* ## Julie Palermo – Vice President & Senior Photographer

With over 30 years of experience, Julie is a precision-driven photographer known for her sharp eye
and unmatched work ethic. Whether capturing complex aerial shots or exploring remote locations,
she approaches every project with technical skill, creativity, and energy. Focused, curious, and
quietly fearless—Julie makes every frame and every moment count.

📩 [julie@aerialinnovations.com][28]
* ## Andres Ramirez – Photographer & Visual Artist

Andres brings a fine art perspective and technical precision to every project. With an MFA in
Photography from the University of South Florida and experience as an adjunct instructor, he
enhances Aerial Innovations with a fresh, detail-oriented approach grounded in both creativity and
craft.

📩 andres@aerialinnovations.com
* ## Ian Foe – Production Manager, Photographer & Videographer

A creative force behind the lens and in the edit suite, Ian brings a strong background in
documentary media and advertising from Flagler College. As Production Manager, he keeps Aerial
Innovations running efficiently with technical skill and artistic vision. Outside the studio, Ian
contributes to Tampa Bay’s art scene through museum installations and professional art handling
across Florida.

📩 ian@aerialinnovations.com
* ## Trinity Oribio – Photographer & Visual Artist

Trinity holds an MFA from the University of South Florida and continues to exhibit her artwork
across the southern U.S. Since joining Aerial Innovations, she has developed a deep appreciation
for Florida’s diverse landscapes, providing exceptional aerial images tailored to each client’s
needs.

📩 trinity@aerialinnovations.com
* ## Jay Host – Sales

A Kentucky native, Jay brings a down-to-earth approach to sales at Aerial Innovations. With a
friendly, no-nonsense attitude, he's dedicated to helping clients with their aerial imaging needs.

📩 jay@aerialinnovations.com
* ## Dali Bergen – Accounting

Formerly the Ambassador of Happiness at Aerial Innovations, Dali now leads our Accounting
department. Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with her family, watching movies, dancing,
and reading.

📩 accounting@aerialinnovations.com
* ## Maryia Fennell – Executive Assistant & Accounts Receivable

A Tampa native with a global perspective, Maryia brings her attention to detail and organizational
skills to Aerial Innovations. With a background in Psychology and a passion for learning, she’s an
integral part of the team and a coffee lover.

📩 [admin@aerialinnovations.com][29]

Our Team
* ## Colette Eddy – President & Lead Visionary

Colette is the driving force behind Aerial Innovations, Inc., combining decades of aerial
photography expertise with global perspective. With over a million captures to her name and
experience in 88 countries, she brings unmatched precision, creativity, and leadership to every
project. Her work reflects a bold, boundary-pushing vision—delivering images that are as impactful
as they are unforgettable.

📩 [colette@aerialinnovations.com][26]
* ## Jenny Smith – Vice President, Sales

With 25+ years of experience in aerial photography sales, Jenny is known for her precision,
reliability, and commitment to client success. She consistently delivers high-quality results on
time, every time. A former pro water skier and now an avid snowboarder, Jenny brings the same
energy and discipline to every project—and still holds the title of coolest grandparent around.

📩 [jenny@aerialinnovations.com][27]
* ## Julie Palermo – Vice President & Senior Photographer

With over 30 years of experience, Julie is a precision-driven photographer known for her sharp eye
and unmatched work ethic. Whether capturing complex aerial shots or exploring remote locations,
she approaches every project with technical skill, creativity, and energy. Focused, curious, and
quietly fearless—Julie makes every frame and every moment count.

📩 [julie@aerialinnovations.com][28]
* ## Andres Ramirez – Photographer & Visual Artist

Andres brings a fine art perspective and technical precision to every project. With an MFA in
Photography from the University of South Florida and experience as an adjunct instructor, he
enhances Aerial Innovations with a fresh, detail-oriented approach grounded in both creativity and
craft.

📩 andres@aerialinnovations.com
* ## Ian Foe – Production Manager, Photographer & Videographer

A creative force behind the lens and in the edit suite, Ian brings a strong background in
documentary media and advertising from Flagler College. As Production Manager, he keeps Aerial
Innovations running efficiently with technical skill and artistic vision. Outside the studio, Ian
contributes to Tampa Bay’s art scene through museum installations and professional art handling
across Florida.

📩 ian@aerialinnovations.com
* ## Trinity Oribio – Photographer & Visual Artist

Trinity holds an MFA from the University of South Florida and continues to exhibit her artwork
across the southern U.S. Since joining Aerial Innovations, she has developed a deep appreciation
for Florida’s diverse landscapes, providing exceptional aerial images tailored to each client’s
needs.

📩 trinity@aerialinnovations.com
* ## Jay Host – Sales

A Kentucky native, Jay brings a down-to-earth approach to sales at Aerial Innovations. With a
friendly, no-nonsense attitude, he's dedicated to helping clients with their aerial imaging needs.

📩 jay@aerialinnovations.com
* ## Dali Bergen – Accounting

Formerly the Ambassador of Happiness at Aerial Innovations, Dali now leads our Accounting
department. Outside of work, she enjoys spending time with her family, watching movies, dancing,
and reading.

📩 accounting@aerialinnovations.com
* ## Maryia Fennell – Executive Assistant & Accounts Receivable

A Tampa native with a global perspective, Maryia brings her attention to detail and organizational
skills to Aerial Innovations. With a background in Psychology and a passion for learning, she’s an
integral part of the team and a coffee lover.

📩 [admin@aerialinnovations.com][29]

Their versatile multi-role drone platform is engineered for long-range, same-day delivery, safety and security, and special missions, catering to diverse markets with a focus on innovative logistics solutions. Committed to excellence, Dronamics proudly manufactures its products in Europe, ensuring market-leading endurance, range, and payload capabilities.

all_classified.company_summary: DroneUp is a technology company that specializes in airspace management and UAS operations, offering integrated solutions designed for both authorities and operators. Its core products include UAS Operator Solutions, which provide autonomous platforms for UAS operations, and Airspace Sovereignty, which ensures regulatory oversight and operational excellence in airspace management. Targeting industries such as government, public safety, and logistics, DroneUp is committed to transforming airspace operations through comprehensive frameworks.

# Who is

# DroneUp?

### We are a technology company that is built on years of complex airspace management and UAS
### operations experience.

### We understand what it takes to create coordinated, safe, scalable autonomous airspace.

### Our Approach

Where others see complexity, we build clarity. Our dual-channel solutions serve both authorities
(ATOMx for airspace sovereignty) and operators (Uncrew for UAS operations), working independently or
together as a complete ecosystem.

### Our Foundation

Veterans from military, law enforcement, special operations and airspace policy bring real-world
expertise to every solution. We don't build theoretical technology, we create tools that work in
actual operational environments.

### Our Purpose

We exist to bridge this critical gap by uniting regulatory oversight with operational excellence.
Authorities need awareness, control, and threat mitigation. Operators need autonomous platforms
without vendor lock-in. Both need seamless coordination.

### Our Commitment

To revolutionize airspace sovereignty and advance UAS operations solutions without vendor lock-in,
creating autonomous airspace infrastructure that makes operations practical, scalable, and safe for
everyone.

# Our History
* ## Tom Walker

Founder & CEO

Former Navy officer, nuclear engineer, and Special Operations leader advancing low-altitude
airspace modernization. A trusted advisor to Congress and senior federal officials on autonomy,
national security, and aviation, he is widely recognized as an industry authority. His expertise
has been sought on White House panels, and he has testified before the Homeland Security
Subcommittee on emerging drone threats.
* ## John Vernon

Co-founder & CTO

A seasoned technologist and product leader, John advances autonomy-first platforms for unmanned
aircraft, driving secure flight authorization, dynamic restrictions, and Remote ID. With a
background in networking and product engineering, he has built high-performing teams delivering
standards-based systems that strengthen airspace security and protect critical infrastructure. He
also served on the FAA rulemaking committee for beyond visual line of sight operations.

# Who is

# DroneUp?

### We are a technology company that is built on years of complex airspace management and UAS
### operations experience.

### We understand what it takes to create coordinated, safe, scalable autonomous airspace.

### Our Approach

Where others see complexity, we build clarity. Our dual-channel solutions serve both authorities
(ATOMx for airspace sovereignty) and operators (Uncrew for UAS operations), working independently or
together as a complete ecosystem.

### Our Foundation

Veterans from military, law enforcement, special operations and airspace policy bring real-world
expertise to every solution. We don't build theoretical technology, we create tools that work in
actual operational environments.

### Our Purpose

We exist to bridge this critical gap by uniting regulatory oversight with operational excellence.
Authorities need awareness, control, and threat mitigation. Operators need autonomous platforms
without vendor lock-in. Both need seamless coordination.

### Our Commitment

To revolutionize airspace sovereignty and advance UAS operations solutions without vendor lock-in,
creating autonomous airspace infrastructure that makes operations practical, scalable, and safe for
everyone.

# Our History
* ## Tom Walker

Founder & CEO

Former Navy officer, nuclear engineer, and Special Operations leader advancing low-altitude
airspace modernization. A trusted advisor to Congress and senior federal officials on autonomy,
national security, and aviation, he is widely recognized as an industry authority. His expertise
has been sought on White House panels, and he has testified before the Homeland Security
Subcommittee on emerging drone threats.
* ## John Vernon

Co-founder & CTO

A seasoned technologist and product leader, John advances autonomy-first platforms for unmanned
aircraft, driving secure flight authorization, dynamic restrictions, and Remote ID. With a
background in networking and product engineering, he has built high-performing teams delivering
standards-based systems that strengthen airspace security and protect critical infrastructure. He
also served on the FAA rulemaking committee for beyond visual line of sight operations.

all_classified.company_summary: Matternet is a logistics company that specializes in innovative drone delivery systems, primarily serving the healthcare and e-commerce sectors. By leveraging advanced drone technology, Matternet aims to revolutionize the logistics landscape, enhancing efficiency and reliability for its target customers.

Its core products include the Matternet M2 Drone, designed for urban logistics with a payload capacity of 2.5 kg, the Matternet Station for automated package handling, and a comprehensive software platform that optimizes drone operations and logistics management. # **Infrastructure ** for
# Advanced Air Mobility

Skyports designs, builds, owns, and operates networks of vertiports, enabling safe and efficient
urban air transport in major markets around the globe

## What We Do

Aviation is on the verge of a transformation. The advent of electric vertical take off and landing
aircraft opens the potential of urban air transport. Vertiports are the dedicated ground
infrastructure that help realize this future. Skyports is the world’s leading vertiport provider and
operator.

Site Selection
Designing, Permitting, & Construction
Operations
Technology

Skyports works with aircraft operators, asset owners, and local stakeholders to establish a
transportation network optimized for efficiency and convenience. Our approach considers the needs of
the customer and the community, enabling us to identify the best vertiport sites.

Skyports uses its airport planning, airspace, regulatory, and operations expertise to design and
build vertiports which capture industry best practices and aircraft performance requirements.
Working with authorities and communities, we obtain necessary permits and permissions before
deploying each vertiport.

Skyports implements the processes and procedures that allow vertiports to function safely and
efficiently. We process passengers and cargo through the terminal, support aircraft on the ground,
and ensure a safe operating environment for landing and take off.

At the core of Skyports’ product is a technology solution that enables safe and efficient
operations. This includes landside terminal management, airside resource management, operational
status supervision, and data integrations across stakeholders.

# Zipline Fact Sheet

## About Zipline

Zipline is an American robotics company and the world’s largest autonomous delivery service. Zipline
has flown more than 130 million autonomous miles, operates on multiple continents, and safely makes
a delivery every 30 seconds somewhere in the world.

Zipline started in 2014 to build the first logistics system that serves all people equally. We did
this because 5.5 million kids lose their lives each year due to a lack of access to basic medical
products. Those deaths are entirely preventable. Our system gets blood and medicine from Point A to
Point B when people need it – saving lives. Today, Zipline delivers to more than 5,000 hospitals and
health centers and has become a key part of healthcare supply chains in Africa, helping save tens of
thousands of lives and dramatically improve health outcomes.

It turns out that moving things quickly from Point A to Point B is a universal need. Each year in
the U.S., more than 5 billion on-demand orders are delivered using vehicles that weigh thousands of
pounds to transport items that weigh less than five. It’s slow, expensive, and bad for the
environment. A better system helps busy families care for their kids, brings fast and reliable
delivery to hard-to-serve areas, and helps older adults stay healthier with easier access to
prescriptions and fresh groceries—without needing a car trip.

In 2025, Zipline launched Platform 2 (P2), our home delivery service designed to make instant
deliveries of food, retail goods, and health products to people who live even in dense cities across
the U.S. In its first year of service Zipline launched P2 in Pea Ridge, Arkansas and more than 20
communities in the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex with Walmart, and more than a dozen restaurant
brands. Customers use the Zipline app to choose from tens of thousands of items with many more being
added all the time.

We deliver food from restaurants, including fan favorites like Chipotle, Crumbl, Blaze Pizza,
Wendy’s, Little Caesars, Hawaiian Bros, and much more. Most orders arrive at homes in less than 30
minutes from the time the order is placed, which means fries arrive hot and crispy, and drinks
arrive still cold and refreshing.

## Technology

Zipline has two delivery services—a service optimized for long-range and rural deliveries, Platform
1, and a service optimized for urban home delivery, Platform 2. Zips are what people see, but they
are only a small percentage of what Zipline does. Behind each delivery is a complex network of
airspace deconfliction tools, inventory management, fulfillment software, warehousing, performance
management, cold chain storage, and more.

Zipline’s instant logistics system is a trusted partner for businesses, governments, and consumers
across the healthcare, food, and retail sectors. Zipline operates around the world 24/7 to deliver
tens of thousands of different items, including medical supplies, blood, vaccines, prescriptions,
retail goods, food, and products that support human and animal health.

## Our Healthcare Work
* Today Zipline regularly delivers to more than 5,000 hospitals and health facilities, including
everything from blood, vaccines and medical products to supplies and gauze. Collectively our
deliveries help doctors save more than 10,000 lives each year.
* Many of our deliveries have helped save the lives of mothers in particular. Numerous studies have
found Zipline’s service helps dramatically improve health outcomes, including:
* 56% decrease in maternal mortality
* 66% decrease in missed opportunities to treat malaria.
* We reduce medical product stockouts by up to 60%
* $0.66 incremental cost per additional Fully Immunized Child (lower than all other
interventions)

**Learn more about ****[Zipline's Healthcare Impact.][3]**

## About Platform 2
* P2 can deliver up to ten times faster than traditional automotive delivery and can make deliveries
ten miles away as quickly as ten minutes.
* Each P2 aircraft is designed to fly up to 24 miles and carry up to 8lbs, with plenty of room for a
family dinner.
* Zipping Points let businesses use Zipline without any construction. Zipline orders are loaded into
Zipping Points in seconds without specialized packaging, training, devices. The Zip will arrive
and pick up the order completely asynchronously.
* P2 aircraft are designed to stay quieter than cars and trucks by hovering high above while its
Delivery Zip descends to the ground on a tether to deliver a package - a contactless delivery
system.
* Zipline’s home delivery service is designed to handle the vast majority of instant delivery orders
in the U.S. across the food, healthcare, and convenience sectors.
* P2 aircraft are equipped with Zipline’s FlightIQ, its advanced onboard autonomy and perception
suite that lets us fly, navigate, and deliver smartly and safely.
* All of Zipline’s aircraft and operations are FAA-approved. Zipline is a pioneer in the use of
Unmanned Aircraft System Traffic Management (UTM), which lets multiple operators automatically
reserve flight routes and airspace, part of its redundant safety systems to avoid conflicts in our
shared airspace.
* For more information on our safety operations, check out [Safety at Zipline][4].

## FAQ

**What does Zipline delivery sound like?**

Zipline deliveries are quieter than common neighborhood sounds. We work hard to be a welcome part of
the communities we serve and to blend seamlessly into the everyday soundscape.

**What weather conditions can Zipline deliver in?**

We run one of the largest testing campaigns in aviation history to make sure we can deliver in rain,
wind, storms, cold, and other conditions that would normally slow down automotive transport.

**What makes Zipline’s approach different from other delivery services?**

It’s just not efficient to use a 3,000 pound car to deliver things like a takeout order, or your
medication. Zipline is faster, more convenient, and doesn’t get stuck in traffic. By staying safely
high up in the air, Zipline deliveries are quieter than common neighborhood sounds.

**Does Zipline have approval to fly?**

Yes. Zipline follows all relevant regulations in every country it operates. Within the United
States, Zipline has all necessary permissions from the FAA to operate. We work closely with the FAA
to ensure our system meets or beats all safety standards and regulations, including extensive
verification of our aircraft, software, operations, procedures, personnel, and more. We work closely
with local communities to keep improving – adding new businesses and features people care about.

# Automated Drone Delivery Technology Solutions

## Docking Stations - A2Z AirDock

### AirDock Dual & AirDock Quad

Designed to blend seamlessly into a built environment, the multi-drone elevated AirDocks support
multiple stakeholders executing simultaneous missions across a joint area of operation.

[ Learn more ][27]

### AirDock Portable

Easily transportable and deployable within minutes, the AirDock Portable folds small and can be hand
carried. Deploy a single AirDock Portable or multiple to extend the Longtail’s serviceable area.

[ Learn more ][28]

### AirDock Shelter

Featuring a motorized clamshell dome, the AirDock Shelter houses one Longtail – AirDock Edition for
prolonged periods and can withstand extreme weather conditions.

[ Learn more ][29]

## Drone Systems

### Longtail Cargo - AirDock Edition

Designed to seamlessly integrate with the AirDock system, the Longtail Cargo – AirDock Edition
features automatic battery charging for round-the-clock autonomous operations. Built on a rugged
all-weather hexacopter platform, it delivers dependable performance in demanding logistics and
delivery environments.

[ Learn more ][30]

### Longtail Patrol - AirDock Edition

Designed for long-duration surveillance missions, the Longtail Patrol – AirDock Edition features
seamless integration with the AirDock for fully autonomous launch, recovery, and battery charging.
Equipped with a specialized patrol payload, it delivers consistent aerial monitoring and real-time
situational awareness for mission-critical operations.

[ Learn more ][31]

## Drone DELIVERY Winch AND ACCESSORIES

### RDS2 Drone Delivery Winch

Our second-generation Rapid Delivery System, the RDS2 offers the highest payload capacity of any
drone winch system on the market safely delivering up to 10 kg from altitude. Eliminating the need
for specialty payload boxes, the RDS2 gives drone delivery operators more flexibility in the shape,
size and weight of payloads they can carry.

[ Learn more ][32]

Designed to seamlessly integrate with the AirDock system, the Longtail Cargo – AirDock Edition
features automatic battery charging for round-the-clock autonomous operations. Built on a rugged
all-weather hexacopter platform, it delivers dependable performance in demanding logistics and
delivery environments.

[ Learn more ][30]

### Longtail Patrol - AirDock Edition

Designed for long-duration surveillance missions, the Longtail Patrol – AirDock Edition features
seamless integration with the AirDock for fully autonomous launch, recovery, and battery charging.
Equipped with a specialized patrol payload, it delivers consistent aerial monitoring and real-time
situational awareness for mission-critical operations.

[ Learn more ][31]

## Drone DELIVERY Winch AND ACCESSORIES

### RDS2 Drone Delivery Winch

Our second-generation Rapid Delivery System, the RDS2 offers the highest payload capacity of any
drone winch system on the market safely delivering up to 10 kg from altitude. Eliminating the need
for specialty payload boxes, the RDS2 gives drone delivery operators more flexibility in the shape,
size and weight of payloads they can carry.

[ Learn more ][32]

# Shaping Tomorrow's Sky
# with Indigenous Drone

Aebocode Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is a drone manufacturing company in India focused on building
indigenous drone solutions. We design and manufacture drones for defence, emergency services,
industrial use, education, and urban development. Our work supports Make in India and strengthens
local manufacturing and self-reliance. Every drone is built with real use cases in mind, from field
operations to training and research.

## Crafted Excellence

[Surveillance Drone]

### Surveillance Drone

This surveillance drone is designed to monitor areas continuously and collect real-time visual data
with stable and reliable flight performance. It is widely used in defence operations for border
monitoring, patrol missions, and threat detection, as well as in security patrolling of sensitive
locations. The drone supports perimeter surveillance, crowd monitoring, and infrastructure
protection across large areas. By providing continuous aerial awareness, it helps security teams
respond faster and operate more safely.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
5 kms LOS
Flight Time
Up to 45 mins
Max Speed
Up to 14 m/s
[Read More][16]
[FPV Drone]

### FPV Drone

This FPV drone offers an unmatched, immersive flying experience with real-time first-person visuals
that put you in the pilot’s seat. Engineered for speed, agility, and smooth maneuverability, it’s
ideal for drone racing, freestyle tricks, and cinematic videography. Its responsive controls and
advanced stabilization ensure confident flight even during aggressive movements.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
5 kms LOS
Flight Time
Up to 25 Mins
Max Speed
Up to 20m/s
[Read More][17]
[Cargo Drone]

### Cargo Drone

This cargo drone is designed to transport heavy loads safely and efficiently across short and long
distances while maintaining stable and controlled flight. It uses intelligent flight systems to
manage weight balance, route accuracy, and safe landing, making it suitable for logistics, medical
supply delivery, disaster relief, and defense operations.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
5 Kms LOS
Flight Time
Up to 30 Mins
Max Speed
Up to 8 m/s
[Read More][18]
[Fixed Wing Drone]

### Fixed wing Drone

This fixed wing drone is built for long-range missions that require extended endurance and wide-area
coverage. Its aerodynamic design allows it to fly longer distances while consuming less energy
compared to multi-rotor drones. It is widely used for mapping, surveying, border monitoring, and
large-scale surveillance operations. Stable flight, precise data capture, and efficient area
coverage make fixed wing drones suitable for strategic and commercial applications.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
5 Kms LOS
Flight Time
Up to 90 Min
Max Speed
Up to 25 m/s
[Read More][19]
[Explore More][20]
[Abhyas Drone]

### Abhyas Drone

This training drone is designed to help beginners and professionals learn drone flying in a safe and
controlled way. It focuses on stable flight, predictable handling, and easy recovery from mistakes,
which makes it ideal for skill development and practice sessions. The drone allows pilots to
understand basic aerodynamics, navigation, and flight control before moving to advanced or
mission-critical platforms. It is commonly used in training institutes, educational programs, and
defense or industrial pilot training.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
2 Km LOS
Flight Time
Up to 30 Mins
Max Speed
Up to 10 m/s
[Read More][21]
[Fire Fighting Drone]

### Fire fighting Drone

This firefighting drone is designed to support fire response teams by providing aerial visibility
and critical data during emergencies. It helps locate fire hotspots, monitor fire spread, and assess
risk in real time without putting firefighters in danger. The drone can operate in high-temperature
and low-visibility environments, making it useful for urban fires, industrial sites, and forest
areas.
Technical Specifications
Max Range
5 Kms LOS
Flight Time
Up to 30 Min
Max Speed
Up to 15 m/s
[Read More][22]
[Drone Simulator]

### Drone Simulator

This drone simulator is designed to train pilots in a safe and controlled virtual environment before
real-world operations. It helps users understand flight dynamics, controls, and emergency handling
without risking hardware damage. The simulator supports skill development for beginners as well as
advanced mission practice for professionals. By improving pilot confidence and reducing training
costs, drone simulators play an important role in responsible drone operations.

all_classified.polished_summary: Aeroexpo is a leading B2B marketplace specializing in aeronautical equipment, catering to a diverse range of industries within the aviation sector. The platform features an extensive catalog of products, including aircraft components, avionics, drones, and airport terminal equipment, while attracting approximately 290,000 visitors each month. Aeroexpo provides manufacturers and buyers with the opportunity to connect, exhibit products, and facilitate online sales, enhancing business development in the aeronautics field.

all_classified.company_summary: Aeronext is an innovative technology startup specializing in next-generation drone solutions aimed at addressing societal challenges through advanced logistics infrastructure. With a focus on intellectual property and proprietary technologies, the company offers services such as technology licensing and joint development, while its subsidiary, NEXT DELIVERY, provides drone-based logistics solutions tailored for logistics providers, government entities, and industry partners.

all_classified.company_summary: Airambulanceworld is a comprehensive resource dedicated to educating the public about air ambulance services, including their types, operational procedures, and the benefits they provide in emergency healthcare. The company focuses on various aspects of air ambulances, such as costs, insurance coverage, and advancements in technology, while targeting individuals in need of medical transport, healthcare professionals, and organizations involved in emergency services.

# Home of Drones For Good®
# and AAM for Good**®**.

## We are America’s leading non-profit organization saving lives by advancing uncrewed aviation for
## public safety, emergencies, and disaster response.


[ Our Vision ][37]

**The Airborne International Response Team (AIRT) was founded with a single vision; to provide
innovative airborne capabilities that help people prepare for, respond to, and recover from complex
emergencies and major disasters.**

**Since our creation in 2017, AIRT programming has expanded to support public safety and emergency
services organizations across the U.S. and around the world to build and manage uncrewed aircraft
systems (UAS) programs. These resources protect property, restore critical infrastructure, and help
save lives.**

**As UAS technology proliferates, AIRT is evolving it’s Drones For Good® program through our newest
non-profit program, AAM For Good. Learn how you can get involved and support our Drones For Good®
and AAM For Good® missions!**

### Airborne International Response Team

Launched in 2017 as our flagship program, the Airborne International Response Team (AIRT) works with
domestic and international partners across all sectors to advance the use of uncrewed aircraft
systems (UAS) for emergency response, humanitarian assistance, and disaster relief (HA/DR).

[ Learn More ][38]

AIRT is the official home of the DRONERESPONDERS Program, established in 2019 as the world’s leading
non-profit program supporting public safety agencies and emergency services organizations using UAS
and related technology for life-safety missions in more than 85 countries.

[ Learn More ][39]
[ [2024 Florida Public Safety Drone Operations Conference] ][40]

Created in 2021, the Florida Public Safety Coordination Group (FLOGRU) serves as a model for states
to share information and knowledge about government drone operations between the public and private
sectors.

[ Learn More ][41]

AIRT’s Drones For Good® program is designed to educate target audiences about the many benefits of
solving problems using UAS and related technology for a wide range of use cases.

### ®

[ Learn More ][42]

Launched in 2024, AAM For Good is AIRT’s newest program uniting stakeholders across all sectors to
explore how the emerging advanced air mobility ecosystem can positively impact communities for
public safety, emergency services, humanitarian assistance, and disaster relief (HA/DR) missions.

[ Learn More ][43]

Partners

## “Drones and advanced aviation are shifting world how the world manages emergencies and
## catastrophes. AIRT is the thrust propelling the tip of that spear.”

— Christopher Todd, CEM®, EMPS, Executive Director, AIRT

all_classified.polished_summary: Airt, founded in 2017, is a leading non-profit organization dedicated to advancing uncrewed aviation for public safety, emergency response, and disaster relief. Through its flagship programs, including the Airborne International Response Team (AIRT) and DRONERESPONDERS, the organization collaborates with domestic and international partners to implement uncrewed aircraft systems (UAS) for humanitarian assistance and life-safety missions. Airt's initiatives, such as Drones For Good® and AAM For Good®, aim to educate and unite stakeholders across various sectors to enhance community resilience and safety.

all_classified.company_summary: Ambulance Drone Wins specializes in innovative drone technology designed for emergency medical services. The company focuses on delivering medical supplies and equipment rapidly to critical locations, enhancing response times in healthcare emergencies. Its target market includes hospitals, emergency responders, and healthcare providers seeking efficient solutions for urgent medical needs.

Their core offerings include the AGNES Connect platform, which facilitates remote patient assessment and care, as well as the Tele-ICU service for critical care management. With a focus on enhancing patient-provider connectivity, Amdtelemedicine serves a diverse range of clients, including hospitals, clinics, and critical care providers, through a comprehensive suite of software, medical devices, and telemedicine systems.

AGNES Connect® software

The bread and butter of AMD Global Telemedicine’s telemedicine technology offering. An enterprise-wide telemedicine platform, for remote clinical healthcare providers to capture and share medical device data, exchange documents and medical images in real-time, and participate in a live video conference – all in a single web-based platform.

Learn More

Scalable Virtual Care Solutions

Our telemedicine and telehealth solutions give you a single solution for your enterprise-wide virtual care needs. A single software platform that addresses multiple medical specialties and a wide range of low-acuity to high-acuity care applications.
Learn More

Integration of Medical Devices

We take a collaborative approach to help you determine the virtual care platform and integrated medical devices that make the most sense for your organization’s needs and deliver business value long term.
Learn More

Support and Training

We are here, by your side to help you all the way through. From finding the right technology solutions for your virtual care delivery challenges to implementation and user training. Hear why our customers have chosen AMD over other solutions.
Learn More

Global Leaders in Telehealth Solutions

For the last 30 years, AMD’s telehealth software platforms, integrated medical devices, and telemedicine bundled kits have established us as a pioneer and leader in providing telemedicine virtual care technology. Our service and solutions help customers push the boundaries of remote healthcare .

Learn More

## Software

All of AMD’s solutions begin by making sure there is a platform for you to effectively have a
virtual encounter with your patients. Our software offerings are the core of almost all our
telemedicine and telehealth solutions because that is what brings all the rest of the pieces
together for the best possible virtual experience. The variety of medical devices may allow you to
capture the diagnostic data, but it is the software that powers the real-time examination and
exchange of information – pushing medical practices to new boundaries.

### Clinical Encounter Telemedicine Platform

[AGNES Connect®][41] is AMD’s premiere software offering. This secure and encrypted cloud-based
telemedicine platform enables remote clinical healthcare providers to capture and share medical
device data, exchange documents and medical images in real-time, and participate in a live video
conference – all in a single web-based platform.

This platform allows you to take live streaming images and data from integrated (connected) medical
devices and stream it in real time to the remote physician.

### Automated Vitals Capture & Documentation Platform

[AGNES Vitals Connect][45] platform is an automated solution that reduces time/resources needed for
your staff to take and document patients’ vitals within their EMR. Automating vitals data collection
and documentation with AGNES Vitals Connect allows clinicians to move from room-to-room in just
minutes, quickly accomplishing their vitals rounds, and leaving more time for clinical observation
and focused patient interaction.

## What Can AGNES Connect® Do for You?

[AGNES Connect® is AMD’s premiere telemedicine software offering of our telehealth products.]

##### Delivers 100% Live Access to a Patient from Any Remote Location

Clinician and remote specialists are connected through video conferencing set inside the AGNES
Connect® platform. Data from the connected medical devices is streamed in REAL-TIME via our
application.

##### Integrates with EMRs

AGNES Connect is built with support for the next generation of HL7, FHIR. Our solution can be set up
to directly pull patient demographics from the EHR and push an encounter report and data from
connected medical devices, back into the EHR. Simplifying documentation from the virtual visit.

##### Provides Complete Physician Mobility

Remote users have secure web-based access to one or multiple exam sites. With the Facility Manager
tool, it becomes easy for a provider to manage their telemedicine consults for multiple patient
locations, but within a single platform.

##### Provides Enterprise-Wide Scalability & Security

Leveraging our cloud-based infrastructure, healthcare systems and centers of excellence can
[securely manage multiple telehealth sites][41] and have one access point to deliver care in
partnership with their local provider networks.

## How does it work?

AGNES Connect® patient assessment tool is a cloud-based application – no need to configure back-end
servers. The telehealth platform seamlessly aggregates data from connected clinical device
diagnostics and then securely exchanges that information in real-time to the remote consulting
physician. The video conference session is simultaneous to the the rest of the encounter, keeping
everything in a single platform and entry point for the provider.

[See Our Compatible Devices][42]

## Secure Encryption for Enterprise-Wide Telehealth

Our AGNES Connect® SaaS offering is delivered on a secure platform that supports HIPAA compliance
and we offer a Business Associate Agreement (BAA).

Any information exchanged during the session is encrypted and erased once the session is over. At
the end of the session, an Encounter Report can be saved to the location of your choice or sent to
your EMR.

[A healthcare physcian using AGNES Connect®, a telemedicine patient assessment tool.]

### Unlimited Remote Users and Licensing Fee Per Sending Site

There are no user fees or doctor fees associated with AGNES Connect®. Just a licensing fee per
sending site (flexible monthly subscription or 1x fee models available) and zero cost for unlimited
receiving sites.

# Tele-ICU Solution for Critical Care Providers

Critical care patients require complex and expensive care. We can help your organization
automatically capture billable clinical interventions, reduce nursing documentation by 70% and
improve patient outcomes with real-time access to the bedside from a remote location.

[AGNES Connect® is AMD’s premiere telemedicine software offering of our telehealth products.]

# Who We Are

At AMD Telemedicine, we believe experience matters. Our digital technology tools and cutting-edge
solutions connect over 10,000 patient end-points in 100+ countries.

[AMD Global Telemedicine is a global telemedicine technology provider]

As a [pioneer of virtual care technology][35] and an industry leader in telehealth solutions, AMD
Global Telemedicine has been providing quality healthcare solutions to our customers for almost 30
years. Since 1991, we have focused on breaking the barriers that keep healthcare providers from
connecting with their patients, such as time and distance.

We take pride in helping to revolutionize the way remote patient assessment and care is performed.
That’s why we’re committed to providing the assistance you need to grow a successful, tailor-made
program based on the demand of your organization and its patients.

## Our commitment to you****

We understand that every organization seeks something different. At AMD Global Telemedicine, our
commitment to you means crafting a telemedicine and telehealth solution specifically to your
organization’s business goals, providing you with the ability to grow and enhance the program while
always delivering top quality healthcare to all of your patients.

As telemedicine continues to evolve and change the way healthcare is delivered across the world, AMD
Global Telemedicine is dedicated to further expanding our telemedicine and telehealth expertise and
constantly creating new healthcare technology solutions for your telemedicine applications.

## Leadership

AMD has proudly been delivering telemedicine solutions for over a quarter-century, playing an
integral role in helping health care organizations and clinical professionals deliver not only
increased access to health care, but improved mobility for remote providers and patients alike.

The company’s [management team][36] has been intricately involved with the telemedicine and
telehealth evolution to mainstream care. From “proof of concept” pilot programs across the US to
country-wide deployments in developing nations, the team at AMD has been there every step of the
way. AMD has earned Best Practices awards from Frost & Sullivan, a growth strategy research firm,
in both [Product Leadership][37] and [Market Leadership][38].

#### Tim Steffl

President

[Eric Bacon]

##### Learn more about Tim Steffl

Tim brings extensive healthcare experience to his role as President of AMD Global Telemedicine,
which he joined in June 2024. Prior to this, Tim served as the Vice President of Strategic
Development & Finance at Delta Dental Plans Association, providing strategic oversight and
leadership to multiple functions within the association. He also led Pivot Health Advisors as
President, where he was responsible for product strategy development and commercialization
consulting for one of the nation’s largest hospital systems. Tim spent 16 years with the American
Hospital Association, serving as Chief Operating & Development Officer, managing the for-profit
endorsement arm of the AHA and founding, launching, and running three start-up organizations.

Tim is a Mentor at MATTER, a Chicago-based healthcare incubator and accelerator, where he offers
business expertise to start-up organizations in the healthcare space. His personal passions are
playing golf and attending music festivals and concerts.

In addition to his healthcare background, Tim was the President and CEO of the dental technology
company ADA Business Innovation Group (ADABIG). He was responsible for establishing the
profitability and scalable growth of this for-profit subsidiary of the American Dental Association.
His role included developing a business portfolio of companies by partnering with, developing, or
acquiring innovative organizations in the dental sector. Tim also created a strategy for growing and
scaling ADA Practice Transitions, which helps match dentists looking to buy or sell a dental
practice.

Tim holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration with a specialization in finance from The
Ohio State University.

Fun fact: Tim is an avid golfer and attends multiple music festivals and concerts every year.

The organization focuses on advancing clinical best practices, policy leadership, and education to enhance access to technology-enabled care across the healthcare ecosystem. Its initiatives, such as the LIFTT Initiative and the Digital Infrastructure Score, aim to promote federal reforms and improve telehealth access nationwide.

# amr industry alliance

uniting to act on antimicrobial resistance
The AMR Industry Alliance is one of the largest private sector coalitions set up to provide
sustainable solutions to curb antimicrobial resistance, **with over 90 biotech, diagnostics,
generics and research-based pharmaceutical companies and associations** joining forces. Read some of
our latest reports below:

[ antibiotic manufacturing standard ][20]

###  

### We drive and measure the life-sciences industry progress to curb antimicrobial resistance in
### four different areas:

Invest in R&D to meet public health needs with new innovative diagnostics & treatments
Improve access to high-quality antibiotics and ensuring that new ones are available to all
Work to reduce the development of antimicrobial resistance
Support measures to reduce environmental impact from production of antibiotics

## shared goals

We are uniting efforts to reduce the development of antimicrobial resistance, invest in R&D to meet
public health needs and improve access to antibiotics, vaccines and diagnostics.
[find out more][22]

Report captures efforts made by the life sciences industry to fight AMR across several domains:
research and science, access, appropriate use, and manufacturing. The third iteration of this
biannual report captures progress made by Alliance members between July 2019 and March 2021. Find
out more below.
[find out more][23]

## in action

Our case studies provide snap-shots from across the life-sciences industry, share information on the
tangible steps we are taking to invest in new research to develop new antibiotics and vaccines,
prevent infection, and improve appropriate use of antibiotics.

# Medical Drone Delivery

Avion connects remote clinics with urban healthcare infrastructures, ensuring rapid, safe, and
efficient delivery of vital medical supplies and clinical samples to the most hard-to-reach
locations.

[Contact Us][5][Learn More][6]
Features

## Cutting-Edge Technology Platform

Our platform combines advanced autonomous drone technology with an intuitive digital health
interface

eVTOL Drones
Advanced autonomous drones with seamless take-off and landing capabilities, even in challenging
terrains.
Digital Health Platform
Intuitive interface connecting healthcare providers with labs and pharmacies in real-time.
Medical Supply Delivery
Rapid and safe delivery of vital medical supplies to remote locations.
Clinical Sample Transport
Efficient transport of clinical samples from remote clinics to sophisticated urban labs.
Real-Time Tracking
Track shipments and communicate with laboratory and pharmacy staff through our platform.
Safe & Secure
Ensuring the highest standards of safety and security for all medical deliveries.
How It Works

## Simple, Efficient Process

From order to delivery, our streamlined process ensures healthcare reaches where it's needed most

01
Place Order
Healthcare providers use our intuitive platform to order supplies or schedule sample transport
02
Drone Dispatch
Autonomous eVTOL drones are automatically dispatched with advanced route optimization
03
Real-Time Tracking
Monitor delivery progress in real-time through our digital health platform
04
Safe Delivery
Drones safely deliver to remote clinics or transport samples to urban labs
Benefits

## Transforming Remote Healthcare Delivery

Avion's innovative platform brings unprecedented advantages to healthcare delivery in remote areas.

Rapid delivery to hard-to-reach locations
24/7 autonomous operation capability
Real-time tracking and communication
Reduced delivery costs and time
Enhanced patient care outcomes
Seamless integration with existing healthcare systems

### Remote Access

Reach the most isolated clinics

### Fast Delivery

Minutes instead of hours or days

### Connected Network

Seamless healthcare ecosystem

Ready to Transform Healthcare Delivery?
Join us in bridging the gap between remote clinics and urban healthcare infrastructures

# Medical Drone Delivery

Avion connects remote clinics with urban healthcare infrastructures, ensuring rapid, safe, and
efficient delivery of vital medical supplies and clinical samples to the most hard-to-reach
locations.

[Contact Us][5][Learn More][6]
Features

## Cutting-Edge Technology Platform

Our platform combines advanced autonomous drone technology with an intuitive digital health
interface

eVTOL Drones
Advanced autonomous drones with seamless take-off and landing capabilities, even in challenging
terrains.
Digital Health Platform
Intuitive interface connecting healthcare providers with labs and pharmacies in real-time.
Medical Supply Delivery
Rapid and safe delivery of vital medical supplies to remote locations.
Clinical Sample Transport
Efficient transport of clinical samples from remote clinics to sophisticated urban labs.
Real-Time Tracking
Track shipments and communicate with laboratory and pharmacy staff through our platform.
Safe & Secure
Ensuring the highest standards of safety and security for all medical deliveries.
How It Works

## Simple, Efficient Process

From order to delivery, our streamlined process ensures healthcare reaches where it's needed most

01
Place Order
Healthcare providers use our intuitive platform to order supplies or schedule sample transport
02
Drone Dispatch
Autonomous eVTOL drones are automatically dispatched with advanced route optimization
03
Real-Time Tracking
Monitor delivery progress in real-time through our digital health platform
04
Safe Delivery
Drones safely deliver to remote clinics or transport samples to urban labs
Benefits

## Transforming Remote Healthcare Delivery

Avion's innovative platform brings unprecedented advantages to healthcare delivery in remote areas.

Rapid delivery to hard-to-reach locations
24/7 autonomous operation capability
Real-time tracking and communication
Reduced delivery costs and time
Enhanced patient care outcomes
Seamless integration with existing healthcare systems

### Remote Access

Reach the most isolated clinics

### Fast Delivery

Minutes instead of hours or days

### Connected Network

Seamless healthcare ecosystem

Ready to Transform Healthcare Delivery?
Join us in bridging the gap between remote clinics and urban healthcare infrastructures

all_classified.polished_summary: Avion is a pioneering company specializing in medical drone delivery, connecting remote clinics with urban healthcare infrastructures to ensure rapid and efficient delivery of vital medical supplies and clinical samples. Utilizing advanced autonomous eVTOL drone technology and an intuitive digital health platform, Avion enhances healthcare access in hard-to-reach locations, improving patient care outcomes through real-time tracking and seamless integration with existing healthcare systems.

all_classified.company_summary: Avive is a pioneering company focused on enhancing emergency response to out-of-hospital cardiac arrests through its innovative products and services. The company offers the Avive Connect AED®, the smallest and lightest AED on the market, alongside the REALConnect™ software, which integrates AEDs with 911 services to improve response times and survival rates. Targeting diverse sectors including athletics, education, business, and public safety, Avive aims to mobilize communities and create a connected system for cardiac arrest management.

[Avive AED device in front of a computer monitor displaying a map of the United States with green
markers and a dashboard showing 122 emergency-ready devices with no issues.]

The Avive® solution bridges the gap between 911, bystanders, first responders, and hospitals to save
time and improve survivability of out-of-hospital cardiac arrests.

[
Learn more about REALConnect™
][43]

## A system built to save lives.

Avive’s REALConnect™ services power industry leading AED connectivity, first of its kind 911
integration, and streamlined AED maintenance.

Intelligent Response™

### The first and only AED integrated into 911.

Connecting AEDs directly to 911. Intelligent Response gives 911 the power to activate nearby Avive
Connect AED®s, alert bystanders, mobilize responders, and save crucial time during an emergency.

[
Learn more
][44]
Rapid Incident Data Transfer

### Hardware that connects the Chain of Survival.

Help first responders and physicians make informed decisions faster with ECG data, usage timestamps,
and shock analysis. Available immediately once the AED is powered off.

Smarter deployment

### Consultative community assessments.

Avive works with your community to build coordinated systems that help close the gap between
collapse and care—improving survivability and bridging the Chain of Survival.

[
**Talk to our team**
][45]
4 Minute Community™

### Getting AEDs to the people who need them, faster.

A holistic approach to out-of-hospital cardiac arrest management. Partnering with your community to
bridge the efforts of bystanders, 911, first responders, and healthcare providers to create a
unified system of response.

[
**Explore 4 Minute Community™**
][46]

When an AED is used for OHCA by a bystander prior to EMS arrival, survival rates jump to 53%.³

4-7x

all_classified.polished_summary: Avive is a pioneering company focused on enhancing emergency response to out-of-hospital cardiac arrests through its innovative products and services. The company offers the Avive Connect AED®, the smallest and lightest AED on the market, alongside the REALConnect™ software, which integrates AEDs with 911 services to improve response times and survival rates. Targeting diverse sectors including athletics, education, business, and public safety, Avive aims to mobilize communities and create a connected system for cardiac arrest management.

## Why is Every Shipping Company Looking Up?

#### Cost

Overcoming the challenges of speed and safety comes at a high cost when using conventional transport

## **Blueflite^{®}** is Rugged, Scalable & Market Ready

Founded in 2018, blueflite^{®} offers a drone-based logistics platform for faster and more
cost-effective deliveries. The patented, unique, and all-electrical drone design has vertical
take-off and landing capabilities, advanced maneuverability, and is built without compromise – to
meet the rigorous demands of commercial operations.

Whether packages are large or small, our drone-based platform is built to scale in both size and
quantity. Operating through our proprietary logistics systems blueflite^{®}’s digital network is
designed to work with existing logistic solutions, making blueflite^{®} the obvious choice for large
logistic contracts.

[Contact us][18]

Designed and made in USA. Optimized for logistics applications with cost and dependability in mind.
Easy to transport and dispatch, fully assembled, and ready to use. Extreme maneuverability and
high-speed cruise through vectored thrust. Superior operating economics, for a range of logistics
applications. The all-electric drive-train allows for emission-free energy sources.
* Compact and modular design
* Lightweight carbon composite airframe
* Independently actuated tilt-rotors
* All-electric design with battery monitoring system
* Integrated cargo compartment with easy access

###### Digital

[Home Quality][21]

blueDigital: our cloud-based productivity tool to integrate the full bandwidth of advanced
functionality that only drone logistics can offer.

control and vehicle monitoring.

system featuring Machine Learning, was designed to carry out the most complex flight missions.

blueDelivery is our smart phone app to enable customers placing orders for consumer items to be
delivered by drone.

## Drone Deliveries Are On The Rise

The blueflite^{®} drone enables rapid delivery of medical or life-saving equipment, such as
defibrillators, when speed is of essence. Our revolutionary drone technology reduces cost associated
with medical emergencies and has the potential to revolutionize the medical logistics sector.

#### Emergency Response

Whether it’s fresh food delivered to the doorstep or the convenience of quasi-instant grocery
shopping online, only drones can offer the speed and efficiency required to enable the convenience
of last mile deliveries for all. Our drones carry the payload protected from external weather and
have automated delivery capability. Cost for last mile delivery can be reduced by factor 5 or more
compared to conventional road transport while time for delivery is reduced.

#### Smart City

Our drones offer logistics solutions to industrial applications, such as spare part deliveries in
the energy or maritime industries. Transport to hard to reach locations can be expensive, time
consuming and dangerous. Our drones enable reliable delivery of critical supplies to remote sites
while keeping the crew safe.

#### Industrial Revolution 4.0

The ruggedness and ease-of-use of our drones make them a perfect logistics tool for resupply units,
to increase expeditionary reach, and facilitate logistics at scale in remote locations. The four
independently controlled vector thrusters enable our drones to also operate reliably when the

Heavy Payload & Logistic Drone Manufacturer in India

We are a pioneering logistics drone manufacturing company in India, specialising in heavy-payload unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) engineered for high altitudes and challenging terrains. Our drones are built for real-world operations, delivering reliability, precision, and endurance in demanding environments.

Our heavy-lift drones, with a payload capacity of up to 20 kg, are currently operationally deployed between 14,000 ft to 17,000 ft AMSL. We have also successfully demonstrated our 50 kg payload drone to the Indian Army at 6,500 ft AMSL.

As a deep-tech drone manufacturing company, we place a strong focus on research and development. Our team of 60+ engineers and domain experts brings over a decade of experience across aerial mobility, autonomous drone technologies, and advanced aerospace systems.

Our drones support logistics, disaster response, and military applications, delivering security, precision, and endurance in mission-critical deployments. Through continuous innovation and indigenous engineering, we are building next-generation logistics and heavy-payload drones, positioning ourselves among the most trusted drone manufacturers in India.

Advanced UAV Manufacturing for High-Altitude Operations

Highly Efficient
Propulsion System

Optimised for high-altitude UAV operations, the propulsion system is fine-tuned to achieve the desired torque and RPM with minimal energy consumption. This results in enhanced operational efficiency, particularly in high-altitude, low-density air environments where traditional systems may struggle. The system is engineered for optimal performance while ensuring reduced energy consumption, which is critical for extended flight times and sustainable operations.

High-Altitude
Performance

Our proprietary algorithm enables seamless drone operations in high-altitude environments. Designed for efficiency in low air density conditions such as fog and snow, it operates reliably even in extreme temperatures as low as -20°C. This ensures optimal performance in the most challenging terrains, enhancing mission success rates in harsh conditions.

AI-Based Predictive
Maintenance

Advanced AI continuously monitors vehicle health, subsidiary sensors, flight cycles, maintenance schedules, airframe condition, and battery performance to predict potential issues before they arise. This technology safeguards the integrity of the vehicle, reduces downtime, and ensures operational reliability, providing a comprehensive approach to proactive maintenance.

Self Flying
Technology

Fully autonomous operations minimise the need for constant pilot intervention. With features such as smart terrain-following, return-to-home functionality, and emergency landing protocols, our drones are equipped to handle a variety of complex scenarios independently. Even in unforeseen circumstances, autonomous emergency landing capabilities ensure the mission continues without disruption.

Multi-Pod Payload
Capability

The modular payload system is designed to accommodate a variety of volumetric payloads, enabling efficient and secure transport for diverse mission requirements. Whether carrying medical supplies, essential equipment, or other logistical materials, the system ensures flexible and reliable delivery. Its adaptability allows for seamless integration across multiple applications, including defence, disaster response, and commercial logistics.

## One Indigenous Innovation At A Time

In Cutting-Edge Vertical Take-Off And Landing Platforms. Based In Bhubaneswar, Odisha, We Are
Revolutionised Logistics And Transport With Smart Solutions Designed For Challenging Terrains, Urban
Environments, And Disaster Response Scenarios. With A State-Of-The-Art 32000 Sq. Ft. Facility And A
Team Of Over 40 Skilled Professionals, BonV Aero Is Committed To Revolutionised Aerial Mobility By
Creating Drones That Could Perform In The Most Challenging Environments, From High-Altitude Defense
Operations To Disaster Management. Recognised Globally For Excellence, Our Vision Is To Make Aerial
Mobility Accessible To Everyone, Everywhere.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What does the recruitment process look like?

Our recruitment process typically includes an application review, an initial HR screening, a
technical or functional interview (if applicable), and a final discussion with the hiring manager or
leadership team. The exact process may vary depending on the role.

### What are the next steps after submitting my application?

Once you submit your application through our website, our recruitment team reviews your profile. If
your experience and qualifications align with the role requirements, we will reach out to you for
the next stage of the hiring process.

### How long does it usually take to hear back after applying?

Our team usually reviews applications within 1–2 weeks. If your profile is shortlisted, you will
receive communication from our HR team regarding the next steps.

### Can I apply for multiple roles at the same time?

Yes, candidates can apply for multiple roles if their skills and experience align with the job
requirements. However, we recommend applying to positions that best match your qualifications.

### What qualities do you look for in candidates?

We look for candidates who demonstrate strong technical or functional skills, a willingness to
learn, adaptability, and the ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.

### What is the company culture like?

Our company culture focuses on collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. We encourage
employees to share ideas, take ownership of their work, and contribute to the growth of the
organization.

### Are there growth and learning opportunities in the company?

Yes, we support employee development through learning opportunities, mentorship, and exposure to
different projects that help individuals build their skills and grow professionally.

### Does the company provide training for new employees?

Yes, new employees typically go through an onboarding process where they are introduced to the
company, the team, and the tools required for their role. Additional training may also be provided
depending on the position.

### What benefits does the company provide?

We offer competitive compensation, structured leave policies, and opportunities for professional
growth. Our team also benefits from a dynamic work environment and exposure to real-world,
high-impact projects.

### Is there flexibility in terms of work arrangements?

Work arrangements depend on the role and business requirements. Some positions may offer
flexibility, while others may require onsite presence.

### Will I receive feedback if I am not selected?

Due to the large number of applications we receive, detailed feedback may not always be possible.
However, shortlisted candidates are typically informed about their application status.

### Can I update my application after submission?

If you need to update any information, you may contact our HR team or submit a revised application
if the system allows.

## Mission Briefing

### 01 What is the payload capacity of Air Hans?

Air Hans can carry payloads of up to 20 kg depending on mission profile and altitude.

### 02 What is the operational ceiling of Air Hans?

The platform is capable of operating up to 16,500 ft AMSL.

### 03 What is the mission range of Air Hans?

Air Hans has a mission range of 12km (Line of Sight).

### 04 What type of missions is Air Hans designed for?

Air Hans is designed for logistics, ISR, payload deployment, emergency response, and tactical
operations.

### 05 Does Air Hans support autonomous missions?

Yes. The platform supports Manual, Auto, and RTL (Return-to-Launch) flight modes.

### 06 Can Air Hans operate in difficult weather conditions?

Yes. The system is engineered for all-weather operations ranging from –20°C to +55°C.

### 07 What navigation system does Air Hans use?

Air Hans uses Multi-Constellation GNSS for reliable navigation and positioning.

### 08 Does the platform support day and night operations?

Yes. Air Hans supports EO/IR payloads for both day and night mission capability.

### 09 What is the communication range of Air Hans?

The platform supports LOS communication up to 7 km.
