# Frequently Asked Questions

At BonV Aero, we understand that our clients and partners often have questions about how our drone
systems integrate into real-world logistics, defence, and government use cases. Below you'll find
answers to some of the most commonly asked questions to help you understand our capabilities,
certifications, deployment process, and ongoing support.

### 1. What Kind of Logistic Drones Do You Offer?

At BonV Aero, we offer purpose-built multi-rotor logistics drones designed to carry payloads
efficiently across urban, rural, and remote areas. From emergency deliveries to daily logistics, our
drones support different government and commercial use cases with reliable performance.

### 2. How Reliable Are Your Drones in Different Indian Environments?

BonV's drones are rigorously tested across diverse and extreme Indian terrains. From sub-zero
temperatures in Ladakh to the humid, cyclone-prone coastal belt of Andhra Pradesh, and even during
monsoon rescue simulations along the Mahanadi River in Odisha, our UAVs have consistently delivered
results.

Designed to operate in temperature ranges from –20°C to +55°C with wind tolerance up to 40 km/h,
they’ve been deployed for high-altitude logistics, emergency supply missions, and military support
in some of India’s toughest environments. This proven performance makes them highly reliable for
both government and commercial operations.

### 3. Can the Drone’s Payload Capacity or Flight Range Be Customised?

Yes. At BonV Aero, we recognise that every mission presents unique operational challenges. Our UAV
platforms are engineered with modularity at their core—allowing customisation in payload weight,
endurance, and flight profiles based on mission needs and environmental conditions.

From groceries and medical kits to explosive ordnance, firefighting payloads, and oblong cargo, our
multi-use pods have been configured to support diverse applications across mountains, coastlines,
deserts, and remote forested terrains.
Our drones have been successfully deployed in extreme regions like Ladakh, Kupwara, Baramulla, and
Tawang, where we’ve demonstrated performance at altitudes up to 19,000+ ft AMSL.

### 4. Can Your Drones Work With Our Current Logistics or Tracking Systems, and Do They Support
### Real-time Tracking?

Our drones offer full real-time tracking throughout their flight range via the BonV ground control
software, allowing you to monitor location, altitude, speed, and flight path live. This ensures
smooth coordination and situational awareness during operations. Relevant tracking data can also be
used to support your logistics workflows as needed.

### 5. Where Can These Drones Be Used in Government Operations?

BonV Aero’s multi-rotor drones are designed for a wide range of logistics applications, including
emergency deliveries, postal services, and rural operations.

Some of our government-related deployments are confidential and cannot be publicly disclosed. For a
better understanding of our drone capabilities and real-world use cases, we invite you to explore
our website.

### 6. Can These Drones Be Used in Hilly or Remote Areas?

Yes, our drones are engineered to operate smoothly in challenging terrains and less accessible
regions. Whether it’s undulating landscapes, remote villages, or forested zones, they are capable of
reaching areas where conventional logistics might face limitations. This makes them a practical
solution for timely deliveries in difficult-to-reach locations.

### 7. Are You Registered on Gem or Do You Support Government Procurement Processes?

Yes, BonV Aero is registered on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) and actively supports procurement
through government-approved channels.

We fully comply with all protocols laid out under public procurement policies and defence
procurement procedures, including those outlined in DAP 2020 and the Make in India initiative. Our
offerings are aligned to meet the logistical, operational, and compliance needs of government
stakeholders, particularly in the defence, disaster response, and strategic logistics sectors.

This ensures ease of procurement, transparency, and regulatory readiness for all government partners
seeking cutting-edge UAV solutions.

### 8. Do Your Drones Meet Government Safety and Compliance Standards?

Yes, at BonV, we prioritise regulatory compliance and operational integrity as core principles
guiding the development and deployment of our drone technologies.

Our logistics drone systems have successfully met the rigorous safety and operational standards set
forth by the Ministry of Defence (MoD), Government of India. In alignment with our collaboration
with the OEF and active engagement with the Indian Army, our drones have undergone comprehensive
technical evaluations and demonstrated full compliance with military protocols for unmanned
logistics operations.

Engineered for mission-critical performance, reliability, and secure communication, these systems
are fully suited for defence logistics and tactical support. This adherence to MoD standards
reinforces our commitment to national defence objectives and supports the broader vision of
strategic autonomy and indigenous innovation under the Make in India and Atmanirbhar Bharat
initiatives.

### 9. Can We Request a Live Demo Before Purchasing a Drone?

Yes, we offer live demonstrations to help you evaluate the drone’s performance. You can see the
drone in action and understand how it fits your specific operational needs.

### 10. Will You Help Us With Flight Test Regulations or Compliances?

Yes, we provide full support for test flight permissions and regulatory approvals. Our team liaises
with the relevant aviation authorities to facilitate the application process, ensuring compliance
with local regulations and minimising approval timelines.

Whether it’s coordinating with DGCA, MoCA, or site-specific authorities, we help streamline the
entire process for a smooth test flight experience. We also assist with obtaining test flight
approvals from DGCA and other regulatory bodies in India.

Our team ensures your test operations remain compliant with NPNT, UAS Rules, and local airspace
permissions.

### 11. What Does Post-sales Support Includes?

Our post-sales support includes technical assistance, routine maintenance, component replacements,
and timely software updates. We’re all about making sure your team stays supported and confident in
using our systems well beyond deployment.

### 12. Do You Provide Training for Drone Pilots or Operators?

Yes, we provide complete logistic drone operator training including theoretical lessons and hands-on
sessions. Your team will learn how to operate, manage, and maintain the drone effectively.

### 13. Will Certification Be Provided After Training?

Yes. After training is complete, we issue a certificate that confirms the individual is trained to
safely operate BonV Aero drones, which can also be useful for compliance and reporting.

### 14. In One Line, What Does BonV Aero Do?

BonV Aero designs and manufactures indigenous, defence-grade heavy-lift UAV systems for
high-altitude, mission-critical logistics and tactical operations.We focus on autonomous aerial
mobility where terrain, altitude, and operational urgency demand reliability.Our platforms are
engineered for real-world deployment, not just demonstration.

### 15. Why Was Bonv Aero Started?

BonV Aero was started to solve India’s last-mile logistics challenges in extreme terrains. We saw a
gap where soldiers and responders depended on slow, risky ground transport. Our goal was to build an
autonomous aerial alternative designed specifically for Indian conditions.

### 16. What Problem Were You Trying to Solve at the Beginning?

We aimed to ensure essential supplies could reach remote and high-altitude locations reliably.
Traditional logistics methods were limited by weather, terrain, and time.We wanted to make aerial
delivery predictable, autonomous, and scalable.

### 17. Who Typically Uses Your Drones Today?

Our primary users are defence and security agencies. We also engage in disaster-response and
emergency support missions. Our systems are tailored for mission-critical deployments where
reliability is non-negotiable.

### 18. Which Sectors Do You Work With the Most?

Defence logistics remains our core focus. We also support homeland security and disaster-response
ecosystems. Our technology bridges logistics and tactical use cases under a unified defence
umbrella.

### 19. What is Your Main Product or Platform?

Our flagship platforms include Air Orca and Air Uttam, built for heavy-lift and high-altitude
missions. They combine indigenous propulsion, autonomous navigation, and rugged airframes. These
systems are designed to perform where conventional UAVs cannot.

### 20. Where Are Our Drones Being Used on the Ground Right Now?

Our logistics drones are deployed in high-altitude forward regions, including Leh–Ladakh. They
support defence supply operations in low-density air environments. These deployments validate
real-world operational readiness, not just test performance.

### 21. What Sets Your Technology Apart From Others?

We specialise in high-altitude heavy-payload capability with autonomous execution. Our propulsion
systems and flight control stacks are built in-house. The combination of rugged airframes and
mission-tested autonomy differentiates us in extreme terrains.

### 22. What Kind of Conditions Are Our Drones Built For?

Our drones operate above 13,000 ft AMSL in mountainous regions. They are built for unpredictable
winds, low air density, and harsh weather. Every component is engineered for durability and
operational continuity.

### 23. How Do We Ensure Our Systems Are Safe and Reliable?

We rely on layered sensor fusion, telemetry-based optimisation, and fail-safe redundancies. Each
system undergoes progressive altitude and payload testing. Reliability is validated through real
mission deployments, not just controlled trials.

### 24. What Has Been a Key Milestone for the BonV Aero So Far?

We set a world record by lifting a 30 kg payload at 19,024 ft AMSL at Umling La. This validated our
heavy-lift capability in one of the toughest operating environments globally. It demonstrated
India’s ability to build high-altitude aerospace technology indigenously.

### 25. How Do Regulations Affect Our Day-to-day Operations?

We operate within India’s evolving UAV regulatory framework. Compliance for BVLOS and defence
testing is embedded into our planning cycles. Regulation is not a constraint but a framework for
responsible scale.

### 26. What is the Biggest Challenge in the Drone Sector Today?

Scaling autonomous operations while maintaining safety and compliance is a major challenge. Energy
density limitations and indigenous component development remain key hurdles. Bridging policy speed
with technology readiness is equally critical.

### 27. How Do We See Drones Changing Logistics and Defence?

Drones will redefine last-mile supply chains in inaccessible regions. They reduce response times and
minimise human risk in tactical scenarios.Autonomous aerial systems will become core infrastructure,
not supplementary tools.

### 28. What is the Scale of BonV Aero’s Operations Today?

We are a growing deep-tech aerospace company with in-house design and manufacturing capabilities.
Our teams work across engineering, autonomy, propulsion, and field deployment. Operations are
anchored in Odisha with expanding national relevance.

## Beyond
## Boundaries

Pelican is a game-changing logistic aerial vehicle drone designed to conquer demanding terrains and
harsh conditions.
With a payload capacity of up to 50kg, this multi utility payload drone supports a wide range of
applications using state-of-the-art self-flying technology. As a BVLOS drone ([Beyond Visual Line of
Sight ][23]), Pelican can operate autonomously even in remote and rugged locations.
Successfully demonstrated at Rupa Valley at 8,530 feet, ongoing R&D aims to enable operations at
altitudes of 16,000 to 17,000 feet AMSL.

## About BRINC

Founded in response to the tragic 2017 Las Vegas Shooting, BRINC is committed to deploying drones
and other technologies that benefit the community and help save lives.

[ Our Values & Ethics ][51]
Never build technologies designed to hurt or kill
Be open, transparent and honest
Move carefully and with purpose
Do the hard stuff
Build technologies designed to save lives
Listen to our customers and communities
Be mindful of the implications of our work – we won’t build a dystopia
[Blake Resnick][Blake Resnick]

# About Us

Cargo Insights, a dynamic trade media, committed to delivering comprehensive coverage of
advancements and trends within the logistics sector. In today’s digital landscape, we specialise in
innovative branding solutions tailored to address the distinct challenges encountered by
professionals and businesses in this intricate industry.

Through in-depth analysis, surveys, and interviews, we offer the latest news, expert opinions,
association activities, and government announcements. Our digital platforms serve as conduits for
clients to expand their reach in the digital era, facilitating connections with their target
audience. Cargo Insights fosters growth and innovation within the logistics landscape.

**Fueling tomorrow’s success with today’s insights!**

We will connect clients to their target audience through our digital platforms that will enable them
to expand globally in this digital era.

## **What We Offer **
* Web and Flash News , Latest News and Updates about the Industry
* E Magazine
* Daily Industry Insights
* Webinars – Digital Panel Discussion
* Round Table meet Physical/ Virtual
* Live interviews of Industry Experts
* Digital Marketing For Trade Partners and Branding on our Social Media Pages
* Customized Branding Options

## **Our Vision**

To create a platform that becomes a one stop solution provider for all the branding needs and serves
as a B2B connector for all our associates.

## **Our Deliverance:**
* Keeping industry updated with ‘Latest News’
* To bridge the gap between clients and their ‘Target Audience’
* Serving our clients to evolve in this ‘Digital Era’
* Creating a ‘360°solution’ based environment for our clients

**Empowering the future of logistics, one insight at a time!**

# About Us

Cargo Insights, a dynamic trade media, committed to delivering comprehensive coverage of
advancements and trends within the logistics sector. In today’s digital landscape, we specialise in
innovative branding solutions tailored to address the distinct challenges encountered by
professionals and businesses in this intricate industry.

Through in-depth analysis, surveys, and interviews, we offer the latest news, expert opinions,
association activities, and government announcements. Our digital platforms serve as conduits for
clients to expand their reach in the digital era, facilitating connections with their target
audience. Cargo Insights fosters growth and innovation within the logistics landscape.

**Fueling tomorrow’s success with today’s insights!**

We will connect clients to their target audience through our digital platforms that will enable them
to expand globally in this digital era.

## **What We Offer **
* Web and Flash News , Latest News and Updates about the Industry
* E Magazine
* Daily Industry Insights
* Webinars – Digital Panel Discussion
* Round Table meet Physical/ Virtual
* Live interviews of Industry Experts
* Digital Marketing For Trade Partners and Branding on our Social Media Pages
* Customized Branding Options

## **Our Vision**

To create a platform that becomes a one stop solution provider for all the branding needs and serves
as a B2B connector for all our associates.

## **Our Deliverance:**
* Keeping industry updated with ‘Latest News’
* To bridge the gap between clients and their ‘Target Audience’
* Serving our clients to evolve in this ‘Digital Era’
* Creating a ‘360°solution’ based environment for our clients

**Empowering the future of logistics, one insight at a time!**

## JX-6A Water Rescue Drone – Flying Lifebuoy for Rapid Response

The JX-6A Air-Water Dual-Role Rescue Drone is an advanced emergency device designed for rapid
deployment in aquatic environments. With a lightweight, durable structure and reliable performance,
it enhances rescue efficiency while reducing the risks for rescuers.
* ###### Smart Hovering & Water Operation
  
  The JX-6A supports autonomous takeoff, point-hovering, and automatic return. It can stably take
  off and land on water surfaces, even in challenging conditions. Wind resistance up to level 6
  ensures reliable performance during emergency response.
* ###### Lightweight Design with High Buoyancy
  
  Weighing just 4.38 kg, the drone is highly portable and easy to operate. With a buoyancy of 190N,
  it can provide immediate floating support to drowning victims in rivers, lakes, oceans, wetland
  parks, offshore platforms, and flood zones.
* ###### Real-time Rescue Support
  
  Equipped with a tiltable camera and 5-inch remote screen, the JX-6A provides real-time video feed
  to locate victims quickly. One-button takeoff, return, and landing ensure efficient, safe
  operation during urgent missions.
* ###### Wide Application Range
  
  Ideal for use by marine police, coast guards, firefighting teams, and emergency responders.
  Suitable for locations including beaches, flood zones, yachts, fish farms, tourist sites, and
  offshore drilling platforms.

OUR PRODUCTS

  Ideal for use by marine police, coast guards, firefighting teams, and emergency responders.
  Suitable for locations including beaches, flood zones, yachts, fish farms, tourist sites, and
  offshore drilling platforms.

# Doctorpreneurs is the global community for medical innovators and entrepreneurs.

As a non-profit, we are dedicated to transforming healthcare by empowering the next generation of
medical innovators and entrepreneurs. With healthcare facing unprecedented challenges, we believe
unlocking clinical talent from within the system is key to driving radical change.

## What we do

We provide medical innovators and entrepreneurs with the insight, network, and opportunities to lead
innovative improvements in healthcare.

INSPIRE – CONNECT – ACCELERATE

We inspire healthcare professionals and students to embrace innovation and entrepreneurship through
insightful interviews and curated resources.
We connect our community with a powerful network, fostering growth and connections through events
and strategic partnerships.
We support their journey by providing access to exciting career opportunities in healthtech.

## How you can get involved

Sign up to our newsletter and join our community for FREE.

Trusted by Our Customers and Partners

Draganfly is amongst the most innovative and adaptable to field solutions for mission execution.

Darren Nebres
COUNTRY DIRECTOR, UKRAINE

Draganfly’s technology will provide a seamless solution that keeps pilots flying even in the most difficult or remote areas during critical missions, We are extremely excited about this partnership which will provide a full drone solution using vision-based, global navigation for GPS-denied and spoofed environments for military and government contracts

Chris Pickett
DIRECTOR OF BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, VERMEER

Draganfly’s drone technology is crucial in helping ensure our first responders remain safe while responding to emergencies,” said Yurii Anykiienko, International Cooperation Specialist with the Main Department of the State Emergency Service of Ukraine in Kyiv region. “Drones are the primary tools in this conflict. They provide our first responders with the necessary information to respond to operations effectively.

Yurii Anykiienko
INTERNATIONAL COOPERATATION SPECIALIST WITH THE MAIN DEPARTMENT OF THE STATE EMERGENCY SERVICE OF UKRAINE IN KYIV REGION

Draganfly’s support has enabled us to increase our portfolio for the cruise industry,” said Klaus Vollmer, Managing Director of Lufthansa Industrial Solutions Hamburg & VP of Lufthansa Industrial Solutions Miami. “We are looking forward to a long and successful partnership.

Kalus Vollmer
MANAGING DIRECTOR OF LUFTHANSA INDUSTRIAL SOLUTIONS HAMBURG & VP OF LUFHTANSA INDUSTRIAL SOLUTIONS MIAMI

We live and operate among vast spreads of land controlled by the US government,” said Curtis Pate, Owner of Agtegrity. “We wanted to find a drone solution that would provide us with the best ROI and help the overall growth of our business. Extended flight time and a PPK (Post Processed Kinematic) option were priorities in our search. That's when we found the Swiss Army Knife of drones: Draganfly’s Commander 3XL. The improved flight times of this platform will lead to better production. The platform's versatility will enable us to multitask between our imagery mapping and heavier payloads. We look forward to the arrival of the Commander 3 XL.

Curtis Pate
OWNER OF AGTEGRITY

We are very excited to collaborate with Draganfly to enhance counter-drone technology further,” said Jack Jia, Founder and CEO of Bluvec. “This will undoubtedly have a major impact on the ability to deeply incorporate UAS and UAV solutions into civil and military threat detection management and intervention.

Jack Jia
FOUNDER AND CEO OF BLUVEC

It is an honor to partner with Draganfly, a global UAV leader, to inspire more women to pursue careers in STEM and aviation, with an emphasis on UAS and AAM. Together, we look forward to bolstering diversity, equity and inclusion in the drone industry, which will improve business outputs and profitability,” said Sharon Rossmark, CEO of Women And Drones.

Sharon Rossmark
CEO OF WOMEN AND DRONES

I am incredibly grateful for the opportunity to learn from the experts at Draganfly. Drones continue to play a significant role in everyday life, and it is essential that we understand how to safely operate them,” said Angela, an ASU student.

Angela

## Driven by passion, partnership, and innovation

For more than two decades, Draganfly has been a leader in the professional drone industry,
supporting our clients with enterprise drone solutions, contract engineering services, custom
software, professional UAV services, and more.

Learn more about our legacy and the people who got us where we are today.

## VISION STATEMENT

To pioneer transformative drone solutions that define industry standards, empower global
organizations, and safeguard lives and resources worldwide.

## VISION STATEMENT

To pioneer transformative drone solutions that define industry standards, empower global
organizations, and safeguard lives and resources worldwide.

## A 25+ year history of drone innovation

Breaking ground with international firsts

Draganfly has a legacy of leading the professional drone industry. Here are a few of our most
groundbreaking firsts:

Earning news coverage

Draganfly technology has appeared in **Time Magazine’s** “Rise of the Drones” issue, the **New York
Times** feature article “How It Works: Gyroscopes That Don’t Spin Make It Easy to Hover,” and
**National Geographic’s** article on UAVs used in emergency services.

Receiving awards and recognitions

Our drone software, tech, and team have been honored with numerous awards and recognitions over the
years.

Improving public safety

Draganfly has a long history of using drone technology to aid the police in keeping the public safe.

Mr. Andy Card, the second longest-tenured White House Chief of Staff, has served in senior government roles under three U.S. Presidents. Mr. Card serves on the Board of Directors of public corporation Union Pacific, on the Business Advisory Board of BrainStorm Cell Therapeutics, on the Advisory Board of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, and on a number of non-profit boards. Before that, Mr. Card was Vice President-Government Relations for General Motors Corporation, one of the world’s largest automobile manufacturers. From 1993 to 1998, Mr. Card was President and Chief Executive Officer of the American Automobile Manufacturers Association, the trade association whose members were Chrysler Corporation, Ford Motor Company, and General Motors Corporation. From March 1987 until March 1988, Mr. Card ran the successful New Hampshire Presidential Primary Campaign for George H. W. Bush.

## Engineering Capabilities

Draganfly is a contract engineering partner for government agencies, enterprise organizations,
academic institutions, and businesses of all sizes. Our team’s truest capabilities are actualized
during the engineering process as hardware designers, software designers, engineers, project
managers, and vertical-specific experts come together to build custom drone solutions for our
partners. Our end-to-end engineering services include:

**Hardware design:** Component, product, and system design
**Software design:** Custom software and interface design
**Development:** Including integration with 3rd party platforms, PX4, Ardupilot, DJI and more
**Modeling:** 3D design and modeling of mechanical components
**ITAR equipment management:** Approved handling and integration of ITAR, and Controlled Goods
technologies
**Support:** Testing, training, documentation, and repairs

## Prototyping

Whether we created the original design or not, **we can build a prototype to make your vision a
reality.** We specialize in low volume, handmade hardware with a strong attention to detail. All you
need is to provide us high-level specs of your components and we’ll craft a turnkey solution for
your specific use case. We have the capabilities to source, supply, or fabricate any material
necessary for your project. Our in-house equipment includes a **CNC mill, CNC router, lathe, FDM 3D
printers, vacuum forming machine, temperature calibration chamber, gyro rate table, and more** to
provide electronics, machining, and PCB assembly services. We are skilled in working with the
following materials:
**Plastics**
**Composites**
**Aluminum**
**Carbon fibre**

Our team of engineers pioneered the Drone space more than two decades ago.

No matter the challenge, we can craft a custom solution for your business.

## Andy Card

## ADVISOR

Mr. Andy Card, the second longest-tenured White House Chief of Staff, has served in senior
government roles under three U.S. Presidents. Mr. Card serves on the Board of Directors of public
corporation Union Pacific, on the Business Advisory Board of BrainStorm Cell Therapeutics, on the
Advisory Board of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, and on a number of non-profit boards. He is also a
professional speaker represented by the Washington Speakers Bureau and joined NBC News as a
contributor in April 2017.

Mr. Card, appointed in November 2000, served as Chief of Staff to President George W. Bush from
January 2001 to April 2006. Prior to his tenure as White House Chief of Staff, Mr. Card managed and
ran the Republican National Convention in Philadelphia at the request of nominee Texas Governor
George W. Bush. Before that, Mr. Card was Vice President-Government Relations for General Motors
Corporation, one of the world’s largest automobile manufacturers. From 1993 to 1998, Mr. Card was
President and Chief Executive Officer of the American Automobile Manufacturers Association, the
trade association whose members were Chrysler Corporation, Ford Motor Company, and General Motors
Corporation. When Chrysler became part of Daimler Corporation, Mr. Card oversaw the dissolution of
the nearly 100-year-old trade association.

Mr. Card also served as Deputy Chief of Staff and then as a Cabinet Member for President George H.W.
Bush as the 11th Secretary of Transportation. Prior to that, he served as Special Assistant (1983 to
1987) and later as Deputy Assistant to the President and Director of Intergovernmental Affairs for
President Ronald Reagan (1988) where he was a liaison to governors, statewide elected officials,
state legislators, mayors, and other elected officials. From March 1987 until March 1988, Mr. Card
ran the successful New Hampshire Presidential Primary Campaign for George H. W. Bush.

Mr. Card is a graduate of the University of South Carolina with a B.S. in Engineering. He also
attended the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy and the John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard
University. Mr. Card served in the U.S. Navy from 1965 to 1967.

## Tim Dunnigan

## DIRECTOR

Tim Dunnigan, a retired U.S. Army Infantry Officer and accomplished technology entrepreneur, is the
CEO & President of MMS Products, Inc., a defense technology solutions provider. He is also the
Founder of CaptureTec, LLC, a defense consultancy group focused on supporting Warfighters through
leadership and innovation. As COO and Co-founder of Talon Aerolytics, Tim led the development of the
nation’s largest aerial drone services provider, expanding operations to all 50 states and
facilitating digital data collection with AI analysis for national critical infrastructure.

As CEO and Founder of Strategic Integration, LLC, Tim developed and operated the CTED (Create, Test,
Educate, Deploy) turnkey business model for defense consulting and technology integration. He has
served America’s security interests abroad through multiple classified (TS/SCI) contracts with the
U.S. Department of Defense. Additionally, as the Founder of iK9, LLC (CVE SDVOSB), Tim co-authored
the Veterans Administration’s (VA) training protocols for service dogs provided to Military Veterans
with Post Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD).

Mr. Dunnigan is a Corporate Advisor with Integrated Defense Accelerator, Founder of the I’m a Hero
Too Foundation [501(c)(3)], and a children’s book author. He holds an active Top Secret security
clearance and is currently a Doctoral Student researching leadership efficacy in decision-making
with regard to drone usage, where AI and machine autonomy are considered. Tim has been awarded six
patents and has two patents pending for an aerial drone delivery system he developed to address
capability gaps he witnessed during his multiple humanitarian trips to Ukraine.

## Andy Card

## ADVISOR

Mr. Andy Card, the second longest-tenured White House Chief of Staff, has served in senior
government roles under three U.S. Presidents. Mr. Card serves on the Board of Directors of public
corporation Union Pacific, on the Business Advisory Board of BrainStorm Cell Therapeutics, on the
Advisory Board of the U.S. Chamber of Commerce, and on a number of non-profit boards. He is also a
professional speaker represented by the Washington Speakers Bureau and joined NBC News as a
contributor in April 2017.

Mr. Card, appointed in November 2000, served as Chief of Staff to President George W. Bush from
January 2001 to April 2006. Prior to his tenure as White House Chief of Staff, Mr. Card managed and
ran the Republican National Convention in Philadelphia at the request of nominee Texas Governor
George W. Bush. Before that, Mr. Card was Vice President-Government Relations for General Motors
Corporation, one of the world’s largest automobile manufacturers. From 1993 to 1998, Mr. Card was
President and Chief Executive Officer of the American Automobile Manufacturers Association, the
trade association whose members were Chrysler Corporation, Ford Motor Company, and General Motors
Corporation. When Chrysler became part of Daimler Corporation, Mr. Card oversaw the dissolution of
the nearly 100-year-old trade association.

Mr. Card also served as Deputy Chief of Staff and then as a Cabinet Member for President George H.W.
Bush as the 11th Secretary of Transportation. Prior to that, he served as Special Assistant (1983 to
1987) and later as Deputy Assistant to the President and Director of Intergovernmental Affairs for
President Ronald Reagan (1988) where he was a liaison to governors, statewide elected officials,
state legislators, mayors, and other elected officials. From March 1987 until March 1988, Mr. Card
ran the successful New Hampshire Presidential Primary Campaign for George H. W. Bush.

Mr. Card is a graduate of the University of South Carolina with a B.S. in Engineering. He also
attended the U.S. Merchant Marine Academy and the John F. Kennedy School of Government at Harvard
University. Mr. Card served in the U.S. Navy from 1965 to 1967.

# About 9to5Mac

At 9to5’s family of sites, we make great efforts to be a top influencer in the tech community by
*consistently* breaking exclusive news and being the first to report information our readers care
about.

We deliver breaking information in digestible format peppered with commentary, wit, and a deep
understanding of the subject matter.

It isn’t enough to just inform; our posts strive to be interesting, entertaining and complemented
with compelling, high-quality media.

9to5 sites are consistently at the top of [Techmeme’s leaderboards][51] and cited by publications
like the *New York Times*, the *Washington Post*, the *Wall Street Journal*, the *Financial Times*,
*Bloomberg*, and many others. Our reporters have won numerous awards and recognitions for their
journalism.

9to5 sites use industry-standard Adsense ads, and offer sponsored posts to companies interested in
reaching our readership through long-form articles rather than banners. Sponsored posts are always
clearly marked as such, represent the views of their sponsors, and improve the site experience for
readers by allowing us to remove some traditional banner ads.

### Reviews

9to5 reviewers are never paid for reviews, but we often receive free temporary or permanent review
units and complementary instruction on usage. We *only* run reviews of hardware and software that we
deem interesting to our audience and worth looking at. This is the reason you don’t often see poor
reviews on 9to5 sites: If we review something we don’t like or find interesting, we usually won’t
post it. We don’t want to waste your time.

### Affiliate linking

We use affiliate links whenever possible; 9to5 sites run software that adds affiliate tags to any
outside linking as a revenue-generating mechanism. You support 9to5 by using our links to buy
products.

*9to5Mac*, *9to5Google*, and *9to5Toys, Electrek, DroneDJ, and SpaceExplored* are also a participant
in the Amazon Services, LLC Associates Program, an affiliate advertising program designed to provide
a means for sites to earn advertising fees by advertising and linking to Amazon.com.

*9to5Toys* is a gear, shopping deals, and news site where we aim to be first to post original news
on new gadgets and notable price drops. *9to5Toys* also aggregates relevant technology deals from
leaders in this industry, including [StackSocial ][52]and others.

You will not be charged extra for your purchases by using our affiliate links.

### Licensing, permissions, and reprints

For all licensing, permissions, and reprint requests, please contact [ads@9to5mac.com][53]

### History

*****9to5Mac* was born in 2007 between the announcement and the launch of the iPhone from Seth
Weintraub’s Paris apartment. Weintraub was taking a sabbatical from Mac IT development work while
his wife was given a fellowship to study in France. The blog was a way to keep up with technology
developments and nurture a writing career that was also taking shape at *Computerworld*, an IDG
publication. [The full story is here][54].

9to5 became a full-time career in 2011 when Weintraub left *Fortune* magazine, started up
[9to5Toys.com][55] and [9to5Google.com][56], and continued to ramp up with additional editors and
reporters. [Electrek.co ][57]was added in 2013, and [DroneDJ.com][58] was launched in 2017.
[SpaceExplored.com][59], [ConnecttheWatts.com][60] and [Blocktalk.co][61] were launched in 2020. All
sites are wholly owned by Seth Weintraub through the 925, LLC company.

Find our [contact information here][62].

# Show combines drones with fireworks

[ [Avatar for Scott Simmie] ][25] [Scott Simmie][26] | Jul 8 2020 - 10:02 am PT
[ 0 Comments ][27]

A Baltic company, SPH Engineering, has released a new video filmed on the 4th of July. The video
captures programmed drones flying in concert with a fireworks display – and even appearing to carry
some pyrotechnics. It’s worth watching.

Of course, Independence Day is a great time for fireworks – and drones. But normally, unless you
have special permission, those two aren’t usually a great mix.

Unless, of course, the drones have been specifically programmed to be part of the show – which is
precisely what SPH Engineering has done. The company produces something called Drone Show Software,
which does pretty much what you’d expect it to do. SPH also puts on technology demonstrations to
show what it can do, and here’s the July 4th edition.

There’s some cool stuff happening there. We’re impressed by the segment where it appears that
there’s actually a drone carrying a firework that appears to be drizzling sparks. If that’s the
case, then the drone likely would have had to ignite that pyrotechnic as well – which is a pretty
cool trick.

Advertisement - scroll for more content
[Site default logo image]

When looking at this video, the one criticism we’d have is that we’d like to see *more drones*. But
given that this is but a demo show from SPH Engineering, we can understand that cost might preclude
the company from having an even greater number. (Plus, we’re probably getting spoiled by some of the
shows that tout 500, even 1000 drones.)

> “SPH Engineering is honoured delivering new Drone Show Software offering fundamentally new event
> experience. The new tool allows to integrate all essential elements for an excellent performance,
> like music, special effects and drone dance which can also be delivered as a digital
> entertainment. We are very excited to deliver a solution to the demanding customers who thrive for
> excellence to ensure them the possibility to create new level shows.”
> **Alexey Dobrovolskiy, CTO of SPH Engineering**

Others have used the company’s Drone Show Software in the past, with great results. These videos
have been produced by others who were using the product for their own show in Switzerland and the
USA.

If you’re curious about how it works, here’s what the company has to say about the process:

> “The timecode with music is started from one controlling computer and passed over to all the
> receiving hardware – fireworks control panel and drone show controlling computer. Once the
> timecode is started, the show is initialised and all components wait for starting command. The
> video recording presents how accurate the drones and fireworks create synchronised formations and
> interact with the music rhythm.”

If you’re interested in a little more info, you can find it [here][28].

Centimeter-Level Accuracy

## About Me

[Drake Schilder, FAA Part 107 licensed drone pilot and owner of Drone Logistic Services]

Drone Logistic Services started with a straightforward goal: build a professional, aerial services
business from the ground up. I hold an FAA Part 107 commercial pilot certificate, have spent years
flying drones, and bring three years of photo and video editing experience to every project I take
on.

I specialize in high-accuracy drone mapping and data capture for real-world applications that
require precision, not guesswork. Using RTK-enabled platforms, base stations, and advanced sensors,
I produce survey like maps, 3D models, and geospatial data that clients can actually rely on for
decision-making.

**FAA Part 107 Licensed**
Commercial drone pilot certificate.

**2 Years Utility Experience**
Infrastructure inspection and documentation.

**3 Years Photo & Video Editing**
Every deliverable is edited and ready to use.

**FAA Part 107 Licensed**

**2 Years Utility Experience**

**3 Years Photo & Video Editing**

## How I Work

Every project gets my full attention. I fly, I edit, and I deliver — no middlemen, no outsourced
post-production. Whether it’s a stockpile volume report that needs to be back by end of week or a
real estate reel that needs to stop a buyer mid-scroll, I approach every job with the same standard.

I’m based in Plymouth WI and serve the wider Midwest, including Chicago. If your project is within
range, let’s talk.

## Ready to work together?

Tell me about your project — I’ll get back within 24 hours with a quote.

Their innovative solutions cater to industries including construction, real estate, utilities, civil engineering, and land development, providing precision-driven deliverables that enhance project outcomes.

### Real Estate

### Agriculture

Precision spraying, crop monitoring, and real-time data on soil health.

Site survey, progress and mapping.

## Mission Statement

Drone Logistics Group empowers sporting, agricultural, real estate, and leisure sectors with the
transformative power of drone technology. We elevate these sectors with our unwavering commitment to
professionalism, integrity, and excellence. We provide farmers and developers with affordable
cutting-edge solutions optimizing land management increasing accuracy and efficiency. Our dedication
to superior customer service and trust built partnerships fuels our mission to lead the industry in
innovation and growth. Crafting a future where our technology sets the standard for efficiency and
effectiveness.

[ about us ][10]

## Tech edge

## Drones

Our fleet of drones are versatile, precise and high-performing. They are tailored for a range of
aerial tasks. The Mavic pro 3&4 is perfect for capturing stunning high-resolution images and videos
with ease. The DJI Avata excels in immersive FPV (first-person view) flying, providing a dynamic and
exhilarating flying experience while delivering high-quality footage. The Mavic Enterprise stands
out for its superior flight time and advanced camera capabilities, making it ideal for surveying and
crop spotting. The DJI inspire creates a cinematic feel capturing the highest quality from above.
Finally, the T-50, known for its robust build and long-range capabilities, is well-suited to
accurately apply chemicals to crops.

## Software

Proprietary analytics platform delivering fast, actionable insights.

## Competitive Advantages for Ag Spraying

### Efficiency & Cost-Effectiveness

Reducing traditional costs by up to 50%.

### Precision & Accuracy

Superior data quality facilitates better decision-making.

### Sustainability

Enhances environmental protocols with reduced chemical usage.

## Valued Partners

Here are some of the organizations we’ve proudly worked with over the years.

Emergency Live is the only multilingual magazine dedicated to people involved in rescue and
emergency. As such, it is the ideal medium in terms of speed and cost for trading companies to reach
large numbers of target users; for example, all companies involved in some way in the equipping of
specialised means of transport. From vehicle manufacturers to companies involved in equipping those
vehicles, to any supplier of life- saving and rescue equipment and aids.

With a focus on the EMS community, Ems1 serves as a vital resource for industry insights, best practices, and professional development.

all_classified.polished_summary: DJI Enterprise specializes in providing advanced drone solutions tailored for various industries, including public safety, geospatial, inspection, and logistics. Their product lineup features high-performance drones such as the Matrice series and FlyCart models, as well as innovative software like DJI FlightHub 2 and DJI Terra, catering to enterprise users across multiple sectors. With a focus on enhancing operational efficiency and precision, DJI Enterprise empowers organizations to leverage aerial technology for diverse applications.

all_classified.company_summary: Entesoer is a high-tech enterprise specializing in energy-efficient solutions for thermal management, refrigeration, dehumidification, and heating applications. The company offers a range of products, including high-efficiency cooling fans, refrigeration units, air filtration systems, and climate control solutions, targeting industries such as telecommunications, data centers, industrial automation, and renewable energy. Through innovative energy management solutions, Entesoer aims to create value for its customers by enhancing operational efficiency and air quality.

# About our company

Headquartered in Shanghai, a global financial hub and cosmopolitan metropolis renowned for its
commercial vitality, Tingxiang Electric (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. is a high-tech enterprise integrating
R&D, production, sales, and service. With three subsidiaries specializing in cooling fans,
filter-equipped fan units, cabinet air conditioners, and intelligent temperature control solutions,
as well as three advanced production bases in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Zhejiang, the company has
established itself as a leader in providing energy-efficient solutions for thermal management,
refrigeration, dehumidification, and heating applications. Since its inception, Tingxiang Electric
has remained committed to delivering systematic and professional optimization solutions, embedding
the philosophy of "creating value for customers" into every stage of its operations—from design and
manufacturing to sales and post-sales support.

### Comprehensive Product Portfolio

The company’s subsidiaries specialize in manufacturing critical components such as high-efficiency
cooling fans, precision-engineered filtration systems, intelligent climate control units, and
energy-saving cabinet air conditioners. These products cater to diverse industries, including
telecommunications, data centers, industrial automation, and renewable energy.

Tingxiang Electric excels in designing tailored thermal management systems that optimize energy
consumption, reduce operational costs, and enhance equipment reliability. Its solutions are widely

product quality and rapid scalability. Beyond manufacturing, the company offers 24/7 technical
support, customized consultancy services, and lifecycle maintenance programs, solidifying long-term
partnerships with clients worldwide.

# Empowering the Future with Cutting-Edge

## Drone Technology

ABOUT EQVIV

## Who

### We Are?

[eqviv drone factory]

#### At EQVIV, we are passionate about harnessing the power of drone technology to transform the way
#### businesses and individuals capture, analyze, and share information.

EQVIV is a company that specializes in the development and manufacturing of unmanned aerial vehicles
(UAVs), commonly known as drones. We are passionate about using technology to solve real-world
problems and believe that drones have the potential to revolutionize a wide range of industries.

## What

### We Do?

#### We are committed to providing our customers with the best possible service and support.

Our team of experienced engineers and designers is dedicated to creating innovative and reliable
drones that meet the needs of our customers. We offer a wide range of drones for a variety of
applications, including logistics, agriculture, surveillance, fire control, etc

[eqviv drone manufacturing site]

## Our

### Vision

#### Our vision is to make drone technology accessible to everyone, empowering businesses and
#### individuals to achieve their goals with greater efficiency, precision, and creativity.

We believe that drones have the potential to revolutionize industries ranging from agriculture and
logistics to surveillance and environmental monitoring.

#### Our mission is to provide our customers with the highest quality drones and accessories, backed
#### by exceptional customer service.

We are dedicated to helping our customers succeed by providing expert advice, training, and
technical support.

## Our

### Mission

[mr. rohit bansal founder of EQVIV]

## Mr. Rohit Bansal

### Founder & CEO

[[linkedin icon]][26]

#### A Pioneer in Air Quality and Drone Innovation

Mr. Rohit Bansal is also the founder of AQI India and Prana Air, two brands that are working to
improve air quality and empower people to breathe clean air.

His passion for drones is evident in his unwavering commitment to making drone technology accessible
and empowering. He recently founded **EQVIV** for** logistics, agriculture, fire control, teargas,
surveillance, air quality,** etc.

problems and believe that drones have the potential to revolutionize a wide range of industries.

applications, including logistics, agriculture, surveillance, fire control, etc

logistics to surveillance and environmental monitoring.

#### Our mission is to provide our customers with the highest quality drones and accessories, backed

We are dedicated to helping our customers succeed by providing expert advice, training, and
technical support.

# Drone as first responder – When time is life

By harnessing the power of autonomous drones, we deliver life-saving medical equipment and provide
real-time situational awareness to emergency services before the first unit arrives, dramatically
improving response times and ultimately, saving lives. Presently, our system reaches over 250,000
people, and is on constant standby, ready to be deployed at a moments notice.

When every second counts.

Get started today, sign up for our online introduction webinar.

[[Sign up here ]][26]
* Everdrone GridPlanner™ predictive analytics
  
  Our innovative Everdrone GridPlanner™ isn’t just a tool—it’s a comprehensive analytical system
  designed to revolutionize emergency response efficacy. Utilizing the latest in data analysis
  technologies, it assesses system responsiveness, providing critical evaluations of how drone
  assistance can dramatically expedite emergency services compared to conventional methods.
  
  The power of GridPlanner™ lies in its capability to conduct an extensive gap analysis for various
  types of emergencies. By meticulously reviewing historical emergency incidents and executing
  simulations of drone flights to real-world locations, it furnishes predictive insights that are
  invaluable for strategic planning. This thorough analysis not only facilitates the identification
  of crucial areas that require the most attention but also empowers you to allocate resources
  efficiently and tailor the grid according to your specific needs and ambitions, ensuring a focused
  approach on the zones of highest impact.
  
  Embarking on this transformative journey begins with integrating our drone-as-first-responder
  grid. This systematic approach ensures not just expansive coverage but also heightened
  responsiveness in critical moments. It’s about targeting efforts where they’re needed most,
  fortifying your emergency response framework, and providing immediate, life-saving interventions.
* Medkit + Liveview delivery
  
  Consider the significant benefits of immediate, precise situational understanding coupled with
  delivery of essential medical supplies. Our drone system provides emergency teams, including
  ambulance services, with critical information to assess situations before arrival, facilitating
  more efficient, safe, and swift responses.
  
  Our service extends beyond delivering valuable insights. It’s a vital resource in critical
  moments, quickly transporting crucial medical equipment such as AEDs and anti-bleeding kits to the
  scene. This approach maximises the effectiveness of the ‘golden hour,’ the crucial period during
  which immediate medical intervention is most successful. This dual functionality represents not
  just innovation but a vital support in emergency scenarios. With real-time data and essential
  medical supplies at hand, our first-on-scene drone system enhances emergency response and enables
  precision healthcare like never before.
* Evidence-Based Approach
  
  Our dedication to evidence-based solutions is at the heart of our mission, exemplified through
  rigorous research in partnership with prestigious entities like the Karolinska Institutet. This
  scientific rigor ensures our emergency drone services are reliable, precise, and grounded in solid
  data.

# About Us

**Fast Company** is the world’s leading business media brand, with an editorial focus on innovation
in technology, leadership, world changing ideas, creativity, and design. Written for and about the
most progressive business leaders, Fast Company inspires readers to **think expansively, lead with
purpose, embrace change, and shape the future of business. **

Launched in November 1995 by Alan Webber and Bill Taylor, two former Harvard Business Review
editors, Fast Company magazine was founded on a single premise: A global revolution was changing
business, and business was changing the world. Discarding the old rules of business, Fast Company
set out to chronicle how changing companies create and compete, to highlight new business practices,
and to showcase the teams and individuals who are inventing the future and reinventing business.

# About Us

**Fast Company** is the world’s leading business media brand, with an editorial focus on innovation
in technology, leadership, world changing ideas, creativity, and design. Written for and about the
most progressive business leaders, Fast Company inspires readers to **think expansively, lead with
purpose, embrace change, and shape the future of business. **

Launched in November 1995 by Alan Webber and Bill Taylor, two former Harvard Business Review
editors, Fast Company magazine was founded on a single premise: A global revolution was changing
business, and business was changing the world. Discarding the old rules of business, Fast Company
set out to chronicle how changing companies create and compete, to highlight new business practices,
and to showcase the teams and individuals who are inventing the future and reinventing business.

## In 2013, Rabih Bou Rached took a business trip to Dubai. While there, he stumbled upon something
## unfamiliar: Drones.
## Back then, drones weren’t part of any industrial playbook. But Rabih saw their potential to
## change how industries collect and use data.
## He spent the next year deep in research — studying drone tech, exploring use cases, and testing
## feasibility in a region with no drone regulations.
## What started as curiosity became a clear mission.
## In 2014, FEDS was born. From day one, we weren’t just operating drones. We were helping define
## how the region would adopt and scale them.
## We worked with regulators to shape policy. We helped early adopters replace unsafe, outdated
## methods.
## ‍
## And we built the region’s most complete drone ecosystem — spanning fleet, field operations, and
## training.

## Industries don’t need more data.
## They need answers.

Every week, companies deploy drones that capture gigabytes of data.

But too often, that data sits untouched. Raw. Unstructured. Unusable.

At FEDS, we don’t just run drone missions.

We convert aerial data into clear, useful insights so you can make confident, time-sensitive
decisions.

From safety assessments to site analytics, we help you move faster and smarter.

## What makes us different?

Most companies offer drone services. Some sell drone products. A few offer training. FEDS provides
all three at scale.

Largest drone fleet in the region
Skilled, licensed pilots you can trust
Services, products, and training under one roof

## We’re redefining how industries solve their toughest challenges using drone solutions.

We convert aerial data into clear, useful insights so you can make confident, time-sensitive
decisions.

From safety assessments to site analytics, we help you move faster and smarter.

## What makes us different?

Most companies offer drone services. Some sell drone products. A few offer training. FEDS provides
all three at scale.

Largest drone fleet in the region
Skilled, licensed pilots you can trust
Services, products, and training under one roof

— delivering high-resolution visual, thermal, and 3D mapping data from every internal surface, with
no human entry required.

Entry permits delay inspection by days

UAE regulations require rescue standby teams

[Red background with a subtle grid pattern of rounded squares and small dots at intersections.]

No baseline data makes condition monitoring impossible

[Black grid pattern with squares and central dots on a dark background.]
Inspect in Hours. Not Days

Caged indoor drones deploy through a standard access hatch and are airborne within minutes. No entry
permits to process, no scaffolding to erect, no rescue standby teams to mobilise. A typical tank or
boiler inspection flight is completed within hours — reducing shutdown windows significantly and
returning assets to service faster than any traditional method.

[Close-up of a drone with a protective cage inspecting blue and black industrial pipes and valves on
a white wall.]
[Illuminated metallic spherical drone with intricate frame structure against a dark background.]
Keep Your People Out. Get Better Data In

The safest confined space inspection eliminates human entry entirely. FEDS indoor drones navigate
GPS-denied environments with full collision tolerance, capturing 4K visual and thermal data across
surfaces that rope access teams routinely miss. Onboard gas detection sensors continuously monitor
the atmosphere throughout each flight — adding a layer of safety data that traditional entry methods
simply don't capture.

From Raw Data to Reports You Can Act On

Every FEDS indoor inspection produces geo-located, 3D-mapped findings — not a folder of disconnected
photos. Defects are annotated directly on a point cloud model of your asset, with measurements and
location tags attached. Your engineering team receives a structured, digital inspection report
faster than any scaffolding-based alternative can be mobilised.

[Person wearing an orange safety jacket and white hard hat, with 'FEDS Drone-powered Solutions' logo
on the back against a clear blue sky.]

## Inspection Capabilities

### LiDAR Mapping & 3D Point Clouds

[Person wearing safety goggles viewing a tablet screen displaying a colorful 3D point cloud and
inspection data.]

Integrated LiDAR sensors build centimetre-accurate, real-time 3D maps as the drone flies — no GPS
required. The output is a navigable point cloud your team can use for dimensional analysis, volume
measurement, and defect tracking across inspection cycles.

### 4K Visual & Thermal Imaging

[A drone with a protective wire cage flying inside an industrial facility near large equipment and
pipes.]

4K cameras with integrated thermal sensors and high-output oblique lighting reveal corrosion,
cracking, weld defects, and heat anomalies in complete darkness. Engineered specifically for
low-visibility industrial environments where standard cameras fail.

### GPS-Denied Navigation & Collision Tolerance

[Worker in orange safety jacket and white helmet kneeling and operating inspection drone in a dimly
lit industrial setting.]

Visual-inertial odometry, radar, and LiDAR-based stabilisation allow confident navigation inside
metal tanks, tunnels, and pipe arrays where GPS fails entirely. Collision-tolerant cage designs
protect the drone — and the asset — in tight, complex environments.

### Security
### and Compliance

[Drone flying over desert terrain near a white vehicle with Dubai Civil Aviation Authority logos
under a cloudy sky, with text stating compliance with international and local standards.]

Aligned with UAE aviation and municipal regulations, FEDS is an ISO 21384-3:2023, ISO 9001, ISO
14001, ISO 45001 and ISO 27001 certified entity.

## Technical Capabilities

### Mobile Mapping
### ‍

Vehicle-mounted LiDAR and imaging capture roads, infrastructure corridors, and built environments at
scale — point clouds, 360° imagery, and asset inventory in one mobilisation.

### Ground Penetrading Radar

Non-destructive detection of buried utilities, subsurface voids, and concrete structures. Output
integrates directly into GIS and CAD for UAE municipality submissions.

### Bathymetric & Marine Survey

Multibeam sonar maps seabeds, harbours, and coastal zones with sub-decimetre accuracy — bathymetric
DEMs, hydrographic charts, and GIS layers to port authority standards.

### Handheld LiDAR & 3D Laser Scanning

SLAM-based handheld scanners capture tunnels, interiors, and confined zones — with the same accuracy
and coordinate format as the rest of the project dataset.

# A Closer Look at Drone-based Facade Inspections

Discover how drone facade inspections improve safety, accuracy, and efficiency in this in-depth case
study on drone-based building assessments.
Heading 2
][51]
Heading 3
][52]
Heading 4
][53]
Heading 5
][54]
Heading 6
][55]

A building with a stunning facade is indeed a visual treat. Facades are significant, not just
aesthetically but also considering safety, especially with high-rise buildings. Furthermore, facades
can be even more complicated with skyscrapers due to the complexity of the mix of materials used –
concrete, glass, steel, and more. Any issues with these facades may arise during the construction or
over time. This is why Facade inspection is crucial; it helps us verify a building structure’s
competency; it helps us identify property issues before they become “problems”.

[dubai skyline with skyscrapers and burj khalifa as focus ]

But we can’t really afford to move ahead with the same old time-consuming, labor-intensive, costly
traditional practices anymore – Let us do the job for you… let our drone-powered solutions do the
job for you! Unlike the conventional facade inspection methods, drone-based facade inspections make
the operation Safer, Efficient, and way more Cost-effective. Besides identifying structural
deterioration, faults and flaws, drone data can also be used to record historical information,
produce 3D point clouds, create comprehensive building-compliance documents, and much more.
Moreover, drones’ automated mode of operation and the ability for real-time monitoring increase
flexibility and efficiency. With a drone, it’s a simple act of swapping payloads to attain a
complete picture of your building facades. So let’s dive deep into the drone-based facade
inspections.

### **Why is Facade Inspection Important?**

Knowing about the increasing cases of building-facade accidents from different parts of the world is
really concerning. Likewise, we found several [research papers][56] and articles highlighting
crucial public safety issues due to falling objects from tall residential buildings. These tragedies
underline the importance of maintaining building infrastructures.

Knowing about the existing and potential issues is crucial to ensuring the safety, aesthetics and
value of a building, as it helps the stakeholders to make timely actions. In addition, it can
identify property issues before they become “problems”. While this provides some assurance to
owners, tenants, and the public alike— it remains vital for building owners, engineers, and
corporations to identify problems and provide visibility into their buildings.

### **How to perform a Facade Inspection?**

Regulations usually differ depending on the country, state, or even city. Also, in some countries,
the requirements for periodic facade inspections are driven more by insurance companies. However,
the inspection regulations usually depend on the building size and age. General issues that we look
for in a facade inspection:
* Any instances of water infiltration through the gaps between different building materials, cracks,
and more.
* Chances of facade elements fall on the ground; loose or damaged facade elements might fall,
creating concern about public safety and questions about the integrity of the building.
* Water staining or cracking on the interior of the building.
* Efflorescence of the building facade elements.
* Discolouration or hollowness of the facade elements.

### **Drone-based Facade Inspections v/s Traditional Inspection**

Generally, the timeline of a traditional facade assessment per property is 30 days; that’s where the
time, cost and labour are focused. Traditionally, you’d need specialized equipment that is expensive
to purchase, maintain and operate. A typical review includes visual inspection from the ground –
with high-end binoculars, and physical inspection using a boom lift, scaffolding, or rope access.
During the physical assessment, suspected areas of the building will be sounded with a hammer to
define hollow areas and the severity of the damage.

In a traditional facade inspection, the findings of the final assessment are presented as a summary
detailing each building’s current conditions, along with recommendations for its betterment.
Unfortunately, it’s not as smooth as it may sound. It is time-consuming, costly and
labour-intensive. Moreover, the results of manual facade inspection are inconsistent, depending on
the inspector’s expertise. Especially given the heat— traditional façade inspection of a 40-story
tower is an absolute nightmare.

Unlike conventional facade inspection, drone-based facade inspections make the operations Safer,
Efficient, Accurate, and way more Cost-effective. Moreover, the automated mode of operation and the
ability for real-time monitoring make it even more flexible and efficient.

## **Drone-based Facade Inspection with FEDS**

With a drone, it’s a simple act of swapping payloads! With drones, what generally took months, is
now possible in a matter of a few days, with more reliability, precision and efficiency. For
example, the [FEDS][57] team performed a facade Inspection in downtown Dubai. The mission was to
digitally reproduce the entire building’s facade to cross-check whether all the apartments were
sound and safe.

The mission area was huge; it had three zones comprising 33 buildings (the tallest building in the
mission area was 280 metres tall). A traditional facade inspection would have been incredibly
challenging in this scenario – it is difficult to see and capture data from the ground; likewise,
some of the building zones would have been difficult to assess either from eye level or from the
roof.

Based on the height and the number of buildings per zone, the FEDS inspection team divided
themselves into groups. With one of the best drones in the market – the [DJI M300 RTK][58] paired
with a powerful thermal sensor – DJI Zenmuse H2OT; the drone operators captured the data of the
assigned buildings in a matter of minutes – depending on the height. Team FEDS completed the on-site
inspection within six days and submitted the final report in another six days. The drone-based
facade inspections enabled the client to view, evaluate, and make better-informed decisions
regarding their properties.

[different defects detected highlighted with a red circle in a building with facade inspection ]

###### The deliverables of the mission included:
* HD visual data of building facades
* HD geotagged inspection asset imagery
* 3D building point cloud model
* Infrared Scanning for Moisture and Water Infiltration
* Historic Preservation Mapping and Modeling
* Facade assessment summary for individual buildings
* Comprehensive facade inspection portfolio

FEDS provided an inspection report containing all the issues along with their location coordinates,
allowing us to track each issue quickly. Likewise, the inspectors could readily share the results
with all stakeholders too.

[infographic of key results from the facade inspection conducted in a dubai downtown building]

No more safety concerns; drones can just fly around and capture high-resolution images and videos.
Besides identifying structural deterioration, faults and flaws, drone data can also be used to
record historical information, produce 3D point clouds, create comprehensive building-compliance
documents, and much more. Drones paired with infrared sensors detect instances of water infiltration
and also help us have a clearer picture of hidden structural elements.

Regarding Facade Inspections, we at FEDS focus on the facade assessment, documentation, and
quantification of errors found. Our clients use the results to work on budgeting, phasing, and
scheduling repair/maintenance work.

Are you looking forward to examining the integrity of your buildings? It’s time to work together –
get in touch with us.

# Drone Disaster Response in Beirut's Recovery | FEDS Case Study

See how drones supported Beirut’s disaster recovery, enhancing relief efforts, damage assessment,
and response efficiency in this case study.
Heading 2
][51]
Heading 3
][52]
Heading 4
][53]
Heading 5
][54]
Heading 6
][55]

One year ago, on August 4, 2020, a large amount of ammonium nitrate stored at the port of Beirut,
Lebanon’s capital, exploded, killing at least 218 people, injuring 7,500, displacing an estimated
300,000 people. The blast that was felt all the way in Cyprus 300 kilometers away shook the capital
and caused widespread destruction of property. The explosion flipped cars and stripped the cladding
off steel-framed buildings. The blast damaged homes up to ten kilometers away. The rampant damage
was hard to fathom, much less- map accurately. Still, surveying the affected regions is a necessity
that would facilitate relief and restoration projects.

[sun shining on a destroyed Beirut port after the gas explosion]

To help with the restoration of affected regions, [FEDS- Drone Powered Solutions][56] partnered with
Geospatial Minds and traveled to Lebanon to map the city. In this article we’ll explore the role
played by Drones and GIS in Disaster Mitigation and Recovery.

### GIS and Disaster Mitigation

GIS data and tools have tremendous potential to save lives, limit damage, and reduce the cost of
dealing with disasters. Gathering precise and accurate data can be challenging, especially in the
wake of a calamity. The significance of GIS in disaster management was realized in August 1992 when
Hurricane Andrew swept through southern Florida.

The hurricane left a trail of destruction throughout the region. GIS was first used to map damage
and analyze community demographics. Later, as the potential of GIS became more apparent, its
application expanded into areas such as public assistance and disaster mitigation. Now GIS is
involved in every stage of Disaster Planning.

#### Mitigation

Mitigation strategies help reduce the impact of disasters by safeguarding human lives and reducing
property damage. Using GIS, you can find optimal locations for emergency headquarters like police
stations, fire stations, and hospitals. Essentially, what you get is a Dynamic Risk Map program that
provides accurate data to stakeholders and partners.

#### Preparedness

Geography information systems (GIS) and remote sensing are key components of the pre-disaster
strategy. The ability to determine high-risk areas and be prepared in advance is critical. GIS
enables a more efficient and effective response to emergencies. You also have access to a geospatial
database for populations, businesses, structures and schools which can be consulted in case of an
emergency.

#### Response

Even if you’re prepared for every scenario, determining the exact scale of damage caused by a
disaster is never a sure thing. As a result, post-disaster response models heavily rely on accurate
and real-time data. GIS is also required to visualize the most efficient pick-up and evacuation
routes for survivors.

#### Disaster Recovery

Once the immediate emergency is dealt with, all that remains is to restore a state of normalcy to
the affected regions. GIS plays a crucial role in disaster recovery as well-it provides a
comprehensive overview of the affected areas- and long-term goals can be tackled systematically.

All disasters have a spatial component to them- Successful response starts with a map. GIS enables
you to plan, analyze and take action across all stages of disaster mitigation. To the survivors, it
is a vital line of communication through which they can seek safety. You can find instances of maps
being used to deliver critical information to those affected, like electricity outage maps after
Hurricane Sandy. GIS integrates multiple layers of information and displays them in an
easy-to-digest format.

### How Drones Help in Disaster Mitigation and Recovery

https://youtu.be/GcJl43XJEBc?si=0v_4HeIiMBMP-v5G

When disaster strikes, [commercial drones][57] can help solve problems humans on foot or in vehicles
just can’t reach. For example, in 2016, wildfires in Fort McMurray forced 88,000 people to evacuate
their homes. At first, [aerial mapping services][58] were used to identify which areas were damaged
so emergency responders could prioritize their efforts. But these maps only covered small parts of
town and took many hours to produce.

As we established, Geospatial data is a critical component of any disaster recovery plan.
Understanding the geographical impact of an event helps aid organizations prioritize and implement
disaster response efforts. However, it’s too dangerous to send humans to survey an area in many
instances or is simply too expensive or time-intensive for other methods like GPS or satellite.
Luckily, unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), or drones, can help collect geospatial data that would be
impossible or too risky to obtain by sending humans into affected areas.

Drones happen to be faster, safer, and more accurate- these three attributes are precious following
a disaster.

#### Faster

It’s vital to get an effective map up and running so rescue and recovery operations can commence as
soon as possible. If it isn’t safe enough for humans or even manned flight/chopper missions, drone
operators can fly in and survey areas quickly and effectively.

#### Safer

Because they can travel into unsafe areas for humans to enter, drones provide survey data and images
of disaster sites that can assist in planning recovery efforts. Additionally, using different
sensors like IR or Thermal can provide greater visibility into critical situations. Drones in
disaster response are still relatively new, but they could soon become standard practice.

#### Accurate

[Professional survey grade drones][59] come built-in with tools and features that provide increased
accuracy like PPK and RTK. This means that you obtain accurate georeferenced, enabling you to plan
and rescue or restore with pinpoint accuracy. In addition, using photogrammetry, you can create 3D
reality captures or orthomosaic maps, which help you assess structural damage and guide subsequent
missions.

Disasters can be devastating. Add in time lost to rebuilding, and it can take years before a
community is back on its feet. But drones are becoming more widely used every day— helping us do
things faster, cheaper, and more efficiently than ever before.

Nikin Mohan James, FEDS’s operations manager and Rabih Bou Rached- a native of Lebanon, and FEDS’s
founder and CEO would get an opportunity to help nearly two months after the disaster. This data

multiple angles- making it critical for restoration missions.

It was an incredibly poignant experience to see the devastation suffered. The first task would be to
identify the affected area that required mapping. They determined a 6 sqkm area that required
surveying and mapping. The next challenge would be to find the ideal ground station setup to enable
them to launch the drone safely and efficiently.

Finding a suitable drone take-off and landing location would be a real challenge. The site is a
densely populated area littered with high-rise buildings, making a routine drone take-off and
landing much more complicated and hazardous.

take-off technology would help in an urban setting. The FEDS Team determined that launching from
ground level in the middle of a city would be incredibly challenging and found a suitable elevated
area. The team found a suitable site- the helipad of Saint George Hospital University Medical
Center. Located at the heart of the city and 45m from the ground, the helipad would enable the team
