# TWO-BLADED MAIN ROTOR with All-metal Edging

## to be installed on helicopters with up to
## 140 kg take-off mass and rotor diameter
## of 3200 mm (126")

Gallery ][15]

### OVERVIEW

The state-of-the-art carbon main rotor blades are produced with latest carbon multi- cross-layer
technology using a curing oven.

The highly efficient carbon main rotor blades have been designed by gluing an all-metal edging into
the leading edge. The blades are fully interchangeable and carry a life-limit of 2,600 hours.

Due to the industrial production process the main rotor blades have long-life endurance, the
enhanced aerodynamic performance, the increased wear resistance under severe weather conditions. The
blades have superior behavior under extreme maneuvers.

### SPECIFICATIONS

**Length:**

1453 mm

**Width:**

100-50 mm

**Thickness:**

16.5-6 mm

**Root thickness:**

16-16.5 mm

**Mounting Hole Size:**

12 mm

**Rotation:**

Left (CCW) or right (CW)

**Twist:**

9.5°

**Material:**

Carbon fiber (prepreg)

**Max. RPM:**

1300

**Weight:**

0.94 ± 0.05 kg/blade

**MTOW (2 blades):**

140 kg

## ALPIN UNMANNED HELICOPTER

## a joint project of TITRA, a Turkish
## engineering company, and UAVOS

Gallery ][15]
Video ][16]

Alpin VTOL UAS has been created in accordance with the needs and requirements of the Turkish Rescue
& Security industry. The Alpin UAS is a long-range, heavy-lift unmanned helicopter capable of
carrying up to 160 kg with a range of up to 840 km. The converted Alpin UAS is based on the piloted
helicopter.

### ADVANTAGES

Night operations and flights under severe weather conditions
All terrain capable
Primed for ease operations
Meeting operational requirements
Low life cycle costs

Remote Ground Controls network capability
Simultaneous multi-UAV operation
Customizable software and SDK
Auto-rotation landing capability and high efficiency flight control, based on TECS
Redundant autopilot system

Payload Options:
* EO/IR
* RADARS SAR/GMTI
* LIDAR
* HYPERSPECTRAL

### APPLICATION
* Video surveillance and monitoring
* Autonomous cargo transportation and delivery
* Cargo dropping up to 160 kg (353 lbs) at specified location
* Radio relay
* Agricultural operations using spraying equipment
* Flying R&D laboratory (meteorology, hydrology, earth monitoring, etc.)

# ALBATROSS 2.2

## Fixed Wing UAV

Gallery ][15]
Video ][16]

Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) UAS with a long flight duration about 20h with 88 lb (40 kg)
payload.

### OVERVIEW

The aircraft is designed for long-endurance missions in conditions of high turbulence and overloads.
The reinforced fuselage and landing gear are engineered for harsh landings, including on grass
airfields or prepared sites.
Take-off, route flight, and landing are carried out in fully automated mode.
Proprietary Autopilot.
The ALBATROSS UAV is equipped with satellite communication data link for Beyond Line of Sight
(BVLOS) operation.
Resistance to jamming.

### BENEFITS

Low cost of flying hour

The reliability of certified devices increases the reliability of the entire UAV system as a whole

The availability of a large network of dealer centers and spare parts stores

The conversion reduces the production time for an UAV

### APPLICATION
* Day and Night operations
* Cargo delivery
* Locating poachers and unauthorised activity in National Parks and other wildlife areas
* All kinds of Surveillance including communications interception
* Disaster Help – Civilian Support
* Maritime/Coastal Patrol
* SAR Operation and Victim discovery

# pMDDLRadio
# DATA LINK SYSTEM

## an advanced high power
## long range broadband COFDM
## communication system for UAV

### OVERVIEW

The pMDDLRadio Digital Data Link is a miniature, high power, long range broadband COFDM complete
wireless solution. Based on the new Microhard pMDDL core, it provides the bandwidth and range needed
for complex data intensive applications. The pMDDLRadio features 1W 2X2 MIMO 2.4GHz, using Maximal
Ratio Combining (MRC), Maximal Likelihood (ML) decoding and Low-Density Parity Check (LDPC) to
achieve robust RF performance.

The miniature, lightweight and rugged design is a reliable communication partner for unmanned
applications, both UAS and USV. The high speed, long range capabilities of the pMDDLRadio allow
simultaneous high quality duplex transmission of full HD video and control \ telemetry data.

Typical range with skew planar wheel antennas is 9 km [6 mi], longer range (up to 200 km [124 mi])
is available using high gain antennas / RF amplifiers / automatic tracking masts.

Typical set for 8-9 km range includes:

— 2x on-board omni-directional 5 dBi antennas (30 g x 2 / 0.066 lb x 2)

— 2x ground panel LAN antennas 14 dBi (430 g x 2 / 0.95 lbs. x 2)

— Drone and ground modems in the same design

— Required companion connectors

— Antenna cables

— Required LAN / RS cables (details TBD with customer)

### APPLICATIONS
* Unmanned BVLoS missions
* Emergency communication deployment
* Ethernet Wireless Extension
* Wireless Telemetry
* Wireless Video
* Wireless Control Systems

### FEATURES
* 2X2 MIMO high power 1W COFDM RF output
* External RF amplifiers support
* Rigid-Flex IMU board support
* Automatic tracking antenna support
* MicroSD for telemetry data recording (aka Black-box)
* RTC Clock with battery backup (200 hrs)
* Data Rates > 25 Mbps
* Adjustable Total Output Power (up to 1W)
* Maximal Ratio Combining (MRC)
* Maximal Likelihood (ML) decoding
* Low-Density Parity Check (LDPC)
* Small Footprint
* Lightweight
* Point-to-Point, Point-to-Multipoint
* Master, Remote, Relay (Future) Modes
* Low Power Consumption
* Simultaneous IP & Serial Data

### MODEM SPECIFICATION
* Duplex transmitter and receiver (2xMIMO)
* Dual MIMO antenna ports
* Operating range up to 8 km [5 mi] line-of-sight (The range depends on an ambient condition,
electromagnetic situation, radio interference within the area. In case automatic tracking mast is
not used, the range is guaranteed only within the HFOV of antenna)
* Frequency range: 2.402 - 2.478 GHz
* Encryption: 128-bit AES (Optional)
* Software selectable output power from 7 dBm to 30 dBm
* Up to 25 Mbps IPerf Throughput @ 8 MHz channel (-78 dBm)
* Up to 2 Mbps IPerf Throughput @ 4 MHz channel (-102 dBm)
* Software selectable MIMO on/off

### INTERFACES AND PORTS
* Serial Data/Console: 1 x transparent 3.3V TTL UART 300bps to 921kbps (Pixhawk support)
* Ethernet: Dual 10/100BaseT IEEE802.3 (LAN/WAN)
* Serial data prioritized over video data and has better sensitivity (additional modulation codes)
* STM32H743/53 onboard system controller with 4Mbit MRAM (allows customization of interfaces)
* Designated controller for automatic directional tracking antenna system (2 or 3-axes)
* External RF amplifiers support (provision for manual or automatic Tx/Rx switching)
* SPI interface: Rigid-Flex IMU board connection support (AHRS for tracking antenna & autopilot)
* Firewall: Port Forwarding, Access Control, IP/MAC List
* Diagnostics: Remote Diagnostics, Ping, Traceroute, ARP table, DHCP active leases, IPerf, RSSI
* Management: Local Serial Port Console, Telnet, WebUI, SNMP, FTP Upgrade, TFTP, CLI
* Designated interfaces for communication with autopilot, control system and ground station:
— 2 x CAN
— 1 x RS422
— 1 x RS485/RS232
— 1 x USB2.0
— GPIO: 8 x GPIO through transceiver, 4 x GPIO through level shifter
— Differential analog input: 1

### MECHANICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL FEATURES

##### ENCLOSED VERSION
* Weight, modem only: 90 g [0.198 lb]
* Dimensions: 90.5x70.7x18.2 mm [3.56x2.79x0.72 in]
* Sealed enclosure: rugged anodized aluminum-alloy
* Integrated pressure balance valve
* Ingress protection: meets IP65
* Temperature: -40°C to +50°C [-40°F to +122°F]
* Humidity: 95%, non-condensing
* Military connectors: Harwin M80 and RF - Hirose

### POWER FEATURES
* Full modem output power (30 dBm) at wide range of input voltage: 5-58 VDC
* Maximum power consumption @30 dBm in 2xMIMO mode and full process load: 10W
* Overvoltage protection: 58-80 V @5s of stable operation.

# AP 10.1

## Automatic Control System for UAV with a takeoff weight of 100 kg up to 4000 kg

### OVERVIEW

The Automatic Control System (AP) provides the hardware and vehicle control abstraction layer for
the host platform enabling fully autonomous operation. All flight systems including take-off,
landing, navigation and mission execution can be instigated with a single keystroke. All
diagnostics, flight mission planning and remote control can be achieved wirelessly.

A notable feature of the AP is its distributed architecture. Each component of the system has a
dedicated microcontroller providing data and communication with other components within the CAN bus.
This decentralized configuration helps to manage central processor loading by distributing routine
management tasks across all system components. Additionally, there are no restrictions on the number
of same-type modules connected to one system, enabling multiple redundancy on all levels. With
nearly all payloads or ready-made third-party modules, entire systems can be connected to the AP.

##### **FLEXIBILITY & SCALABILITY**

Thanks to the AP’s distributed architecture, the system can be used in a wide variety of vehicles
ranging from small quadcopter to full size converted piloted aircraft. The redundant layering
provides basic functionality while ground control software is multi-platform and functions across
multiple workstations in a both a wide or local area network configuration. Specific
payloads/sensors can be integrated by scripting custom protocols through onboard Virtual Machines
(VMs).

##### **COMPATIBILITY**

The AP is compatible with almost any vehicle configuration (VTOLs, USVs, UGVs, etc.), including
non-traditional aircraft concepts. The flight control algorithm relies on Total Energy Control
System (TECS) for improved reliability and response to malfunction including automatic landing with
engine failure, auto-rotation for helicopters and parachute deployment. The AP is resilient against
jamming and features precise dead-reckoning navigation in absence of a GNSS signal.

Payload of almost any type can be connected and controlled using the interfaces:
* 1-Wire
* RS-232
* RS-485
* UART
* CAN

### KEY FEATURES
* control of actuating mechanisms
* engine control
* semi-automatic control with automatic stabilization of the vehicles
* manual control using the main 928MHz communication channel
* from ground control station (GCU)
* control of the vehicles object in emergency mode
* payload control
* payload feedback
* control of rotating platforms in gyro-stabilization mode using AP10.1
* receipt and transfer of telemetric data between GCU and the vehicles
* simulation mode
* flight simulator
* onboard power control
* power stabilization
* conversion
* power distribution, including emergency power supply mode
* onboard power monitoring

### SPECIFICATIONS

### Available Interfaces:
* up to 15 x servo drives (PWM control)
* 2x inputs for RPM sensor (Hall-effect sensors)
* 1-Wire interface
* TTL UART interface
* RS-485 interface
* Controller area network - CAN
* RS-232 interface
* Low-side power output (3.7A, @ 20V, 68MOhm)
* 3x digital inputs (timing, level)
* 5x general purpose inputs-outputs (remappable on MCU)

# AP 10.2

## Automatic Control System for UAV with a takeoff weight of 15 kg up to 100 kg

### OVERVIEW

The **AP 10.2** system is designed to control a surface, ground or airborne platform automatically,
semi-automatically or manually.

The system is configurable for the following platforms:
* Standard airplane for automatic take-off and landing
* Rotor-wings for automatic take-off and landing
* Balloons, Blimps
* USVs (boats)
* UGVs (cars)
The **AP 10.2** was designed for small platforms and has the following advantages:
* reduced form factors (avionics weight less then 350 g)
* reduced energy consumption
Most payload can be interfaced through:
* 1-Wire
* RS-232
* RS-485
* TTL UART
* CAN

### KEY FEATURES
* Very small size and lightweight
* ESD protection
* Leading edge components and technologies
* Dead-reckoning, flight and navigation without GPS
* Automatic take-off and automatic landing
* Operating/flight mechanisms controls
* Engine/power plant control
* Semi-automatic control with automatic stabilization
* Manual control over 928MHz from ground control station
* Emergency mode
* Payload control
* Payload feedback
* Gyro-stabilization mode for rotating platforms
* Telemetry 10Hz with compressed stream, 100km LOS
* Ground simulation mode – flight simulator
* Operator training on flight simulator
* Pre-flight and flight assignment testing
* Onboard power control and monitoring
* Power stabilization
* Distribution, including emergency power supply mode

### SPECIFICATIONS

### Interfaces and characteristics:
* 12x servo drives (PWM outputs)
* 12x RPM sensor inputs (hall effect sensor)
* 1-Wire interface
* TTL UART interface
* RS-485 interface
* Controller area network - CAN
* RS-232 interface
* 4x Active-ground switched power output (4.7a, @ 27V, 68mOhm)
* 12x digital inputs (timing, level)
* 12x general purpose inputs-outputs (remappable on MCU)

# ApusDuo aircraft

ApusDuo is a solar-powered stratospheric High Altitude Pseudo Satellite (HAPS), developed by UAVOS.
Its persistence enables a capability of flying continuously for months at a time, at around 20,000
m, above weather and conventional air traffic.

ApusDuo relies on solar energy, with the batteries charged in daylight to power overnight flight.

ApusDuo is aimed to provide a wide scope of applications in Connectivity, Earth observation,
Weather, Security, Natural Resources and Emergency Disaster management.

The ApusDuo HAPS project became part of **Mira Aerospace**.

To find out more about ApusDuo visit** ****[Mira Aerospace][15]**.

# UVH 170

## 4-stroke gasoline engine Helicopter
## with MTOW up to 45 kg

Gallery ][15]
Video 1 ][16]

### OVERVIEW

The UVH 170 is an industrial grade helicopter with a four-stroke gasoline engine equipped with an
injector and a generator – starter.
Take-off and landing as well as mission are carried out automatically.
Optional semi-automatic control.
Emergency operation modes.
Diagnostics, flight planning and remote control can be performed via a wireless network connection.
Proprietary Autopilot.
The UVH 170 was specially designed with better engine cooling to perform in a tropical climate in a
hot and moist environment.

### APPLICATION
* Video surveillance and monitoring
* Payload delivery
* Radio link range extension and retransmission
* R&D flying laboratory (meteorology, hydrology, earth monitoring, etc.)

# SERVO ACTUATOR
# XSERVO140

Video ][15]

### OVERVIEW

Xservo-Series lightweight, Hollow Shaft Servo Actuators features embedded CANopen / EtherCAT servo
drive.

The advantage of this series is:
— the built-in motion controller, which allows the customer to skip the complex stage of mechanical
and electrical integration of a passive servo actuator with an external servo drive controller
— a versatile hollow shaft that makes it easy to pass power supply cables, shafts or laser beams
directly through the servo actuator.

New actuators are immune to shock and vibration and designed for use in harsh conditions.

### APPLICATIONS
* Automation and robotics
* Power movement of UAV control surfaces and elements

### SUPPORTED CONTROL MODES
* Cyclic Synchronous Position
* Cyclic Synchronous Velocity
* Cyclic Synchronous Torque
* Profile Position
* Profile Velocity

### SERVO ACTUATOR TELEMETRY DATA
* Position, speed
* Supply Voltage
* Current (RMS, Phase)
* Motor & power stage temperature

### SERVO ACTUATOR FEATURES
* Hollow shaft1
* Electromagnetic brake
* Shunt braking resistor
* Reverse polarity protection

¹hollow shaft that makes it easy to pass power supply cables, shafts or laser beams directly through
the servo actuator.

# GSG 201

## Gyro-stabilized two-axis gimbal for day and night surveillance,
## with Laser Rangefinder

Gallery ][15]
Video ][16]

### OVERVIEW

Gyro-stabilized two-axis gimbal with integrated 30x Optical Zoom Full HD (1080/ 60p) Block Camera,
Thermal LWIR 1024x768 cameras, Laser rangefinder 2500 m and Onboard Processing Unit. The
optoelectronic onboard unit is designed to perform complex missions and is ideally suited for a wide
range of applications, including prospecting, surveillance, and mapping.

### FEATURES
* Weight: 3.5 kg
* Size: 323 x 200mm
* Super rugged design: Precision machined aluminium structure
* Antivibration frame
* Environmental protection: IP65
* Drying cartridge
* Direct drive stabilization
* Absolute encoder
* Rotation limits: 360°+
* Fully integrated video auto-tracker
* Operational temperature range: -40 … +50°С
* Supply voltage: 12-27V
* Power consumption: 60W
* High-quality onboard video record
* Removable flash card

# PTP140

## Pan Tilt Platform

Video 1 ][15]
Video 2 ][16]
Video 3 ][17]

### OVERVIEW

The heavy-duty precision Pan Tilt Platform is a two - axis positioning system designed to withstand
harsh and extreme environmental and weather conditions.

State-of-the-art built-in control electronics and algorithms provide precise, smooth motion at all
speeds, while an integrated slip ring allows continuous rotation of the pan axis.

The body of the unit is made of high quality painted aluminum (or Saltwater Resistant Aluminum
Alloy) with rugged hermetic circular military connectors.

### APPLICATION
* Two-axes platform for balanced payloads up to 130 kg
* Payloads types: EO/IR, Antenna, Laser and similar systems

### SUPPORTED CONTROL INTERFACES & PROTOCOLS
* Ethernet (EtherCAT)
* CAN (CANopen, CANaerospace)
* RS422/485 (Modbus)
* Profile Position
* Profile Velocity

### FEATURES
* Hollow shaft for cables
* Electromagnetic brake for each of the axes
* Two-axes Gyro Stabilization (possible on request)
* GPS/GNSS True Heading (possible on request)

company.name: UAVOS
company.description: UAVOS is a company specializing in the development and manufacturing of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) and related technologies.
company.tagline: Innovative Solutions for Unmanned Systems

products.name: Servo Drive SD3
products.description: Servo drive designed for UAVs with a takeoff weight of less than 60 kg, used for controlling UAV surfaces and elements.

products.name: SAT-i
products.description: Solar-powered fixed-wing UAV capable of continuous flight during daylight hours, designed for mapping and surveillance.

products.name: Drone-Capture Net System
products.description: System designed to capture and retrieve small drones using a net, ideal for securing sensitive areas.

products.name: Ground Control Station GCS.A
products.description: A command center for unmanned systems installed in a modified 20-foot container, providing all necessary equipment for mission operations.
features: Autonomous operating time up to 48 hours

products.name: UAV-170 Engine
products.description: 4-stroke gasoline engine designed for UAV integration, featuring advanced fuel injection and cooling systems.

products.name: GSG 140D Gimbal
products.description: Three-axis gyro-stabilized gimbal for day surveillance with integrated FHD video camera and 30x optical zoom.

products.name: GSG 140T Gimbal
products.description: Three-axis gyro-stabilized gimbal for night surveillance with thermal camera capabilities.

products.name: SITARIA E
products.description: Fixed-wing unmanned electric aircraft with automatic takeoff and landing, designed for various applications including mapping and surveillance.

products.name: Two-Bladed Main Rotor
products.description: Main rotor blades designed for helicopters with up to 50 kg take-off mass, featuring advanced carbon multi-cross-layer technology.

products.name: Two-Bladed Main Rotor with All-metal Edging
products.description: Main rotor blades with all-metal edging for helicopters with up to 50 kg take-off mass, designed for durability and performance.

products.name: Alpin Unmanned Helicopter
products.description: A long-range, heavy-lift unmanned helicopter capable of carrying up to 160 kg with a range of up to 840 km, designed for the Turkish Rescue & Security industry.

products.name: Albatross 2.2
products.description: Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) UAS designed for long-endurance missions with a flight duration of about 20 hours and a payload capacity of 40 kg.

products.name: pMDDLRadio Data Link System
products.description: An advanced high power long range broadband COFDM communication system for UAVs, providing robust RF performance for unmanned applications.

products.name: AP 10.1
products.description: The Automatic Control System (AP) provides the hardware and vehicle control abstraction layer for the host platform enabling fully autonomous operation.
features: Manual control using the main 928MHz communication channel

products.name: AP 10.2
products.description: The AP 10.2 system is designed to control a surface, ground or airborne platform automatically, semi-automatically or manually.

products.name: ApusDuo
products.description: ApusDuo is a solar-powered stratospheric High Altitude Pseudo Satellite (HAPS), developed by UAVOS.
features: Applications in Connectivity, Earth observation, Weather, Security

products.name: ERS-75
products.description: Drone parachute systems designed for UAV recovery and safety measures in case of catastrophic failure.

products.name: UVH-500 (KAHU-150)
products.description: A heavy-lift VTOL UAS capable of carrying payloads up to 140 kg with a range of 100 km.

products.name: UVH 170
products.description: An industrial grade helicopter with a four-stroke gasoline engine designed for various applications.

products.name: UVH 25EL
products.description: An industrial grade helicopter with an electric motor and Li-Ion rechargeable batteries, designed for various applications including video surveillance and payload delivery.
features: Diagnostics and flight planning via wireless connection
products.target_customers: Industries requiring UAV solutions for surveillance and monitoring.

products.name: Xservo140
products.description: Lightweight, Hollow Shaft Servo Actuator featuring embedded CANopen / EtherCAT servo drive, designed for automation and robotics applications.
features: Hollow shaft for easy cable passage

products.name: GSG 201
products.description: A two-axis gimbal for day and night surveillance with integrated cameras and laser rangefinder, suitable for complex missions.

products.name: PTP140
products.description: A heavy-duty precision two-axis positioning system designed for harsh environments, supporting various payloads.
features: Continuous rotation of the pan axis
products.target_customers: Industries requiring precise positioning systems for payloads.

products.name: Main Landing Gear
products.description: Advanced landing gear designed for unmanned aircraft weighing up to 1200 kg, made from aircraft prepreg carbon.

services.name: System Leases
services.description: UAVOS offers aircraft and sensing equipment for lease worldwide with end-to-end service support.

complex business data and actionable insights. When implemented effectively, it enables
organizations to consolidate data from multiple systems, standardize reporting, and deliver
real-time visibility into key performance indicators. Organizations often integrate data from ERP
systems, CRM platforms, finance tools, and operational databases into a centralized analytics
environment. With proper configuration, Power BI becomes a single interface where leadership teams
can track performance metrics, monitor operational trends, and evaluate strategic initiatives.

ongoing optimization, areas where consulting expertise becomes essential. What Happens During a

business objectives and existing data infrastructure. Consultants work closely with business
stakeholders to identify key performance indicators, reporting requirements, and data sources. This

# About Us

## We're a global community leveraging drone technology to transform health logistics.

Established in 2016, the UAV for Payload Delivery Working Group (UPDWG) is a vibrant community
founded and coordinated by [VillageReach][21]. The UPDWG community is made up of a diverse set of
members coming from drone companies, healthcare organizations, research institutions, and government
agencies among others.

Our members are united by a shared passion for collective progress, collaboration, and partnership.
Members gain access to valuable information, experiences, and resources, enabling them to push the
boundaries of drone logistics in health systems and beyond.

Learn more about [our members][22] and [join us][23] to be a part of the global movement driving the
transformative potential of drone logistics.

Its core products include solutions tailored for aviation, government, healthcare, and enterprise markets, such as Part 139 Inspections, Veoci CORE, and Vitals EM, all aimed at improving organizational resilience and operational efficiency. By offering a comprehensive suite of tools, Veoci empowers organizations to effectively manage crises and maintain continuity in their operations.

allied forces. It was taken over by the Govt. of India in 1954 under the Ministry of Health.

## End-to-End Aerial Intelligence & Drone Operations

## We Manage the Entire Drone Process for You

From mission planning to actionable insights, Volatus Aerospace delivers turnkey aerial solutions
that help organizations operate safer, smarter, and more efficiently

[ Talk To an Expert ][37]

### We don't just fly drones, we deliver outcomes. insights. results. intelligence.

## How Our Services Work

## We take care of everything from mission planning to intelligence delivery.

Our workflow is designed to ensure accurate data acquisition, operational efficiency, and actionable
outcomes. We combine aerial platforms, advanced sensors, and domain expertise to deliver end-to-end
solutions tailored to each project requirement.

## 01

## Requirement Consultation

We begin by understanding your operational objectives, site conditions, technical requirements, and
expected outcomes to define the right aerial solution.

## 02

## Scope Analysis & Mission Planning

Our specialists evaluate project feasibility, sensor requirements, regulatory constraints, flight
operations, and data deliverables to develop an optimized execution plan.

## 03

## Data Acquisition & Operations

Once aligned, our operations team deploys the appropriate UAV or crewed aerial platform to capture
high-quality geospatial, visual, thermal, or sensor-based data.

## 04

## Processing & Intelligence Delivery

Collected data is processed using advanced analytics and geospatial workflows to generate actionable
insights, technical reports, maps, models, and decision-ready intelligence, not just raw data.

Aerial Intelligence Services

## Aerial Intelligence Services

## Surveillance & Monitoring

Continuous or periodic aerial observation operations focused on real-time situational awareness,
activity detection, perimeter security, and operational monitoring over large areas or distributed
assets.
* Pipeline & Utility Corridor Surveillance
* Perimeter & Critical Infrastructure Monitoring
* Construction & Industrial Site Monitoring
* Traffic, Crowd & Public Safety Monitoring
* Remote Operations Monitoring

[ Learn More ][38]

## Asset Inspections

High-resolution condition assessment and defect identification of physical assets and infrastructure
using visual, thermal, LiDAR, and sensor-based aerial data acquisition.
* Energy & Utility Inspections
* Pipeline & Corridor Inspections
* Thermal & Infrared Inspections
* Gas Detection & Environmental Inspections
* Confined Space Inspections
[ Learn More ][39]

## Geomatics & Mapping

Acquisition and processing of accurate geospatial data for surveying, terrain modelling, mapping,
volumetric analysis, and digital twin generation.
* Photogrammetry & Orthomosaic Mapping
* Digital Twin & 3D Modelling
* Volumetric & Stockpile Analysis
* Change Detection & Site Monitoring
* GIS & Spatial Analytics

[ Learn More ][40]

## Logistics & Delivery

UAV-based transportation of payloads, equipment, medical supplies, and mission-critical materials
using autonomous or remotely piloted aerial logistics systems.
* Medical & Humanitarian Aid Supply
* Rural & Remote Area Logistics
* Urban Cargo Delivery
* Industrial & Commercial Logistics

[ Learn More ][41]

## Emergency & Disaster Response

Rapid deployment aerial operations for incident assessment, search and rescue support, hazard
monitoring, emergency coordination, and post-disaster intelligence gathering.
* Hazardous Area Reconnaissance
* Search & Rescue Support
* Emergency Situation Monitoring
* Flood & Disaster Assessment
* Wildfire Detection & Monitoring

[ Learn More ][42]

## Agriculture & Environmental Monitoring

Remote sensing and aerial analytics solutions for vegetation analysis, environmental assessment,
forestry management, crop intelligence, and natural resource monitoring.
* Crop Health Monitoring
* Multispectral Vegetation Analysis
* Wildfire Risk Assessment
* Deforestation Monitoring
* Biodiversity & Habitat Monitoring

[ Learn More ][43]

## Integrated Fleet & Operational Platforms

Our operations are supported by integrated aerial and ground-based acquisition platforms designed
for scalable monitoring, inspection, surveying, and geospatial intelligence operations.

### UAV Systems

Remotely piloted aerial platforms supporting flexible deployment across inspection, surveillance,
mapping, monitoring, and logistics operations.

### Crewed Aircraft

Manned aerial platforms supporting large-area coverage, long-endurance missions, specialized
sensing, and complex airborne operations.

### Fixed-Wing Aircraft

Supporting corridor mapping, regional surveillance, airborne LiDAR acquisition, and long-range
operational missions.

### Rotary-Wing Aircraft

Supporting low-altitude inspections, precision monitoring, rapid deployment, and
infrastructure-focused aerial operations.

### Mobile Geospatial Systems

Vehicle-mounted acquisition platforms supporting roadway mapping, corridor surveys, urban modelling,
and infrastructure intelligence operations.

### Terrestrial Survey Systems

Ground-based laser scanning and spatial acquisition systems supporting engineering surveys,
industrial modelling, and high-accuracy infrastructure documentation.

## Technical Capabilities

Our capabilities and multi-sensor approach enables deeper insight, earlier detection, and better
decision-making.

### AI Analytics

Automated defect detection and predictive data insights.

### Thermal Imaging

Inspections for fault detection.

### LiDAR

Mapping and digital twin modelling.

### BVLOS Operations

Extended-range data collection beyond VLOS.

### Corona UV

Detection for electrical discharge.

### RTK / PPK Positioning

High-precision centimeter-level geo-referencing accuracy.

### Photogrammetry

Image-based mapping and 3D reconstruction.

### Multispectral Imaging

Environmental, agricultural, and specialized crop/soil analysis.

### Live Streaming & Remote Operations

Real-time awareness and secure telemetry broadcasting.

### Gas Detection Sensors (OGI)

Optical Gas Imaging & methane detection.

### Edge Computing & Data Processing

Real-time compute for rapid localized sorting and safety.

### Digital Twin & 3D Modelling

Accurate virtual reconstructions of physical asset.

## Sentinel

## Autonomous Monitoring Platform

Volatus Sentinel provides an autonomous aerial monitoring system designed to support persistent
infrastructure inspection and monitoring operations. Sentinel systems integrate autonomous drone
operations with advanced monitoring technologies

### Autonomous Drone Docking & Launch

Autonomous drone docking and launch capability for persistent operations.

### Remote Connectivity

Remote connectivity through cellular and satellite communications.

### Secure Remote Monitoring

Secure remote monitoring and system management.

### PTZ Situational Awareness Cameras

## End-to-End Aerial Intelligence & Drone Operations

## We Manage the Entire Drone Process for You

From mission planning to actionable insights, Volatus Aerospace delivers turnkey aerial solutions
that help organizations operate safer, smarter, and more efficiently

[ Talk To an Expert ][37]

### We don't just fly drones, we deliver outcomes. insights. results. intelligence.

## How Our Services Work

## We take care of everything from mission planning to intelligence delivery.

Our workflow is designed to ensure accurate data acquisition, operational efficiency, and actionable
outcomes. We combine aerial platforms, advanced sensors, and domain expertise to deliver end-to-end
solutions tailored to each project requirement.

## 01

## Requirement Consultation

We begin by understanding your operational objectives, site conditions, technical requirements, and
expected outcomes to define the right aerial solution.

## 02

## Scope Analysis & Mission Planning

Our specialists evaluate project feasibility, sensor requirements, regulatory constraints, flight
operations, and data deliverables to develop an optimized execution plan.

## 03

## Data Acquisition & Operations

Once aligned, our operations team deploys the appropriate UAV or crewed aerial platform to capture
high-quality geospatial, visual, thermal, or sensor-based data.

## 04

## Processing & Intelligence Delivery

Collected data is processed using advanced analytics and geospatial workflows to generate actionable
insights, technical reports, maps, models, and decision-ready intelligence, not just raw data.

Aerial Intelligence Services

## Aerial Intelligence Services

## Surveillance & Monitoring

Continuous or periodic aerial observation operations focused on real-time situational awareness,
activity detection, perimeter security, and operational monitoring over large areas or distributed
assets.
* Pipeline & Utility Corridor Surveillance
* Perimeter & Critical Infrastructure Monitoring
* Construction & Industrial Site Monitoring
* Traffic, Crowd & Public Safety Monitoring
* Remote Operations Monitoring

[ Learn More ][38]

## Asset Inspections

High-resolution condition assessment and defect identification of physical assets and infrastructure
using visual, thermal, LiDAR, and sensor-based aerial data acquisition.
* Energy & Utility Inspections
* Pipeline & Corridor Inspections
* Thermal & Infrared Inspections
* Gas Detection & Environmental Inspections
* Confined Space Inspections
[ Learn More ][39]

## Geomatics & Mapping

Acquisition and processing of accurate geospatial data for surveying, terrain modelling, mapping,
volumetric analysis, and digital twin generation.
* Photogrammetry & Orthomosaic Mapping
* Digital Twin & 3D Modelling
* Volumetric & Stockpile Analysis
* Change Detection & Site Monitoring
* GIS & Spatial Analytics

[ Learn More ][40]

## Logistics & Delivery

UAV-based transportation of payloads, equipment, medical supplies, and mission-critical materials
using autonomous or remotely piloted aerial logistics systems.
* Medical & Humanitarian Aid Supply
* Rural & Remote Area Logistics
* Urban Cargo Delivery
* Industrial & Commercial Logistics

[ Learn More ][41]

## Emergency & Disaster Response

Rapid deployment aerial operations for incident assessment, search and rescue support, hazard
monitoring, emergency coordination, and post-disaster intelligence gathering.
* Hazardous Area Reconnaissance
* Search & Rescue Support
* Emergency Situation Monitoring
* Flood & Disaster Assessment
* Wildfire Detection & Monitoring

Remote sensing and aerial analytics solutions for vegetation analysis, environmental assessment,
forestry management, crop intelligence, and natural resource monitoring.

* Multispectral Vegetation Analysis
* Wildfire Risk Assessment

* Biodiversity & Habitat Monitoring

## Integrated Fleet & Operational Platforms

Our operations are supported by integrated aerial and ground-based acquisition platforms designed
for scalable monitoring, inspection, surveying, and geospatial intelligence operations.

### UAV Systems

Remotely piloted aerial platforms supporting flexible deployment across inspection, surveillance,
mapping, monitoring, and logistics operations.

### Crewed Aircraft

Manned aerial platforms supporting large-area coverage, long-endurance missions, specialized
sensing, and complex airborne operations.

### Fixed-Wing Aircraft

Supporting corridor mapping, regional surveillance, airborne LiDAR acquisition, and long-range
operational missions.

### Rotary-Wing Aircraft

Supporting low-altitude inspections, precision monitoring, rapid deployment, and
infrastructure-focused aerial operations.

### Mobile Geospatial Systems

Vehicle-mounted acquisition platforms supporting roadway mapping, corridor surveys, urban modelling,
and infrastructure intelligence operations.

### Terrestrial Survey Systems

Ground-based laser scanning and spatial acquisition systems supporting engineering surveys,
industrial modelling, and high-accuracy infrastructure documentation.

# Pioneering the
# Future of Aviation

Volatus Aerospace is shaping the global landscape of uncrewed flight through precision engineering,
uncompromising safety, and a legacy of aeronautical excellence.

## Built on Experience.
## Driven by the Future.

## Aviation Expertise & Operational Excellence

With deep roots in traditional aviation, Volatus Aerospace brings decades of operational, safety,
and regulatory expertise into the evolving uncrewed systems industry, building reliable solutions
trusted by commercial and defence partners worldwide.

## Bridging Innovation to Commercialization

Our Center of Excellence transforms emerging technologies into practical aviation solutions,
supporting the transition between crewed and uncrewed systems while enabling scalable innovation for
commercial and defence applications worldwide.

## Our Mission

**To deliver advanced aerial solutions through innovation, operational excellence, and a relentless
commitment to our stakeholders.**

## Our Vision

**To shape the future of intelligent aerial innovation worldwide.**

## A MESSAGE FROM OUR CEO

“We have built a team that is constantly pushing the boundaries of UAV technology, Counter-UAS
systems, defence innovation, and advanced aerospace solutions powered by AI intelligence and
advanced analytics. Our work spans inspection, imaging, data capture, autonomous aerial systems,
R&D, production, pilot training, and operational consultancy across multiple industries, delivering
meaningful outcomes for our clients. At the core of our success are our people, and the
relationships they build with clients, regulators, partners, and investors that continue to drive
our growth and impact. We remain committed to exceeding expectations while fostering an inclusive,
collaborative, and supportive culture that embraces the strength of diverse perspectives.”

## Glen Lynch

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

We act with the highest ethical standards, ensuring transparency and honesty in everything we do.

## SAFETY CULTURE

Our Safety Management System (SMS) is the heartbeat of our operations. It is a structured approach
that integrates organizational structures, accountabilities, policies, and procedures.

### 01. SYSTEMATIC RISK MANAGEMENT

A structured approach to identifying, assessing, and mitigating safety risks across all operations.

### 02. REGULATORY READINESS

Aligned with global safety standards and prepared for integration into modern air traffic systems.

### 03. DEPLOYMENT-READY OPERATIONS

Proven cargo solutions designed for safe BVLOS operations in remote and controlled environments.

## Advanced Aerial Surveillance & Monitoring Solutions

Modern surveillance operations require continuous situational awareness, scalable monitoring
capabilities, and rapid access to operational intelligence. Our aerial surveillance and monitoring
solutions support infrastructure operators, industrial facilities, public safety agencies, and
remote operations teams with real-time airborne visibility and aerial monitoring capabilities.

Using integrated aerial platforms equipped with HD imaging systems, thermal sensors, live-streaming
technologies, and AI-assisted analytics, we support both scheduled monitoring operations and
rapid-response aerial deployments across diverse operational environments.

## Critical Infrastructure Monitoring

Aerial monitoring of industrial facilities, substations, refineries, solar farms, mining sites, and
other high-value infrastructure assets.

## Pipeline & Utility Corridor Surveillance

Monitoring of linear infrastructure corridors for unauthorized activity, encroachments, leak
indicators, vegetation risks, and operational anomalies.

## Construction & Industrial Site Monitoring

Periodic aerial monitoring for operational oversight, project progress tracking, equipment activity
observation, and safety assessment.

## Remote Operations Monitoring

Continuous or scheduled aerial monitoring for remote assets and geographically distributed
operations where ground visibility is limited.

## Traffic & Crowd Monitoring

Real-time aerial observation supporting traffic flow analysis, public event monitoring, crowd
movement assessment, and emergency coordination.

## Technology Stack & Capabilities

Integrated aerial sensing, real-time monitoring systems, and scalable operational workflows
supporting continuous surveillance and monitoring operations.

### RGB / HD Visual Imaging

High-resolution airborne imaging for real-time observation, monitoring, and visual intelligence
collection.

### Thermal Imaging

Thermal sensing capabilities for heat anomaly detection, low-visibility monitoring, and operational
risk identification.

### AI-Based Detection & Analytics

Automated analytics for object detection, activity recognition, anomaly identification, and
operational intelligence workflows.

### Live Video Streaming

Real-time airborne video transmission enabling remote monitoring and operational coordination.

### Remote Operations & Command Systems

Integrated command and control systems supporting distributed aerial monitoring operations.

### BVLOS-Capable Operations

Extended-range aerial operations for large-area surveillance and corridor monitoring missions.

### Edge Data Processing

Rapid onboard and field-based processing for time-sensitive operational intelligence delivery.

### Integrated Air Operations

Combined crewed and remotely piloted aerial capabilities supporting scalable surveillance
deployments.

## Operational Control Center

Integrated mission control center for real-time aerial monitoring, mission visibility, communication
workflows, and distributed surveillance operations.

## Real-Time Operational Visibility

Live aerial feeds, telemetry, and monitoring systems providing continuous visibility across
operational areas for improved situational awareness and faster response coordination.

## Continuous Monitoring & Rapid Response

Persistent aerial monitoring capabilities enabling faster anomaly detection, operational escalation,
and response support across dynamic environments.

## Centralized Mission Coordination

Centralized coordination of aerial assets, field teams, and surveillance activities through
integrated operational workflows and real-time communication systems.

## Real-Time Situational Awareness Solutions

Leverage integrated aerial capabilities, real-time monitoring systems, and scalable operational
workflows to support complex surveillance and field operations.

## Advanced Airborne Inspection Solutions

Modern asset inspection programs require accurate condition assessment, reduced operational
downtime, and safer access to critical infrastructure. Our aerial inspection solutions support
industrial operators, utilities, infrastructure owners, and engineering teams with high-resolution
airborne inspections, advanced sensor data acquisition, and scalable inspection workflows.

Using integrated aerial platforms equipped with thermal imaging, LiDAR, gas detection, multispectral
sensing, and HD visual systems, we deliver inspection data that supports maintenance planning,
regulatory compliance, structural assessment, and operational decision-making.

## Infrastructure & Structural Inspections

Inspection of bridges, towers, rooftops, industrial structures, and transportation infrastructure
for condition assessment and defect identification.

## Energy & Utility Inspections

Aerial inspections of transmission lines, substations, solar farms, wind turbines, and utility
assets supporting maintenance and operational reliability.

## Pipeline & Corridor Inspections

Monitoring of pipelines and right-of-way corridors for leaks, erosion, encroachments, vegetation
risks, and infrastructure anomalies.

## Thermal & Infrared Inspections

Thermal assessment of industrial systems, electrical assets, energy infrastructure, and operational
hotspots using airborne thermography.

## Gas Detection & Environmental Inspections

Airborne gas detection and environmental monitoring supporting leak identification, emissions
assessment, and regulatory compliance workflows.

## Confined Space Inspections

Remote inspection of hazardous and restricted-access environments using advanced aerial systems to
improve safety and operational visibility.

## Technology Stack & Capabilities

Integrated aerial sensing systems and inspection workflows supporting detailed condition assessment
and asset intelligence.

### RGB / HD Visual Imaging

High-resolution airborne imaging for structural assessment, defect identification, and asset
condition monitoring.

### Thermal Imaging Systems

Thermal inspections supporting hotspot detection, anomaly identification, and predictive maintenance
workflows.

### LiDAR & 3D Modelling

High-accuracy spatial data acquisition supporting structural analysis, digital twins, and
infrastructure modelling.

### Gas Detection Sensors

Airborne gas sensing systems supporting methane detection, emissions monitoring, and environmental
assessments.

### AI-Based Analytics

Automated analytics supporting anomaly detection, defect identification, and inspection data
interpretation.

### RTK / PPK Positioning

Survey-grade positioning systems ensuring accurate and repeatable inspection data acquisition.

### Integrated Air Operations

Combined crewed and remotely piloted aerial operations supporting scalable inspection deployments.

### Digital Asset Intelligence

Geo-referenced inspection outputs, condition analysis, and reporting supporting maintenance and
operational planning.

## Aerial Inspections for Critical Infrastructure

Deploy advanced aerial inspection technologies to improve defect detection, inspection coverage, and
operational decision-making.

## Delivery Drones

## Condor XL

A powerful cargo drone, engineered for long-range , heavy-payload deliveries in the world’s most
challenging environments. Designed with industry and government in mind, the Condor XL opens up a
new frontier for drone logistics.

Key Features
* Two-stroke, gasoline powered helicopter drone
* Designed for long-range deliveries (upto 200km) and heavier payloads (upto 180kg).
* Multi-package payload compartment

Whether it’s delivering critical supplies to remote communities, supporting industrial operations or
responding to emergencies, the Condor XL is purpose-built for missions where conventional logistics
fall short.

## Canary

The drone offers a 20 km (12 miles) range and a payload capacity of 4.5 kg (10 lbs.), making it
suitable for a variety of uses including the delivery of parcels, medical tests, medicine, emergency
kits, small parts, and mail. It features an integrated weight scale for accurate payload
measurements and a touchless cargo drop feature for efficient deliveries. Additionally, the drone is
equipped with new safety technology, including an aircraft parachute deployment system. It is also
approved for flight over people, ensuring compliance with safety regulations.

## Aero II - Defour Aerospace

This tilt-wing drone takes-off and lands like a helicopter, but flies as fast and energy efficient
as an airplane. Designed it for a maximum of flexibility, highest safety standards and low operation
cost.

Payload: Internal payload, front loaded, slide-in External payload, 40kg max.

## PRISM - DroneUp

The DroneUp Aircraft is a high-performance delivery drone with a 55 lb MTOW and 40-minute endurance,
featuring advanced AI-driven navigation, obstacle detection, and precision landing. Its integrated
winch system enables 100-foot line delivery with secure Smart Hook v3.4 and Flight Lock technology
for automated loading and release. Powered by a redundant 12S system and dual F9P GPS units, it
ensures reliable, autonomous operations. Designed for seamless logistics, it’s built to integrate
into scalable drone delivery networks.

## Infrastructure & Software

FLYTE Remote Operations Control Center (OCC) DBX DroneSpot™

Volatus Aerospace Inc.’s FLYTE software is a comprehensive solution for managing autonomous drone
operations, particularly in drone logistics and delivery. FLYTE is a complete solution for
autonomous drone operations that integrates with existing logistics, supply chain, and enterprise
systems. It includes features like automated flight management for multiple drones, maintenance
tracking, real-time tracking and telemetry, and geofencing for safe navigation, and emergency
landing procedures, as well as robust reporting and analytics tools and more.

The Operations Control Center (OCC) is a cutting-edge, controlled access facility capable of
accommodating up to 20 operators simultaneously and is capable of 4+ hours of off-grid
functionality. To date, the OCC has conducted more than 10,000 commercial flights, travelling a
distance of more than 20,000 km, with operations as far as 3,600 km away from the OCC. Staffed by
highly qualified operators, weekly operations out of the OCC include flights at Edmonton
International Airport and Halton Healthcare delivering laboratory specimens and medical supplies ,
including the delivery of dangerous goods.

* **Real-Time Fleet Coordination:** Continuous monitoring and coordination of aerial assets, payload

### Operations Planning

We work with you to determine the best technologies for your unique delivery need. We develop a
complete ground-air risk / mitigation assessment of the operation. Formulate a “Concept of
Operations,” which outlines the full scope of the delivery service including a full analysis of the
airspace. Obtain requisite approvals through regulatory and government agencies.

### Training & Education

Pilots are trained to the highest standards, adhering to regulatory requirements, internal policies,
customer requirements, and manufacturer recommendations. Our pilots undergo continuous education and
advanced training programs that meet or exceed industry and regulatory requirements, ensuring they
remain at the forefront of safety, compliance, and operational excellence.

## Safety Management
* **Transparent Reporting**: We maintain an open safety record, transparently documenting all
incidents, resolutions, and internal Safety Management System (SMS) analyses to drive continuous
improvement. By proactively addressing risks and implementing enhancements, we ensure compliance
and report incidents to the appropriate aviation authorities.
* **Rigorous Testing:** Every drone in our fleet is rigorously tested for performance and
reliability before deployment, undergoing thorough evaluation and vetting by Volatus to ensure the
highest operational standards.
* **Regular Maintenance:** We implement strict maintenance and preventative maintenance schedules in
full compliance with regulatory and manufacturer requirements, ensuring all equipment remains in
optimal condition while minimizing potential operational risks.
* **Advanced Navigation Systems:** Our drones are equipped with state-of-the-art navigation systems
such as real-time traffic management and obstacle avoidance technologies, ensuring safe operations
in complex urban and rural environments.

## Agriculture & Environmental Monitoring

Smart and Intelligent Monitoring Across Land, Forest & Agriculture

[ Talk To An Expert ][38]

## Precision Monitoring for Agricultural & Environmental Applications

Environmental monitoring, forestry operations, and modern agriculture increasingly rely on accurate
geospatial intelligence, scalable monitoring capabilities, and data-driven decision-making. Our
aerial operations support environmental agencies, forestry organizations, agricultural operators,
and land management teams with advanced remote sensing, aerial analytics, and operational monitoring
solutions.

Using remotely piloted and crewed aerial platforms equipped with multispectral sensors, LiDAR
systems, thermal imaging, and geospatial processing workflows, we deliver high-quality environmental
and vegetation intelligence across diverse operational environments.

## Crop Health Monitoring

Aerial assessment of crop conditions, vegetation stress, growth variability, and agricultural field
performance.

## Multispectral Vegetation Analysis

Spectral analysis supporting vegetation classification, plant health assessment, and agricultural
intelligence workflows.

## Wildfire Risk Assessment

Monitoring vegetation conditions, thermal anomalies, and environmental indicators supporting
wildfire preparedness and risk analysis.

## Forest Health Monitoring

Large-area aerial monitoring of canopy conditions, vegetation density, disease impact, and forestry
operations.

## Irrigation Analysis

Assessment of irrigation efficiency, water distribution patterns, and crop moisture variability.

## Deforestation Monitoring

Monitoring land-use changes, vegetation loss, and forestry activity across large geographic regions.

## Environmental Impact Assessment

Geospatial monitoring and aerial analysis supporting environmental compliance, site assessment, and
ecological studies.

## Biodiversity & Habitat Monitoring

Aerial observation and mapping supporting ecosystem analysis, habitat assessment, and conservation
operations.

## Technology Stack & Capabilities

Integrated aerial sensing systems and geospatial workflows supporting large-scale environmental and
vegetation intelligence operations.

### Multispectral Imaging

Spectral sensing capabilities supporting vegetation analysis, crop assessment, and land
classification workflows.

### LiDAR Systems

High-accuracy terrain and canopy mapping supporting forestry analysis and environmental modelling.

### Thermal Imaging Systems

Thermal sensing for vegetation stress detection, wildfire monitoring, and environmental assessment.

### Geospatial Intelligence Workflows

Spatial data processing and environmental analytics supporting mapping and monitoring operations.

### AI-Based Analytics

Automated analysis supporting vegetation classification, anomaly detection, and large-scale
environmental monitoring.

### RTK / PPK Positioning

High-accuracy positioning systems supporting survey-grade environmental and agricultural data
acquisition.

### Integrated Air Operations

Combined crewed and remotely piloted aerial operations supporting scalable environmental monitoring
missions.

### Digital Terrain & Surface Modelling

Generation of terrain, canopy, and environmental surface models supporting analysis and planning
workflows.

## Enhance Environmental & Vegetation Monitoring Operations

Leverage advanced aerial sensing, geospatial intelligence, and scalable monitoring capabilities for
environmental, forestry, and agricultural operations.

## Why Environmental Aerial Operations Matter

Advanced aerial monitoring and remote sensing technologies enable faster environmental assessment,
scalable land monitoring, improved resource management, and data-driven operational decision-making
across large and complex landscapes.

## 01

### Large-Area Coverage

Efficient monitoring of forests, agricultural land, environmental corridors, and remote terrain at
operational scale.

## 02

### Faster & Scalable Monitoring

Support for recurring surveys, seasonal analysis, and long-range environmental monitoring
operations.

## 03

### Reduced Field Dependency

Airborne data acquisition minimizes extensive ground surveys and improves access to difficult or
sensitive environments.

## 04

### High-Resolution Environmental Visibility

Advanced sensing systems provide detailed vegetation, terrain, and environmental insights for
improved assessment and planning.

## Why Volatus Aerospace?

We are more than a drone service provider, we are an enterprise aerial intelligence partner.

### Integrated Aerial Capabilities

Combined crewed and remotely piloted aerial operations supporting diverse mission requirements.

### Advanced Sensing & Intelligence

Multi-sensor data acquisition integrated with geospatial and analytical workflows.

### Operational Reliability & Expertise

Experienced mission planning, regulatory coordination, and reliable field execution.

### Decision-Ready Deliverables

Processed insights, technical outputs, and actionable reporting beyond raw aerial data collection.

# Pioneering the
# Future of Aviation

Volatus Aerospace is shaping the global landscape of uncrewed flight through precision engineering,
uncompromising safety, and a legacy of aeronautical excellence.

## Built on Experience.
## Driven by the Future.

## Aviation Expertise & Operational Excellence

With deep roots in traditional aviation, Volatus Aerospace brings decades of operational, safety,
and regulatory expertise into the evolving uncrewed systems industry, building reliable solutions
trusted by commercial and defence partners worldwide.

## Bridging Innovation to Commercialization

Our Center of Excellence transforms emerging technologies into practical aviation solutions,
supporting the transition between crewed and uncrewed systems while enabling scalable innovation for
commercial and defence applications worldwide.

## Our Mission

**To deliver advanced aerial solutions through innovation, operational excellence, and a relentless
commitment to our stakeholders.**

## Our Vision

**To shape the future of intelligent aerial innovation worldwide.**

## A MESSAGE FROM OUR CEO

“We have built a team that is constantly pushing the boundaries of UAV technology, Counter-UAS
systems, defence innovation, and advanced aerospace solutions powered by AI intelligence and
advanced analytics. Our work spans inspection, imaging, data capture, autonomous aerial systems,
R&D, production, pilot training, and operational consultancy across multiple industries, delivering
meaningful outcomes for our clients. At the core of our success are our people, and the
relationships they build with clients, regulators, partners, and investors that continue to drive
our growth and impact. We remain committed to exceeding expectations while fostering an inclusive,
collaborative, and supportive culture that embraces the strength of diverse perspectives.”

## Glen Lynch

CHIEF EXECUTIVE OFFICER

## Our Values

## Where purpose, people, and performance align.

### INTEGRITY

We act with the highest ethical standards, ensuring transparency and honesty in everything we do.

### SAFETY

We prioritize safety above all, ensuring our products, services, and operations meet the most
rigorous standards.

### CUSTOMER FOCUS

Our customers are at the heart of everything we do, and we are committed to delivering solutions
that create real value.

### EXCELLENCE

We strive for excellence in every aspect of our work, continuously improving to deliver the highest
quality outcomes.

### TEAMWORK

We believe in the power of collaboration, working closely with stakeholders to achieve shared goals
and lasting success.

### SUSTAINABILITY

We are committed to responsible practices that reduce environmental impact and support a better
future.

## SAFETY CULTURE

Our Safety Management System (SMS) is the heartbeat of our operations. It is a structured approach
that integrates organizational structures, accountabilities, policies, and procedures.

### 01. SYSTEMATIC RISK MANAGEMENT

A structured approach to identifying, assessing, and mitigating safety risks across all operations.

### 02. REGULATORY READINESS

Aligned with global safety standards and prepared for integration into modern air traffic systems.

### 03. DEPLOYMENT-READY OPERATIONS

Proven cargo solutions designed for safe BVLOS operations in remote and controlled environments.

Developed by the World Economic Forum’s Centre for the New Economy and Society as part of the Global
Gender Parity Sprint, the report draws on novel data from the LinkedIn Economic Graph Research

[The Regenerative Blue Economy: Pathways to Prosperity][18]

Marine ecosystems continue to degrade under pressure from warming seas, rising tides, pollution and
overuse, undermining the long-term well-being of the communities and economies that depend on them.
This report examines how to shift from the status quo – which perpetuates this decline – towards a
regenerative blue economy.
Roughly 40% of the world's population lives within 100 km of the coast. That narrow band – just 5%
of inhabited land – generates 30-50% of global GDP and concentrates ports, energy infrastructure,
aquaculture, desalination and tourism. This is where most of the regenerative blue economy will be
built. The report analyses how the interaction of four systemic levers – integrated ocean
governance, innovative and equitable finance, investment in human capacity, and advances in
technology and AI – can help transform these ocean-based industries.
Rather than focusing on short-term returns, a regenerative approach offers an ambitious vision of
blue economic activity that helps restore ecosystems, strengthen resilience and support equitable
prosperity for coastal communities within planetary limits. This approach challenges decision-makers
to judge success not only by the wealth generated from the ocean, but by the extent to which that
wealth supports restoration, fairness and intergenerational well-being.

[Plastic Pollution and Biodiversity: a Global Overview][22]

Every year, an estimated 130 million tonnes of plastic waste are unmanaged or improperly discarded,
polluting soils, waterways and seas. While efforts continue to promote a circular economy and pursue
a global plastics treaty, far less attention has focused on how plastic pollution affects
biodiversity and the ecosystem services that underpin economies and human well-being. This report
addresses that gap.

Plastic pollution has particularly severe impacts on sectors such as fisheries, agriculture and
tourism, which directly depend on healthy natural systems. These impacts demonstrate that
biodiversity loss and plastic pollution are not just environmental challenges, but economic and
resilience challenges too. More than half of global GDP is moderately or highly dependent on nature.
So degraded ecosystems create growing risks for communities, industries and economies at a time when
they are already under pressure from climate change and geopolitical uncertainty.

This report draws on field assessments conducted across nine geographies on three continents –
developed by the World Economic Forum’s Global Plastic Action Partnership (GPAP) – which together
represent one of the most detailed multi-country evidence bases on plastic pollution and
biodiversity to date. It concludes with recommendations for governments, corporates, investors and
communities to translate this evidence into coordinated action to deliver measurable benefits for
nature, people and economies.

deployed economic statecraft on a scale not seen in the modern era, accelerating and deepening
fragmentation. These global trends present concrete risks and opportunities to emerging markets and
developing economies, which are explored in detail in a case study of major African economies. The
report offers new quantitative analysis and renews the private sector’s call to preserve the core

## OUR STORY

In 2005, Ziqitza Health Care Limited was founded by a group of young professionals - as a result of
personal experiences.

The founders realised that the difference in EMS service in India and US was the availability and
accessibility of standardized emergency medical services providers. Ziqitza recognised the need of
organised and professional ambulance providers in the country, and thus began the journey to create
the best emergency response service in India that would be on par with 911 in the U.S. and 999 in
the U.K. We realised the urgency of an organised and networked ambulance service required for saving
those lives that would have been otherwise lost, for want of timely medical attention

ZHL’s vision is to assist in saving human lives by providing a leading network of fully equipped
Advanced and Basic Life Support Ambulances across the developing world.

[AMBULANCE & MEDICAL EMERGENCY SERVICES]

Medical emergency services now take the role of basic needs due to risky lifestyles. The emergency
time is the most crucial time of life. In such circumstances, a quick emergency response is needed.
We have been pioneering emergency response systems and patient transport services in India since
2005. In India, nearly 1.5 lakh people die in road accidents, which translates to 422 accidents
every day. Unfortunately, there is no specific response time for ambulances. On average, an
ambulance takes more than 45 minutes. Ziqitza assures swift response on one call. The service is
active across 60 cities.

With our international presence, we are taking our brand of commitment across the world. In India,
our footsteps are growing and we truly believe in making a positive difference in the public health
of the country. In emergency ambulance service there are ALS (Advanced Life Support), BLS (Basic
Life Support), and MICUs (Mobile Intensive Care Units) provided as per patients' criticality.
Advanced technology systems such as TMS are used for vehicles to be on track by TMS (Transport
Management System). We always look for the safety of both patients and our staff. Working for India,
providing service in every corner is our goal.

# About Us | Zenadrone | Leading Drone Innovators & Aerial Tech Experts

## Our BackStory

ZenaDrone is committed to providing innovative and reliable drone solutions to businesses and
individuals across various industries. We strive to be a trusted partner in advancing technology,
promoting sustainability, and improving operational efficiency while maintaining the highest
standards of safety and ethics.

ZenaDrone’s origins date back to 2017, when its principals began supplying drone technology to
farmers, powered by our supply chain software. ZenaDrone was founded in 2020 by Dr. Shaun Passley,
who recognized the potential to revolutionize other industries with drones. Initially, the company
focused on providing aerial photography and videography as well as inspection and mapping services
for the construction and real estate industries.

[Drone Services Order]

As the demand for drone technology grew, ZenaDrone expanded its offerings to include custom drone
design, manufacturing, and training services. The company also began serving the agriculture and
mining industries by providing drone-based solutions for crop monitoring, land surveying, and
environmental monitoring.

### The ZenaDrone Commitment

Our engineering and technical teams are dedicated to providing several industries with precise,
accurate, and real-time aerial information. Organizations may now quickly access cloud-based data
and utilize it to research and assess property asset conditions. They can optimize their lands,
buildings, surveillance, weather forecasting projects, rescue missions, military operation, and
evaluate industrial gains and losses.

The [ZenaDrone Inc.][195]boasts unique features and functions integrated with intelligent algorithms
that can retain and recognize information input to satisfy the demand for technological innovation
in various industries, including but not limited to the following:
* Agriculture and Farm Plantation
* Environmental Monitoring and Conservation
* Weather Prediction
* Property Management
* Search and Rescue Missions
* Emergency Services
* Livestock Management
* Military Industry
* Security and Surveillance
* Crop Insurance
* Architecture and Construction
* Film and Media Production
* Warehousing and Inventory
* Cargo and Logistics
* Power Lines and Grids
* Renewable Energy
* Oil and Gas Industry
* City Planning
* Industrial Zoning
* Mining Industry

### Field Tested

ZenaDrone is deployed at the world’s most extensive mining, oil and gas, utilities, [renewable
energy][196] companies, agricultural lands, military, navy, combat, and covert aerial operations.

### Regulation-ready

Our technology is safe and trusted by regulators worldwide, critical for smooth operations in
high-stress situations. We are working with aviation authorities to keep up with regulation trends.

### AI-enabled

Our AI-powered solution goes beyond data collecting to provide real-time actionable alerts,
insights, and reports.

### Unparalleled Innovation

ZenaDrone’s multi-mission drone-in-a-box solutions are the most innovative and most sophisticated on
the market, engineered with defense, military, industrial and corporate demands in mind.

**Autonomous cycle**

[ZenaDrone is a self-driving drone][197] that performs everyday field scanning, aerial surveillance
chores and responds to emergencies with less human interaction.

**The best possible drone service solutions**
ZenaDrone’s drone-in-a-box solutions can operate at all hours of the day and night, withstanding
harsh temperatures and natural conditions. You can choose any of the [drone as a service][198]
(DaaS) solutions that perfectly meets your enterprise operations.

**Automated insight**
ZenaDrone uses computer vision and artificial intelligence to give valuable aerial visual insights
in real-time and after missions, allowing you to improve your security and business operations while
lowering risks and expenses.

focused on providing aerial photography and videography as well as inspection and mapping services
